name: Solomon
full_text: NOTICE: Two Boys, one named Solomon, belonging to Mr J.H. Neethling, and the other named Jeffie, belonging to Mr P. Marais, were returning home from Cape Town in a Bullock wagon, with 200 Rds. Cash in their care, on their arrival at home, and missing the Money, the boys through fear of punishment absconded. Any person or persons who may lodge both or either of the above named boys in any of His Majesty's Prisons, or have them conveyed to their respective Masters at Wolvefontein, near Stellenbosch, or will give any information respecting the Money, will be rewarded by the Owners.

name: Thomas
physical_description: very much ruptured
clothing: blue jacket, striped Trowsers, (Toedoeng) Malay hat
full_text: ABSCONDED: A Cape Native Slave-boy named Thomas; he is easily known, being very much ruptured. He was dressed when he eloped, in blue jacket, and a pair of striped Trowsers, and has a (Toedoeng) Malay hat on. Whoever lodges him in one of the Government Prisons, will be well rewarded by J.A. van Breda. [Rementioned ZA 18300528: FIFTEEN RIX-DOLLARS REWARD WILL be given to whoever shall bring the Slave of Mr J.A. van BREDA, named Thomas, either to his House, or in the Town Prison]

name: Adriaan
physical_description: yellow complexion, small stature, curly? Hair
full_text: Only Dutch record: GEDROST, op den 14den February jl. Van de Plaats 'Wolvefontein' gelegen in de Koebergen, een jongen genaamd ADRIAAN, zynde geelblank van kleur, zeer klein van gestalte, en heest styl haar {yellow complexion, small stature, curly? hair}; en eene zeer blanke Meid, [genaamd (?) of Willemina], met roode wangen, sterk van gestalte {white complexion, red cheeks, strong stature}, draagt het haar lang, en meest in lokken, en kleed zich over het algemeen als een Jufvrouw - De Slaven behoorten, de eerste aan den Mr A. van Breda, Sen. en de laatste aan Hr ? van Breda, Az? Daaroor reden bestaan om te gelooven, dat deze menschen zich (?) risten [Chritenen], of ten minsten als Vryzwarten uitgeven, waarschuwen wy een ieder, ter voorkoming van groote [on]aangenaamheden, die menschen niet op t hou[den]; beloovende daaren tegen eene goede belooning aan de genen die ze in een der Gevangenessen, dan wer op voornoemde plaats terug brengt. [by den Heer Jacobus van Breda, Az terug brengt] [additional clear info ZA 1830 05 07]

name: Willemina
physical_description: white complexion, red cheeks, strong stature

name: Rachel
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. RAN Away, the female Slave Rachel, a native of the Cape, aged about 19 years, and formerly the property of Mr Fr. Dormehl; she was last seen at the Place of Mr Liebetrau, at Moddergat, where she passed herself as a bastard Hottentot. Whoever will apprehend and lodge her in the Prison, either at Cape Town or Stellenbosch, shall receive the above Reward. Stellenbosch, July 1. J.F. MULLER.

name: Constantia
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. THE Female Slave Constantia, formerly the property of J.J. Mocke (having by purchase become the property of the Undersigned) has absconded with her Husband, Frederik Floris, from the Place Smalpad, situate(d) at Groenekloof. The above reward is offered to any Person who will apprehed her, either at my House in Cape Town, or in any of the public Gaols. And if she will come home of her own accord, she will meet no ill usage. Cape Town, July 8, 1830. F.P. Heinenberg. [Rememntioned ZA 1830 0730]

name: September
full_text: RAN AWAY, about three weeks ago, the Slave Boy named September, being a (a) Cook; and it is likely he hires himself out as such. Notice is given thereof. Any person detaining him after this will be prosecuted, and those who will apprehend him, shall be rewarded.

name: Christina van de Kaap
physical_description: yellow complexion, spots on face
full_text: RAN-AWAY, from Stellenbosch, on the 22nd instant, the female Slave, named Christina, a native of the Cape, of a yellow complexion, and some spots in her face. Whoever apprehends her, shall be rewarded; but those harboring her must abide the consequences. J.D. Victor.

name: Roelof
physical_description: 5 feet high, moderately stout stature
advertiser: Van der Merwe, SJ (De Wit DJ qq)
full_text: TWENTY-FIVE Rixdollars Reward. The Slave named Roelof the property of Schalk Johannes van der Merwe, and formerly belonging to Johannes Rasmus van der Merwe, has absconded from Bokkeveld, about a fortnight ago; he is commonly called Malebar African, about 5 feet high, and of moderately stout stature; it is supposed that he harbors himself in this Town. Whoever will apprehend him and lodge him any Prison, will receive the above reward, on application to the Undersigned, at the Place of Mr. P.A. van der Byl, Eerste Rivier. July 26, 1830. D.J. de WIT, qq.

name: Jonathan
full_text: RAN AWAY, the Undersigned's Slave Boy, Jonathan, a carpenter. Whoever will apprehend him shall be rewarded; but those harbouring or employing him will be prosecuted. J.P. SERRURIER

name: Saul of Mozambique
full_text: 50 RIX_DOLLARS REWARD - Absconded, since 22nd of April, 1829 {16 months}, from the Place Muizekraal, two Slaves belonging to the Field Cornet, C. Cloete, of Langeberg, District of Swellendam, named Saul, of Mozambique, and Rosalyn, of the Cape. Whoever lodges them in the Prison of Swellendam, or brings them to the Undersigned, at Cape Town, shall receive the above Reward; and those harbouring them will be prosecuted. Should these slaves come voluntarily to the Undersigned, as they will be sold in a short time, they will be forgiven. J.A.H. WICHT, Trusteein the insolvent Estate of C. Cloete. No. 12, Bree Street.

name: Absolon
clothing: light brown Duffle great Coat, dark brown Duffle Jacket, Leather Trousers, white Shirt, white Hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, about two Months ago, the male slave named Absolon, about 38 years of age, a wagon driver, belonging to the Undersigned, he had on when he absconded himself a light brown Duffle great Coat, a dark brown Duffle Jacket, Leather Trousers, a white Shirt and a white Hat. He was formerly in the service of Abraham Jacobus de Villiers, Pieter's son, residing before the New Kloof, Worcester. Any person who will apprehend and lodge him in prison shall be rewarded; and those detaining him after this Notice will be prosecuted according to Law. Beaufort, Aug. 2. J. Baird.

name: Alie
physical_description: brown complexion, large black mole on the left side of his nose
intentions: Calls himself a bastard Hottentot; Suspected in Paardeberg
full_text: TWENTY-FIVE RIX DOLLARS REWARD. ABSCONDED, a Slave-boy named Alie, about 15 years old, of a brown complexion, and having a large black mole on the left side of his nose. It is supposed that he calls himself a bastard Hottentot, and that he is in the neighbourhood of Paardeberg. His former owner is Mr. Jan Bantjes. Whoever lodges him in prison, or bring him to Mr. Sebastian van Reenen, Fs. Cape Town, shall receive the above reward. Rondebosch, Sept. 7. M.J. van SCHOOR.

name: Ernst van de Kaap
full_text: NOTICE. THE Slave-boy Ernst, of the Cape, having been hired out as Saddler, to Mr. Jac. Van der Spuy, at Koebergen, and who was sent there on the 19th of last June, having absconded himself some time ago - Whoever lodges him in prison, or brings him to the Undersigned, will be handsomely rewarded; and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. J.F. SERRURIER.

name: Philis
physical_description: middling posture, yellow complexion, large eyes
clothing: bottle green jacket, white under clothes, red handkerchief on his head
intentions: pretends seeking employ with owner's leave
full_text: RAN away since the 11th instant, the Slave PHILIS, purchased by me out the estate of the late J. Myburgh; dressed in a bottle green jacket, white under clothes, and had a red handkerchief on his head; he is of middling posture, yellow complexion, and has large eyes; is a Tailor by trade, and has a fiddle with him; he pretends seeking employ, with my leave, and hires himself out as a tailor or fiddler. Whoever will apprehend him, will receive a Reward over and above the usual apprehension fee; and those habouring(sic) him will be prosecuted. C.C. MOCKE, Long Street.

name: Saartjie
physical_description: short stature, yellow complexion
full_text: 10 Rds. REWARD - Absconded in July last, my Slave-girl, named Saartjie. She is of a short stature, and yellow complexion. Whoever will bring her to me, or lodge her in the Prison, will receive the above Reward; but whoever detains her after this Advertisement, will be prosecuted according to law. Widow R.S. ALLEMAN

name: William
physical_description: yellow complexion
full_text: ABSCONDED. A Young Prize Negro, named William, about 10 years old, of a yellow complexion, and bound to the Undersigned. He was seen last Saturday on a Boor-wagon. Whoever apprehend the said Boy are requested to deliver him to the Undersigned, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. H. Muller, No. 14, Zieke-street. Cape Town, Oct 4, 1830.

name: Francis
physical_description: 5 feet high, bandy legged
full_text: A RUN AWAY Slave of the Undersigned having some time ago been apprehended at a Wagon of a certain Person named John Orchard, with whom it is said that the same Boy had made two Journeys into the Interior of this Colony; it may be surmised that another Slave of the Undersigned, [genaamd Francis] who speaks Dutch tolerably well, and much resembles the former, (being about 5 feet high [5 voeten en 8 duimen], bandy legged, and a native of Mosambique,) is also employed in a similar manner. A Reward is therefore offered to whoever will lodge him in one of the Prisons, and those detaining him will be prosecuted. J.R. LOUW. Paarl, Oct 10.

name: Achap
physical_description: middling stature, yellow complexion
intentions: Pretends to be free Malay; suspected detained at a Malay home
full_text: FIFTEEN RIX-DOLLARS REWARD. RAN away, since July last, the Male Slave Achap, 22 years of age, a native of this place, of middling stature, and yellow complexion, being by trade a smith; he pretends to be a free person named Abdol [vermits hy tot die list geen pas noodig heest]. Whoever will lodge him in one of the Public Gaols shall receive the above Reward, and those harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted with the utmost rigor of the law. [1831 08 26 - Sixty Rixdollars Reward - He is to all probability detaining himself in one of the Malay houses in this Town - He is in the meantime for Sale - Application to be made at no 72 Bree Street - JA Holtman qq]

name: Gideon
full_text: ABSCONDED, since last month, the Slave boy, Gideon, by trade a shoemaker, and as it is supposed he hires himself out as such, the undersigned gives notice therof to the Public. Those harbouring him will be prosecuted according to Law, and whoever lodges him in prison, will be rewarded. The WidowM.T. Smuts.

name: Rotterdam
physical_description: mark on forehead, 5 feet 2 inches, black hair and eyes
intentions: Has a stolen pass/ Pretends to be free
full_text: ABSCONDED, for about four years the slave Rotterdam, a mason by trade, he has a mark on his Forehead, is in posession of a Passport which he has stolen from the prize slave Sofie, alias Caesar, brought here in 1818 in the ship Elizabeth. He was formerly in the service of Mr. Reads. Rotterdam is 40 years old, 5 feet 2 inches in height, having black hair and eyes the same colour. Whoever is found to detain him will be prosecuted, and he who shall restore him, will receive a reward of 100 Rix-dollars. the Widow SINJEUR. Cape Town, the 9th Dec, 1830.

name: Rachel
full_text: ABSCONDED, an African female Slave, named Rachel, belonging to the Undersigned. Whoever lodges her in prison, shall be rewarded; and those harbouring her, will be prosecuted. J.J. Jacobsz.

name: Spadilel
physical_description: abnormaly small in stature
full_text: [ONLY DUTCH] GEDROST, EEN Slavejongen genaamd Spadilel, buitengewoon klein van gestalte {abnormaly small in stature}, circa 30 jaren oud, en is onlangs in die stad gezien. Die hem in de gevangenis bezorgt zal goed beloond worden, en die hem ophoudt wachte zich voor schade. J.P. ROUX. Eersterevier den 7 Dec, 1830.

name: Gameleil Skidmore
physical_description: 4 feet 11 inches high, fair complexion
full_text: DESERTED from the Bark Thorn, Gameleil Skidmore, an Apprentice. Description. He is about 4 feet 11 inches high, fair complexion, and about 13 years of age. Any person harbouring the same will be liable to prosecution; or, any person giving information to the Capt, at the Town Prison, or to Messrs. Thomson, Watson & Co. will be rewarded. Wm. Johnston.

name: Sampeur
physical_description: blind left eye, somewhat lame, large whiskers
full_text: ABSCONDED, a male Slave named Sampeur, is blind in the left eye, and is somewhat lame; he has large whiskers, and is about 40 years of age: it is suspected that he hires himself in the capacity of a Bricklayer's Laborer. Whoever lodges him in prison or brings him to the place of the Undersigned, will be well-rewarded, and those harboring him, will be prosecuted. J.G.T. van REENEN.

name: Rebecca
full_text: ABSCONDED. YESTERDAY Morning, the Slave Maid Rebecca. Whoever harbours her will be prosecuted according to law, and whoever lodges her in prison shall be rewarded. G. MARTYN.

name: Jacob
full_text: TEN RIX-DOLLARS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 25th January last, a Slave Boy named Jacob, about 16 years of age - Whoever lodges him in prison, will receive the above Reward; and those harbouring him, will be prosecuted according to Law. H.A. Sandenberg.

name: Regina
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the 14th January last, a Slave Girl, named Regina, belonging to the Undersigned. She is about 17 years of age, and resembles a bastard Hottentot. Those who lodges her in prison, will be rewarded, and those harbouring her, will be prosecuted. D.J Aspeling, Sen.

name: Roubon alias Paul
physical_description: stout built, yellow complexion, mark on the thumb of his right hand
intentions: Hires himself; pretends to be free
full_text: 25 Rds REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 10th January last, a Slave Boy named Roubon, alias Paul, born in this Colony; he is stout built, yellow complexion, and a mark on the thumb of his right hand; he is a clever (coachman?) [koetzier] and baker, He is supposed to have hired himself out to one of the bakers as a free person. The above reward will be paid to any person who will bring him home, and 15 Rds to any one who lodges him in prison. J.G. Faure. Stellenbosch, Feb 10, 1831. [NB. Een bakker benoodigd]

name: Willem
physical_description: yellow complexion, white mark above one eyebrow
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Undersigned, a Slave Boy, named WILLEM, about 16 years of age, yellow complexion, and has a white mark above one of his eyebrows, He was accompanied by two other Slave Boys of Mr. A.J. HORAK - Any Person apprehending the said WILLEM will be rewarded on bringing him to No. 11 Grave street, Cape Town. P.D. HOLME.

name: David
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 9th January last, my Slave Boy, named David, who has been formerly the property of Jacob Mostert, and a convict for some years; consequently well known. Whoever harbours him, must abide the consequences. JACOB GOUS. Driefontein, Feb, 24.

name: Adam
physical_description: one of his fore-teeth is broke even with the gum; has a brand on one of his thighs, and a ring in his left ear
clothing: Leather Jacket and Trousers, White Shirt, new Straw Hat, lined with white Cotton and stained with bark
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, a Slave Boy, belonging to the Undersigned, was dressed in a Leather Jacket and Trousers, a White Shirt, and a new Straw Hat, lined with white Cotton, and stained with bark; one of his fore-teeth is broke even with the gum; has a brand on one of his thighs, and a ring in his left ear. He has in his possession a grey horse, a gun, and fiddle, and calls himself a Bastard-Hottentot, named Klaas; he is 20 years of age. Whoever will lodge him in one of the Prisons, will receive the above reward. J.P. ROUX. Beaufort, Feb. 25, 1831.

name: Demas
full_text: 25 RIX-DOLLARS REWARD. ABSCONDED, on the 7th February last, my Slave Boy Demas (born in this Colony, of Madagascar parents), 17 years of age, formerly the property of Hermanus Steyn, Jr., in the District of Swellendam. Whoever will bring him home, shall receive the above Reward; and any person that will lodge him in one of the prisons, will recive 15 Rds. Vershe Drift, March 9. P. VAN BREDA.

name: Saronie van Mosambiek
physical_description: hole through her upper lip
full_text: TEN RIX-DOLLARS REWARD. ABSCONDED in the course of the Month of October, 1829, a Slave Girl named Saronie of Mosambique; she has a hole through her upper lip. Whoever will bring her to the Undersigned, shall receive the above reward, and those harbouring her after this notice will be prosecuted. J. NICOLAAS JOOSTE, Js. Middle Roggeveld, District of Worcester.

name: Syme
full_text: ABSCONDED, A SLAVE BOY, named Syme, much resemblingh a Hottentot, and no doubt passes for the same. He absconded on the 12th of October, having with him, his wife, a Hottentot girl, named Christina, and her child, Jacob. Whoever will apprehend this boy, is requested to forward him, either to his Owner the Undersigned, or to any of the Public Prisons. G.H. Steyn. Riebeekskasteel, 19th March, 1831.

name: Mina
physical_description: short stature, yellow complexion, scar on left eye
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE 28th March a Slave Girl named MINA, being of a short stature and yellow complexion, having a scar on her left eye, belonging to the Undersigned. Any person harbouring her, after the date of this Advertisement, will be prosecuted. P.J. VAN SITTERT. Cape Town, March 30, 1831.

name: Jafta
physical_description: tall, yellow complexion
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since October last, Two Slave Boys, viz. JAFTA, of this Colony, a tall man, of yellow complexion, and MENTOR, of Mosambique, of a short stature - Whoever will lodge any or both of these Slaves in prison, or bring them to the Undersigned, will receive 25 Rds for each of them. M. DE KOCK, Sen. Cowberg {Koeberg}, April 7, 1831.

name: Mentor
physical_description: short stature

name: Lena
physical_description: yellowish brown complexion, blear-eyed, long dressed hair
full_text: MY Slave Girl Lena has been inveigled {persuaded} away by a Hottentot named Roog, both of them are of a yellowish brown complexion. The girl is blear-eyed, has a long dressed hair, and is 19 years of age. Both have been seen on their way to Tulbagh. Whoever will bring her to her Master, or lodge her in prison, will be rewarded. J.R. LOUW, Js. Paarl, May 3, 31.

name: David
physical_description: small and thin shape, black
clothing: check trousers, and an old jacket of green velvet
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 12th of February last, my Slave Boy, named David, born in this Colony, 13 years of age, a small and thin shape, black, and much of the complexion of a Malabar; he somewhat burrs in speaking. He was dressed in a pair of check trousers, and an old jacket of green velvet - Whoever will bring him to the Undersigned, or lodge him in prison, will receive the above reward. G. LEEUWNER. Cape Town, May 5, 1831.

name: Jack
physical_description: tall, left knee bent inward, right leg somewhat shorter than left, and a little lame
clothing: Kersey jacket, Skin trousers
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, on the 26th of April last, a Slave of the Undersigned, named Jack, of Mosambique. He is tall, and his left knee bent inward, and his right leg is somewhat shorter than the left, and a little lame. He was dressed in a Kersey jacket, and Skin trousers. Whoever will bring him to the Undersigned, or lodge him in one of the prisons, will receive the above reward. But whoever detains him after this notice will be prosecuted according to law. W.A. Krigo, Sen. Stellenbosch.

name: Solomon
physical_description: about 5 feet 8 inches high, stout make, remarkably fair, light brown hair, blue eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED from Mr. J. THEUNISSEN a Slave Boy named Solomon, aged 23 years. He is about 5 feet 8 inches high, stout make, remarkably fair, light brown hair, and blue eyes. His mother is the Slave Girl Marina, formerly the property of the late Mr Theunissen Sen. and now belonging to Mrs. the Widow WRENSCH, of this Town. He has been seen since his desertion, and stated, that as his Relations have been sold he also wishes to be sold. He is in consequence offered for Sale. He is as clever a Slave as any in the Colony - he is handy in everything, and has never received a single blow from his Master for mischief. Whoever want to buy him may inquire at his Master's or at the Undersigned. Any person lodging him in Prison will be well rewarded; but whoever is found harbouring him will have to abide the consequences. R.C. Hoets, qq. Cape Town, May 1, 1831.

name: Pieter Karr
physical_description: an anchor marked on his left hand
full_text: ABSCONDED, On the 25th of May, an Apprentice Boy named PIETER KARR, about 16 years of Age. He has an anchor marked on his left hand - Whoever harbours him will be prosecuted according to law. CG Langerman. Noordhoek, June 2 1831

name: Chissie
physical_description: fair complexion, red Hair
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Undersigned his two Slaves, named Chissie and Joseph; a reward is offered for their apprehension in one of the prisons. Any person found harbouring them will be prosecuted. The first-mentioned is a Female Slave about 20 Years of Age; she has a fair complexion, and red Hair, she was accompanied by a young Englishman, a turner by trade - About a fortnight ago they were seen in company with two other persons; one a young Englishman, pock-marked, with one eye, on which he wears a green shade, and the other a free woman of colour. The Man, Joseph, is supposed to be in the District of Stellenbosch; he is about 20 Years of Age, and of fair complexion - He gives himself out for a Free Person. 22 Strand street, Cape Town, June 9, 1831. J.A. HORAK. {JUNE 17 says Joseph is 61 years old, and very deaf?} {{{ 06/17 ABSCONDED CHRISSIE & JOSEPH (info missing)…found harbouring them will be prosecuted. The first-mentioned is a female slave, about 20 years of age, she is Pregnant; has a fair complexion and red hair; she was accompanied by a young Englishman, a turner by trade. About a fortnight ago they were seen in company with two other persons; one is a young Englishman, pock-marked with one eye, on which he wears a green shade, and the other a free woman of colour. The man, Joseph, is supposed to be in the District of Stellenbosch; he is about 61 years of Age and very deaf, and of fair complexion – He gives himself out for a free person. 22 Strand Street, Cape Town, June 16 1231 (sic)}}}

name: Joseph
physical_description: fair complexion

name: Sans Soucci
physical_description: middling height, slender body, one ankle thicker than the other
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 25th of February last, my slave SANS_SOUCI, of Mosambique, about 40 years of age, he is of middling height, slender body, one ankle thicker than the other; he will probably hire himself out as a Free Prize Negro. he has been seen at Wynberg and Diepriver. A fair reward will be given to whomsoever will bring him back to the Undersigned or lodge him in prison; and those harbouring him will be prosecuted according to law. H CLOETE, Rs. Mountpleasant, 15th June 1831. [_45A]

name: Christiaan
physical_description: black complexion, curly hair, easily recognisable as one leg is shorter than the other and he requires the help of a crutch
full_text: GEABSENTEERD. SEDERT drie maanden heest zich een opgeschoten jongetje, Christiaan genaamd, van zyn Lyheer geabsenteerd. Hy is omtrent 13 jaren oud, van de Kaap geboortig, zwart van kleur, heest kroeshaar, en is opvallend kenbaar, om dat zyn eene been korter is als de andere, en met behulp van een kruk moet gaan {black complexion, curly hair, easily recognisable as one leg is shorter than the other and he requires the help of a crutch} - Hy heest vroeger toebehoord aan den heer J. ROSELT. Die hem in een der Gevangenissen bezorgt, zal eene belooning van 10 Rds. geniten, en die hem na deze ophoudt, zal volgens de wetten worden vervolgd. Daar het bekend is, dat den gem {genaamde} Jongetje door iemand opgehouden wordt, zoo is deze kennisgeving hoofdzakelyk geplaatst, ten einde die zenen opmerkzaam te maken, dat de wet hieromtrent regoerus door den Eigenaar van gem, Jongetje, hy overtuiging, stiptelyk zal worden geapliceerd, sonder distinctie van Persoon of Personen.

name: Alie
physical_description: between 4 and 5 feet high, brown complexion, large black patch on left side of nose, upper lip somewhat drawn up, caused by a kick from a horse
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the Place of Mr. Melt Jacobus van Schoor, a Slave Boy, named Alie, about 10 years of age; he is between 4 and 5 feet high, of a brown complexion, and has a large black patch on the left side of his nose, his upper lip is somewhat drawn up, caused by a kick from a horse. As he broke out of Prison at the Paarl, together with two Hottentots, it is supposed that he is actually in the Interior of the Colony. Whoever will return him to the Undersigned in Cape Town, who has bought him from his former master, or lodge him in one of the Prisons, will receive the above reward. SEBASTIAN VAN REENEN, Fs. Cape Town, July 5, 1831.

name: Abdol
physical_description: about 6 feet high, yellowish complexion, long hair, knees bent inward
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD FOR EACH. ABSCONDED two Slave Boys, one belonging to G.J. MARAIS, living at Groeneberg, named Abdol, a native of this Colony; about 6 feet high, has a yellowish complexion, long hair, and his knees bent inward. It is supposed that he hires himself out for free, as he has done it before to Mr. Smuts in the Gardens. The other is named Frolik, from Mosambique, and belongs to JOHANNES RETIEF, also of Groeneberg. One was a convict and has been used as a Police Caffer. Whoever will bring these Boys to their respective Masters or Lodge them in one of the public prisons will receive the above reward.

name: Beukis
physical_description: stout make, middling size
full_text: TEN RIX-DOLLARS REWARD. ABSCONDED since February last, a Slave Boy named Beukis, of Mosambique, the property of Mr. R.H. MYBURGH, of Klapmuts, he is of a stout make and middling size, between 30 and 40 years of age; was lately seen in Cape Town, and it is supposed that he hires himself out as an apprentice - Whoever will lodge the above boy in one of His Majesty's Prisons, or bring him to his Master, will receive the above reward.

name: Oranje
physical_description: swelling to one of his ears, curled hair, yellow complexion, stout make, about 5 feet and a half high, has a surley look
intentions: Hires himself as a Hottentot, Possibly in Kat River
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 18th May last, a Slave-boy of the Undersigned, named Oranje, he has the resemblance of a Bastard Hottentot, and a swelling to one of his ears. There exists no doubt that he is hiring himself out as a Hottentot _ Whoever lodges the said Boy in one of His Majesty's prisons, or return him to his Master, shall receive the above reward; and those detaining him will be prosecuted according to law. P. MARAIS. DRAKENSTEIN, August 2, 1831. {{{UPDATE 18340808 - 50 RDS REWARD - Deserted since 3 years... Drakenstein, July 29 1834. P. MARAIS.}}}

name: Joseph
physical_description: yellow complexion, about 5 feet 9 inches high, marks of punishment on his shoulders
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 25th July last, a Slave boy of the Undersigned, named JOSEPH, about 20 years of Age, he is of a yellow complexion, about 5 feet 9 inches high; has marks of punishment on his shoulders. Also, on the 30th March last, a Slave Girl, named DIENA, about 19 years of Age, rather yellow complexion, about 4 feet 5 inches: she has a wart on one of her cheeks. Any person lodging either of the above Slaves in one of His Majesty's Gaols, will be rewarded. ISAAK PRETORIUS, J. Ls. Graaf-Reniet, Aug 4 1831.

name: Diena
physical_description: yellow complexion, about 4 feet 5 inches, wart on one of her cheeks

name: Africa/Afrika
physical_description: dark yellow complexion
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED some time since, Africa, of the Cape, Slave of the Undersigned; he is of a dark yellow complexion, and has the resemblance of a Bastard Hottentot. Has formerly been the property of C. ESTERHUISEN, and had at the time of his absconding, leave to go to his wife at Mr. RETIEF'S, at Wagonmakers' Valley. Whoever brings him to the Undersigned, or lodges him in one of the Prisons, will receive the above Reward, and those harbouring him, will be prosecuted according to law. J. MECHAU, Sen. Bottelary, District of Stellenbosch, Aug 24, 1831.

name: Robert
physical_description: yellow colour, good figure, sharp eyes, long frizzled hair, cavity on one of his feet a little above his great toe, mark on one of his cheeks
clothing: Flushing Jacket, Leather Trousers
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED two months since, ROBERT, of the Cape, Slave of Mr KOTZE [J]at Blaauwberg, about 13 years of age, he is of a yellow colour, has a good figure, sharp eyes, and long frizzled hair; he may be known by a cavity on one of his feet a little above his great toe, and also by a mark on one of his cheeks. Was dressed when he left, in a Flushing Jacket and a pair of Leather Trousers. As he very much resembles a Bastard Hottentot, it is probable that he hires himself out as such. He has lastly been seen on the Cape Downs. Whoever brings him to the Undersigned, or lodges him in one of His Majesty's Prisons, will receive the above Reward, and those harbrouring him after this notice, will be prosecuted according to Law. A. BRINK, Cs, qq. Cape Town, Aug 20, 1831.

name: Floris
physical_description: marks of incisions on both cheeks, pearl on his right eye
full_text: ABSCONDED. A LONG time since, Floris, Slave of SCHALK WILLEM BURGER, Ws. Of the District of Clanwilliam, he is a Mozambique African, about 34 years of age; he has marks of incisions on both of his cheeks, a pearl on his right eye, and lisps. The said slave has declared himslf to have belonged to HENDRIK, as also to ANDRIES BURGEN, but now to be free. He was seen in the month of May or June last, on the road to Sneeuwbergen, at the Wagon of a certain Togtryder. All persons are humbly requested either to detain, or lodge the said Boy in any of His Majesty's Prisons.

name: Petro
physical_description: short stature, yellow complexion
full_text: ABSCONDED, about two months ago, a Slave Boy belonging to the Undersigned, named Petro, a shoemaker. He is of short stature, and yellow complexion. It is suspected that he hires himself out as a shoemaker at Wynberg. Whoever lodges the above Boy in one of His Majesty's prisons or brings him to the Undersigned, will be handsomely rewarded. The Widow WRENSCH. St. George's-street, No. 16.

name: Telemachus
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since two months, my Slave Boy, Telemachus, a Mason by trade. Any persons whom he might offer his service, is requested to detain him, and forward him to the Town Prison. C Mostert. Valkenberg October 6, 1831.

name: Sauel
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 1st instant, the Undersigned's Slave Boy, Sauel, formerly the property of HENDRIK ALBERTS. Whoever lodges him in one of His Majesty's Prisons, will receive the above reward, and those detaining him will be prosecuted according to Law. Cape Town, Oct 5, 1831. W. DILLMAN.

name: Willem
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 22d of September last, my Slave Boy, named Willem, formerly the property of the Widow JANSSENS; it is suspected that he conceals himself in the Cape Downs; any Person who will lodge the said Boy in one of His Majesty's Prisons, or bring him to the Undersigned, will receive the above Reward. No 37 Shortmarket-street. W.J. DE KOCK.

name: Aurora
physical_description: short of posture, middle finger of her right hand partly torn off
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Undersigned, about Six Weeks ago, the Slave Aurora, who was expected to be brought to bed within a fortnight after. She is rather short of posture, and resembles much a Hottentot woman; the middle finger of her right hand is partly torn off - She is said to have hired herself out at Papendorp as a Nurse - Whoever will lodge her in prison will be rewarded, and those detaining her will be prosecuted. J.H. NEETHLING, M so

name: Adam
physical_description: short figure, yellow complexion
full_text: ABSCONDED. A SLAVE Boy, named ADAM, born in this Colony, he is of a short figure and yellow complexion and has formerly belonged to Mr. ADRIAAN HERMANUS LOUW. Whoever lodges him in Prison, will be rewarded by the Owner. G.F. STEGMAN. Wale-street

name: Soebo
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE the 11th September last, the Undersigned's Slave Boy, Soebo; formerly belonging to M.C.A. HAUPT; whoever returns him to the Undersigned will be rewarded, and those harbouring him shall be prosecuted according to law. Weltevreden, Oct. 12, 1831. H.J HOFMEYER.

name: Dirk
physical_description: about six feet high, right foot bends outward, thick ancle, mark of a sore on his shoulder
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 17th instant, the undersigned's slave boy, DIRK. He is about six feet high, his right foot bends outward, and has a thick ancle, a mark of a sore on his shoulder, he is a complete Archetect, and is also able to work in Stone and Wood, and is about 27 years of age. Whoever returns the said Boy to the Undersigned, or lodges him in prison, will receive the above Reward. Drakenstein, Oct 24, 1831. S.W. BURGER.

name: Unnamed + small child
physical_description: yellow complexion, long hair, mark on her nose, thick finger, marks of punishment on her shoulder blades
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, a Slave Girl of the Undersigned, she is of a yellow complexion, has long hair, a mark on her nose, a thick finger, and marks of punishment on her shoulder blades, she has a small boy of 4 years old with her, who is also of a yellow complexion, and has frizzled hair. Whoever lodges her in one of the Prisons, will receive the above reward, and those harbouring her will be prosecuted according to Law. ANDRIES OLIVIER.

name: Joseph
physical_description: tall and stout, fair complexion
full_text: 100 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the Undersigned, two Slave Boys, one named Joseph, about 18 years of age, tall and stout, of fair complexion and rather deaf. The other named Willem, about 16 years of age, tall and fair complexion, having a white mark on one of his eyebrows, and curly hair - Whoever can give any information to lead to the apprehension of the said Slaves, or lodge them in one of the Prisons, will receive Rds. 50 for each of the. Widow J.H. Horak. 22 Strand street, Cape Town, Nov. 8 1831.

name: Willem
physical_description: tall, fair complexion, white mark on one of his eyebrows, curly hair

name: Albert
physical_description: 5 feet high, yellow complexion, curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the 12th of October last, the Slave Boy named Albert, of the Cape, 30 years of age, about 5 feet high, of a yellow complexion, curled hair and much resembling a Hottentot; he is a Smith by trade _ Any person lodging the said Boy in one of His Majesty's prisons, or bringing him to the Undersigned, will be handsomely rewarded. THOMAS ARNOLDUS DU PLESSIS. Behind Groenebergh, Nov. 3 1831.

name: November
physical_description: robust make, between 5 or 6 feet in height
clothing: red handkerchief, blue jacket, white pair of trowsers
full_text: ABSCONDED, Since the 17th of November last. The Undersigned's Slave Boy, November, of Mosambique, formerly the property of A WAHL and Dr. LIESCHING, Sen., being a Baker and Mason; he is of robust make and between 5 or 6 feet in height; was dressed with a red handkerchief, blue jacket and a white pair of trowsers; he has also taken with him a ladder of 10 feet long. Whoever lodges the said Boy in Prison, or brings him to the Undersigned will be handsomely rewarded. J.A. BAM, Long street. {1230 updated reward amount: 20 Rds}

name: Present
intentions: Hires himself as a Prize Negro
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, the Undersigned's Slave Boy, Present, of Mosambique, formerly the property of Mr. NELSON, it is very probable that he is hiring himself out as a Prize Negro. Whoever lodges him in one of the Prisons, will receive the above reward. J.N HAMAN, Sen.

name: Adonis
clothing: blue jacket, leather trousers, straw hat
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since Thursday, the 1st inst the Undersigned's Slave Boy, ADONIS; he was dressed in a blue jacket, leather trousers and a straw hat, and was formerly the property of Mr. PIETER JACOBUS MARAIS, Js. Of Vlaggeberg; it is supposed that he and his Free wife KATRYN, and three children, have hired themselves out in the District of Stellenbosch - Whoever...Law. J.A. Munnik.

name: Cupido
physical_description: mark on his chin, and on the right side of his face, a wound or hole under his left eye, black mark between his shoulders
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE Slave Cupido, the Property of P.C. DUWENAGE, residing at Wolvekop Field Cornetcy, Rhenosterberg, District of Graaf-Reinet. Said Slave has the resemblance of a Bastard Hottentot, has a mark on his chin, and on the right side of his face, has a wound or hole under his left eye, and a black mark between his shoulders. Whoever lodges him in one of His Majesty's prisons will receive 25 rds as a reward. J. G. BROEKHUISEN, Gen. Agent. Graaf-Reinet, Jan 12, 1832.

name: Apollos*
physical_description: tall and thin figure, brown colour, Roman nose, large eyes, thin beard under his chin, marked on his face with small black spots, scar on one arm (caused by the stabbing with a knife)
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ON the 24th January, 1832, the Slave APOLLOS, belonging to the Undersigned, was released out of the Prison in Cape Town, and absented himself again almost the same moment. Whoever lodges the said Boy in Prison will receive the above Reward and those harbouring him will be prosecuted according to Law. The said Apollos is a Carpenter by Trade, of a tall and thin figure, and a brown colour, has a Roman nose, large eyes and a thin beard under his chin, and resembles a Javanese. W. DE WET. Worcester, Feb 1 1832. [[[Update: 1833 12 27: ABSCONDED SINCE the month of Jan 1832, Apollos, native of this colony, formerly property of Rev Mr HESSE, Carpenter, tall and of slender stature - brown complexion, large eyes, long Roman nose, marked on his face with small black spots, one one of his arms is a scar, caused by the stabbing with a knife. Worcester Dec 17 1833. W. DE WET]]] {long period of Absconding}

name: Martha
physical_description: thin figure, 5 feet 2 inches high, brown eyes, large nose, small mark of a wound on her head
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 10th Oct last, the Undersigned's Slave Girl, named Martha; she is of a thin figure, 5 feet 2 inches high, has brown eyes, a large nose, a small mark of a wound on her head and has formerly been the property of JAN RUDOLF LOUW. Whoever lodges the said Girl in one of the Prisons or return her to the Undersigned, will receive the above Reward, and those harbouring her prosecuted according to Law. ARIE WILLEM PAULSE. Oner-Roggeveld, District Clanwilliam, Jan. 21 1832.

name: December
physical_description: brown colour and middle stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the Place Rocklands, near Simon's Town, since the 1st instant, a Slave Boy named December, belonging to the Undersigned of brown colour and middle stature. Whoever lodges him in one of the Prisons, will be rewarded and those harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted according to law. Feb 13 1832. A.J. BECKER.

name: Juliana
physical_description: stout figure, black color, curled hair, white spot on one of her eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE Undersigned's Slave Woman, Juliana, she is of stout figure, has a black color, curled hair, and a white spot on one of her eyes; it is supposed that she absconded in company of her husband, Piet Windvogel. Whoever lodges her in one of the Prisons, will be handsomely rewarded. Stellenbosch, Feb 21 1832. C.L. WYKERD.

name: Fortuin
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. THE Undersigned offers the above reward to any Person who will lodge his Slave Boy, named Fortuin, in one of the public prisons or bring him to the Undersigned. Rondebosch, Feb 1, 1832. C. MOSTERT.

name: Philis*
physical_description: short stature, large eyes, yellow complexion, spots on his face and chin
clothing: blue kersey jacket and waistcoat, basil trousers, black hat with narrow brim
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 11th Dec. last, a certain Slave Boy, called Philis, of short stature, large eyes, yellow complexion, spots on his face and chin, was dressed in a blue kersey jacket and waistcoat, basil trousers, and a black hat with narrow brim, by trade a tailor, calls himself also a musician, and a free person; said Slave has been the property of the late Mr. JAN MYBURG, at the sale of whose estate he was purchased by Mr. MOCKE, and is at present the property of the Undersigned. Whoever brings the said Slave to the Undersigned, or lodges him in one of the prisons, shall receive the above reward. F. J. BESTBIER. Zwartland, 13 March, 1832.

name: Frits*
physical_description: 5 feet high, slender made, light yellow complexion, part of the hair on the back of his head is grey, has a mark on one of his eyebrows
sightings: Du Toit's Kloof, working on wine farms
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 7th Feb. last, the Undersigned's Slave Frits, about 18 years of age. He stands 5 feet high, is slender made, of light yellow complexion, part of the hair on the back of his head is grey, and has a mark on one of his eyebrows. He left this place in company with a young Bushman named Vlak, of short size and narrow eyes. They have both been seen in Du Toit's Kloof, pretending to go to the Wine Farmers to help them in pressing, and Frits probably passes for a Bastard Hottentot. Whoever lodges him in prison, or returns him to the Undersigned, shall receive the above reward. Hex River, Worcester, March 6, 1832. PIETER MEIRING.

name: Frits (z)
physical_description: yellow color, curled hair, blind of one eye
clothing: drab trousers and jacket, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the 9th of January last, the Undersigned's Slave, Frits (z), about 45 years of age, of a yellow color, has curled hair, and is blind of one eye, very much resembles being a bastard Hottentot; he has formerly been the property of the Land Surveyor WARNICK, then of Mr. EKSTEEN, and lastly of Mr. RIGGARDSON; he has been seen in town or its vicinity. Whoever lodges the said Boy in one of the prisons will be handsomely rewarded and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. C.G. MARAIS. Jonkershoek, March 20 1832. [UPDATE 18340425 {sAME DROST PERIOD??} - volgens informatie houdt hy zich in de Stad dan wel aan de Campsbaai op - was gekleed in een vellen broek en baatje en had een palmieten hoed op]

name: Afrika (Africa)
physical_description: 5 feet high, stout make, mark on his left eye and on his neck
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. SINCE Two years the Slave Afrika (Africa, of Mosambique), belonging to the Estate of the late Albertus Laubser, Sr. has absented himself from his Master; he is about 5 feet high, and of a stout make, has a mark on his left eye and on his neck. Whoever lodges the said Boy in the Town Prison, or at Stellenbosch, will receive the above reward. G.H. MAASDORP.

name: UNNAMED
physical_description: one of his upper foreteeth is broken, wort on his under lip, mark above one of his eyes, very small mouth
clothing: green velvet jacket, leather trousers, white shirt
full_text: ABSCONDED. A LITTLE Boy of the Undersigned, about 12 years of age, he is of a slender make, and very much resembles a Hottentot, one of his upper foreteeth is broken; he has a wort on his under lip, and a mark above one of his eyes, and a very small mouth; was dressed in a green velvet jacket, leather trousers and white shirt. Was last seen in Cape Town. Whoever lodges him in prison or brings him to the Undersigned will be rewarded and those harbouring him prosecuted according to law. J.G. FRANK VAN REENEN. Mill Rheezicht, opposite the 3 milestone, 5th April 1832. {Paul - see ZA 123}

name: Izaak
physical_description: short stature, brown complexion, curled hair
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED, about Two Months ago, the Undersigned's Slave, Izaak, of this Colony, about 20 years old, is of a short stature, brown complexion, and curled hair. He represents himself to be a Bastard, and has been seen in Town. Whoever returns said Slave to the Place of the Undersigned, or lodges him in one of the Prisons, will be rewarded; whereas those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Koeberg, April 1, 1832. A.B.W. VAN NIEKERK.

name: Coridon
physical_description: quite black, somewhat lame
full_text: SLAVE ABSCONDED, EVER since the 13th March last, an African Slave Boy, about 20 years of age, named Coridon; he is quite black and somewhat lame. He was formerly the Property of M. DE KOCK, of Klapmuts, and now belongs to Lieutenant-Colonel Collette. Whoever lodges him in prison, or brings him to the U. will be rewarded and whoever harbours him will be prosecuted to the utmost rigour of the law. Witteboom, April 12, 1832. H.L. COLE.

name: Azor
physical_description: long thin stature, middle finger of right hand broken
clothing: duffle-jacket, leather trousers, white shirt
full_text: ABSCONDED, ABSCONDED since the 6th Feb last, the U's Slave Boy, Azor, of Mozambique, he is of a long thin stature, the middle finger of his right hand is broken; was dressed in a duffle-jacket, leather trousers, and white shirt, he was seen last at Breed River, near the Place of Mr. Paul de Villiers. Whoever lodges the above Boy in one of HM's Prisons, or brings him to the Place of the U, will be liberally rewarded. CAREL HAUPT, Sen. Great Drakenstein, April 10, 1832.

name: Galant**
physical_description: mark on his cheek caused by a kick of a horse, walks with his heels inwards, has a staggering way of walking, teeth are white and straggling
clothing: blue Jacket, white Linen Trousers, black Hat
intentions: Vicinity of Cape Town; later Rondebosch
sightings: Cape Town Market (seen going towards Rondebosch)
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 10th of March last, the Slave Galant, of Mozambique, belonging to the U.; he is Twenty-four years old and it is supposed he is in the neighbourhood of Cape Town, as his Parents and Family reside with Mr. P. REDELINGHUYS; he has a mark on his cheek caused by a kick of a horse. Whoever lodges him in one of the p will receive the above reward. Groeneberg, April 16, 1832. P.G. JOUBERT. [UPDATE 08 06: {20 RDS} Said Boy was seen on the 10th May last, going from the Market-place toward Rondebosch; and was then dressed in a blue Jacket, white Linen Trousers, black Hat; carrying on his shoulders, a bundle, and stating himself to reside thereabout; at the time he much resembled a Wood-boy (Houtjonge) or a Prize Negroe; he walks with his heels inwards, and has a staggering way of walking. His teeth are white and straggling - he has a mark under his left eye, occasioned by the kick of a horse - Groene Berg June 2 1832 P.G. JOUBERT]

name: Gabriel*
physical_description: light yellow color, with spots, about 5 feet 2 inches long, crooked legs, curled hair, small hands, thin fingers
other_description: soft voice, always in good humour
intentions: Rondebosch, as Bastard Hottentot named Gert Willemse
full_text: ABSCONDED. A FEW weeks since the U's Slave-boy Gabriel, of the Cape, about 22 years old, of a light yellow color, with spots, about 5 feet 2 inches long, and crooked legs. He has a soft voice, curled hair, small hands, and thin fingers, and he is always in good humour. It is supposed that he conceals himself in Rondebosch, representing himself as a Bastard Hottentot, under the name of Gert Willemse - Whoever lodges said boy in p will be rewarded, and those harbouring him prosecuted according to law. H.S. BOSMAN. Wagonmaker's Valley, April 18, 1832.

name: Rachel
physical_description: short stout make
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON SATURDAY last from the house of Mr. J. FRONEMAN, in whose service she was the Slave Rachel, belonging to Mr. P.J. DE NEEKER, of the District of Swellendam; she is 20 years of age, of short stout make, and very much resembles a bastard Hottentot-woman; it is supposed she is still wandering about this Town; every person is therefore requested not to harbour her on pain of prosecution but to lodge her in p. N.J. LOTZ.

name: Adonis
physical_description: slender make, pointed forehead
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, Two Months since, the U's African Slave-boy, named Adonis, 15 years of age. He is of slender make and has a pointed forehead. It is supposed that said Boy presents himself in one of the Country Districts as a Prize Negro. Whoever lodges him in prison will receive the above reward and those harbouring him prosecuted according to law. Cape Town, April 27, 1832. C.P. WOLHUTER.

name: Abraham
full_text: ABSCONDED, FOR the second time, my Boy Abraham, of the Cape, having very much the appearance of a Bastard Hottentot. On his first desertion he engaged himself to a farmer in the District of Stellenbosch. Whoever will place him in any of HM's P or bring him to Witteboom, will be handsomely rewarded. JACOB VAN OUDTSHOORN. [UPDATE JUNE 7 1833: Insolvent estate of JG Van Reenen Van Oudtshoorn, trustees JT Jurgens, JN Ley - 25 RDS REWARD OFFERED]

name: Jacob (aka Zwartland)
physical_description: thin stature, cast in his eye
clothing: new kersey jacket, lined with blue baixe, leather trousers, striped shirt, coloured handkerchief
items_taken: little brown gelding, English saddle and bridle, without neck-strap
full_text: On the 15th April last the U sent his little Slave Boy, named Jacob, commonly called Zwartland, aged 15 years, born in this colony, to look after a Mare which had strayed in the neighbourhood, and has not been seen since - He is of thin stature, resembles completely a Mozambique Boy, and has a cast in his eye, he was dressed in a new kersey jacket, lined with blue baixe, leather trousers, striped shirt, and a coloured handkerchief on his head; was mounted on a little brown gelding, an English saddle and bridle, without neck-strap - Those persons at whose place he might attire, or if they may discover him, are requested to lodge him in one of the prisons, but rather to send him to the U, who will defray any expenses that may be incurred. It may be necessary to mention that (he is?) known to be a sly fellow. JAN H. THEUNISSEN. Koeberg, May 5, 1832.

name: Adam
physical_description: about 5 feet, yellow colour, white spots on his face, bent nose
clothing: white moleskin jacket, fancy waistcoat, and leather trousers
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, from the U, the Slave Boy, named Adam, [naar gissing 30 jaren oud] about 5 feet, of a yellow colour, has some white spots on his face, and a bent nose; speaks good Dutch, and was dressed in a white moleskin jacket, fancy waistcoat, and leather trousers. Whoever lodges the above Boy in one of HM's Ps or brings him to the U will receive the above reward. J. KOTZE, Sen, Blaauwberg.

name: Arend
physical_description: middle size but strong stature, brown colour, curled hair, rather crooked legs
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE Monday, the 14th inst, an African Slave Boy, named Arend, belonging to the U; he is about 23 years of age, of a middle size but strong stature, brown colour, has curled hair, and rather crooked legs. Whoever lodges the said Boy in p will receive a reward of ten Rix-dollars, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted according to law. D. KUYS. Cape Town, May 16, 1832.

name: Caesar
full_text: REWARD. THE Slave, Caesar, belonging to the Estate of the late PIETER BENJAMIN WIESE, and surviving Widow, MARTHA JACOBA GOBRECHTS, having absconded - The Board of Orphan Masters, as administering the said Estate, do hereby offer a reward to any person who will give information atthis Office, as will lead to his apprehension. H. TENNANT, Sec. Orphan Chamber, Cape of good Hope, June 13 1832.

name: Eleas*
physical_description: long stature
clothing: dark jacket, a chentz waistcoat, white shirt, a pair of linen trousers, wearing a pair of short boots and a large white hat
intentions: Prize Negro; hires himself as Mason; former desertions employed in many areas; pseudonym Marthinus
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED From the U, on last Saturday, a Slave Boy, named Eleas, a Mosambique African, about 22 years of age, of long stature. He stammers a little, was dressed in a dark jacket, a chentz waistcoat, white shirt, a pair of linen trousers, wearing a pair of short boots and a large white hat, and having a skin blanket and some mason's tools with him. Said Slave represents himself as a Prise Negro, under the name of Marthinus and hires himself out as a mason. At the first time he absconded on the 15th August 1830, and had hired himself out to Barend Bredenkamp, place Berendal, to cut corn, then to Isac Metzelaar, Paarl, to Jan Simenie, to Stein Malerme, to Dr. Addy, at the Pont, to Daniel Rossouw, Houtbaai, to Jan Gous, and now during a hole year at Koopmansriver, under the Field-Cornetcy of Samual Walters. Whoever lodges the said Slave in one of HM's Ps will receive the above Reward, and those taken him into service or harbouring him, will be prosecuted according to Law. Constantia, 13th June. J.N. COLYN.

name: Moses Jonas
physical_description: brown colour and good appearance, mark on his nose, and the little finger of his right hand is stiff
intentions: Family in Koeberg, Wagonmakers V, Rivierzonderend
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED two months since, an African Slave Boy of the U's named Moses, and having the surname of Jonas, 15 years of age, of a brown colour and good appearance. His father and mother are slaves belonging to F.X. JURGENS, at Koeberg. [later corr: 1833 0215: Has also two brothers, the one belong to Mr. BENJAMIN LATEGAAN, of Wagonmaker's Valley and the other to Mr. WILLEM ROUX, of Rivier Zonder End] He was bought by the U at the sale of Mr. H. VAN NIEKERK, of Blaauwe Bloemtjes Kloof, has a mark on his nose, and the little finger of his right hand is stiff. Whoever lodges the said Boy in P will receive the above Reward, and those harbouring him, prosecuted according to Law. Rooseboom, June 12, 1832. W.H. THEUNISSEN.

name: Spadille
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. RAN away, a few Months ago, SPADILLE, of Mozambique, Slave belonging to the Insolvent estate of the Widow of the late Michael Jan Smuts. The above Reward will be given to any Person who shall lodge the said Person in Gaol - Persons harbouring him will be prosecuted. G.H. MAASDORP/ F. GODF. WATERMEYER/ E.A. BUYSKES - Joint Trustees.

name: Jephta
physical_description: short and stout
clothing: blue cloth trousers, striped waistcoat and white shirt, and a new black silk hat
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. DESERTED on the 13th inst., from the service of Mr. DICKINSON, slave named Jephta, about 17 years of age, short and stout in person, being dressed when he left home in blue cloth trousers, striped waistcoat and white shirt, and a new black silk hat; it is presumed he states himself to be a prize negro - The above reward will be paid by Mr Dickinson to any person who shall cause the above described Slave to be apprehended and lodged in p. Stellenbosch, June 26, 1832.

name: Willem
physical_description: good figure, brown complexion
clothing: dressed in blue, black hat, shoes
intentions: Pretends to be free; Hires himself
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. DESERTED, about 4 months since the Slave Boy of the U, named Willem, about 24 years of age, he has a good figure, and is of a brown complexion; was dressed when he left, in blue, had a black hat on, wore shoes. It is known that he generally hires himself out, stating to be free. the public are therefore cautioned not to take the above described into service, while the above reward is offered to any person who shall lodge him in P. Cape Town, June 29, 1832. P.A. Brand.

name: Jason
physical_description: middle size, strongly built
intentions: Formerly apprehended at Zwartland; Former service in Constantia
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. THE Slave Boy Jason, about 30 years of age, by birth an Africaner Mosambique, of a middle size and strongly built, has again absconded about the middle of last month, having been only a few days before apprehended by Mr van der Spuy, at Zwartland. He formerly belonged to Mrs Colyn, of Constantia; is generally in company of his Hottentot wife named Lys, and is seldom without a Hottentot violen, on which he plays pretty well. Whoever lodges him in Prison or brings hi to the U, shall receive the above Reward. Elseriver, near Simon's Town, May 24, 1832. W.R. OSMOND.

name: Onverwagt
full_text: SLAVES ABSCONDED. TWO Slave Boys, one a Mosambique named Onverwagt, about 30 years of age, and the other an Africaner Mosambique, named Coridon [_84], 21 years, and slight lame. They formerly belonged to Mr De Kock, of Klapmuts, and now to Lt_Col. COLLETTE - Whoever will lodge them in P or bring them to the U shall be rewarded. Witteboomen near Wynberg, July 12 1832. H.L. COLE.

name: Goliath
physical_description: about 5 feet 7 3/4 inches high, black curly hair, dark brown face, flat nose, stout proportion, marks of punishment with the cat {whip} on his back, the print o, his foot very broad
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 1st of May, Goliath, Slave of the U, about 5 feet 7 3/4 inches high, black curly hair, dark brown face, flat nose, stout proportion, has marks of punishment with the cat {whip} on his back, the print o; his foot very broad; was last seen in the District of Worcester and it is supposed he hires himself out as a Bastard. Whoever will apprehend him, will receive the above reward. P.H. DE VILLIERS. Silvermyn, July 26, 1832.

name: Maart
physical_description: common stature, long curled hair, red eyes
clothing: new kersey jacket, basil trousers, linnen short {shirt?}, new drab hat
items_taken: small iron pot [ketel], silver coin in pieces and shillings
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 20th of this month my African Slave Boy, Maart, 30 years of age, of a common stature, having long curled hair and red eyes, being somewhat like a Bastard, and dressed in a new kersey jacket, basil trousers and linnen short {shirt?}, and a new drab hat on, he took with him a small iron pot [ketel] and some silver coin in pieces and shillings, and has in his company a small Hottentot Boy, named Adam, about 7 years old, he formerly belonged to Mr. H.C. VAN NIEKERK, Blaauwbloemetjeskloof, and was bought by me 1 and a half year ago from Mr. P. AURET, in Cape Town - Whoever lodges him in p or returns him to the U will be handsomely rewarded. JAN H. THEUNISSEN. Koeberg, July 26, 1832.

name: Abraham
full_text: ABDSCONDED, SINCE the 3d June last, the U's well-known [kledermakers] Slave Boy, Abraham, of the Cape, a Tailor he is 30 years of age, and represents himself certainly as a free person. Any person finding the Boy is requested to lodge him in P, while those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Cape Town, July 25, 1832. C.P. WOLHUTER.

name: Francies
physical_description: walks lame
full_text: ABSCONDED. FROM the U, the Slave named Francies, of Mosambique, about 42 years of age, walks lame, and belonged formerly to Mr MICHIEL COETZEEE, Gs., of the Cape Downs, as he is informed that he detains himself in the Cape Downs: any one lodging the above-named Slave, in one of HM's Ps, shall be rewarded. J.J. KOTZE.

name: David
clothing: blue jacket, skin trousers and a ditto overjacket
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the U, his African Slave Boy David, with two baskets greens; he was dressed in a blue jacket, skin trousers and a ditto overjacket, it is supposed that he detains himself at Koeberg - Whoever lodges said boy in P will receive the above rew and those harb him be prosecuted according to Law. W.A VAN SCHOOR.

name: Arend
physical_description: white and of a short and stout figure, has high shoulders and walks rather stiff
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the U, two Slaves. Frits (#_79)…… and Arend, father of Frits, since the month of April last; Arend is white and of a short and stout figure, has high shoulders and walks rather stiff. Both have formerly been the property of Mr FRANS ROOS, Js. of Stellenbosch. .... Worcester, July 19, 1832. PIETER MEIRING.

name: Gezwind
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. THE Slave, Gezwind, born in this Colony, about 25 years old, belonging to the Insolvent estate of Mr. JAN DANIEL CILLIERS. C. Son. Of Swagershoek, District of Somerset, having absented himself from the Service of his Master during the last three years, the above Rew. is offered to any one who will lodge him in any of the ps, and give information to Mr. C MOLLER, Esq, at Somerset, or to the U, No. 2, Church-square. Those harb... Cape Town, August 2, 1832. E.A. BUYSKES, Sole Trustee.

name: George
physical_description: slender make
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since April 10 last, the U's Slave Boy named George, about 19 years old. He is of slender make, resembles much a Bastard Hottentot, and it is suspected he hires himself out as such. Whoever…prosecuted. C.G. MARAIS. Jonkershoek, near Stellenbosch, Aug 6, 1832.

name: Anthony
physical_description: common stature and having a stiff leg
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the U's corn farm, situate at Paardeberg, his Slave Boy Anthony, of Mozambique, of common stature and having a stiff leg. Whoever lodges….prosecuted. J.A. BEYERS. Klapmuts, Aug 21, 1832.

name: Africa
physical_description: black complexion, short stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, TWO Months since, the U's African Slaveboy, Africa. He is of black complexion, short stature, and about 40 years of age and has formerly belonged to the Widow Nelson. Whoever… Law. D.G. EKSTEEN. Kerstenbosch, Rondebosch, Aug 25 1832.

name: Harlequine
physical_description: small stature, and aged; his upper teeth out
clothing: blue duffle jacket lined with baixe, basil trousers, coarse linen shirt, and straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE the 14th July, Harlequine, of Mozambique, of small stature, and aged; his upper teeth out, was dressed in a blue duffle jacket lined with baixe, basil trousers, coarse linen shirt, and straw hat. Understands Mozambique art of Medicine, and it is supposed he hires himself out as a free person - Anyone confining....prosecuted.

name: Spatie
physical_description: yellow colour, spot on her upper lip, flat nose
full_text: ABSCONDED 3 OR 4 MONTHS since, a young African female Slave, named Spatie; she is of a yellow colour, has a spot on her upper lip, and a flat nose. It is supposed that she conceals herself at her father's, Onco, at Hottentots Holland's Strand. Whoever…Law. J. VAN REENEN. Green Point, September 18, 1832.

name: Adriaan
physical_description: yellow colour, short stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 4th of the Present month, my Slave Adriaan, born in this Colony, 30 years of age, of a yellow colour, and a short stature, and having with him a short bastard Bushman Woman, with a mark underneath her eye. Whoever lodges…law. Stellenbosch, September 25, 1832. J.F. MALAN.

name: Damon
physical_description: disease on the great toe of his right foot
clothing: duffle jacket, skin trousers, and striped shirt
full_text: ABSCONDED _Since the 28th September last, the Undersigned’s Slave DAMON, about 50 years old, having a disease on the great toe of his right foot; was dressed in a duffle jacket, skin trousers, and striped shirt. Any one lodging the said Boy in prison, or bringing him to the Undersigned, will be Rewarded, and those harbouring him, prosecuted according to Law. Moddergat, District Stellenbosch, Oct 4 1832. CW LIEBETRAU. [_114A]

name: Cornelis
physical_description: yellow complexion, long hair, appears rather small for his age, two marks on his leg
clothing: skin trousers and a duffle jacket
full_text: 25 RDS. REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 5th of May 1832, a Slave Boy named CORNELIS, of a yellow complexion, and having long hair; he was dressed in a pair of skin trousers and a duffle jacket, and is about 16 years of age, but appears rather small for his age; he has also two marks on his leg, occasioned by the bite of a dog – Whoever returns the said Boy to the Undersigned, will receive the above reward. PH Swart. [_114B]

name: Daantje*
physical_description: white color, black hair, good figure, 5 1/2 feet in height
clothing: blue jacket, black trousers, waistcoat, black hat, around which a piece of black crape on it, shoes
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 24th September last, the U's Slave Boy, Daantje, of the Cape, formerly the Property of Mr. ANDRIES TEUBES, he is of a white color, has black hair, and a good figure, being 5 1/2 feet in height, he was dressed in a blue jacket, black trousers and waistcoat, a black hat, around which a piece of black crape on it, and shoes. At the time of his departure from the Place Nooitgedacht, he was mounted on a saddled light brown mare, with a white spot on the forehead, and white hind legs; he has been seen on the 26th September last, on the Greenmarket, in Cape Town, and afterwards on the Races. Whoever lodges him in P... Law. Nooitgedacht, October 9, 1832. D. CLOETE, Senior.

name: Jacob*
full_text: JACOB, by Trade a Mason, Slave of the U, formerly the Property of the Widow Steyn, has absented himself since the last of August. Whoever lodges the said Boy (who is well known in the Town) in P will be rewarded. He worked last, is it said, at Mr Fairclough's Place, Rondebosch. J.J.L SMUTS.

name: Soul [Saul?]
physical_description: yellow color, fine curled hair, back of his head is bald, left-handed
clothing: nightcap
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the month of May last, the U's Slave Soul, he formerly belonged to Mr. J. RABE, and lastly to P.B. KEYTER of Cango, District of George, and bought by the U from said Keyter, during the time of his absconding. He is of a yellow color, has fine curled hair, and the back of his head is bald; he usually wore a nightcap and is left handed. Deep River, District Swellendam. A.P. KEYTER.

name: Esau
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the 1st inst., the Slave Esau, formerly the Property of Mr Pentz. A reward will be given for his apprehension, and any persons harboring….prosecuted. DEANE & JOHNSON, Shortmarket-street

name: Abraham
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 23d Sept, the U's well-known Slave Boy Abraham, Tailor. He was seen in Town on Sunday last and no doubt presents himself as a free person - It is requested…law. Cape Town, Oct 25, 1832. C.P. WOLHUTER.

name: Damon
physical_description: short stature
intentions: Former service in Rivier zonder einde
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the Month of February, 1831, my Slave Boy, named Damon, of Malebar, between 50 and 60 years old. He formerly belonged to Mr. WESSEL PRETORIUS, of River Zonder einde. He is of a short stature. He was last seen at the place just mentioned - Whoever lodges him in one of the Ps will receive 25 Rds Reward, and any person bringing him to teh U, the above stated Reward. Koeberg. R. CLOETE.

name: Abraham
physical_description: short stature, flat nose
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since Sunday last, the U's Slave Boy, Abraham. He is of a short stature, has a flat nose, and very much resembling a Bastard Hottentot, which he represents himself to be. He has been employed at the Town carts - whoever returns him will receive the above reward. A. CARSTENS.

name: Manes
physical_description: black complexion, frizzled hair
clothing: duffle jacket, leather trousers
intentions: Says he is looking for cattle
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] GEDROST, voor drie weken geleden, een Slavenjongentje, genaamd Manes, vyftien {15} jaren oud, zwart in zyn wezen, kroes haar {black complexion, frizzled hair}; met en duffelsche Baatje, en ledere Broek {duffle jacket, leather trousers}, hy geest voor naar beesten te zoeken; die hem in een der Gevangenissen of op myne Plaats besorgt, zal eene beloning van 10 rds genieten, en die hem ophoudt wachte zich voor schade. JACOB EKSTEEN, Jz. Boter Rivier Valey, District Paardeberg, Den 6 Nov 1832.

name: Paul
physical_description: two marks above right eye, small piece of one of his foreteeth broken off, slender make
clothing: white shirt, skin trousers, kersey jacket, red cap
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, three weeks ago, my little Slave-boy, Paul of about 12 years old. He was dressed in a white shirt, skin trousers, and kersey jacket, and had a red cap on his head. He has two marks above his right eye, and a small piece of one of his foreteeth is broken off. He is of slender make and much resembles a Bastard Hottentot, as which he has already represented himself - At the time of his last absconding he harboured himself at the Place of Colonel Collett - Whoever....prosecuted. J.G. FRANK VAN REENEN. Mill Rheezight.

name: Adonis
physical_description: short figure, black colour, flat nose, mark on his face, walks rather lame
intentions: Hires himself, as a dam rat?
full_text: 15 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since 14 days, my Slave ADONIS, about 25 years old, he is of short figure, black colour, has a flat nose and a mark in his face, he walks rather lame, speaks good Dutch, and very much resembles a "Dam rat", as which he has already hired himself out thrice; whoever....reward. J.J. KOTZE, Senior. Blaauweberg, 16th Nov 1832.

name: Galant
physical_description: brown complexion, beautiful white teeth
clothing: kersey jacket, skin trousers, black hat
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED eight days ago, my Slave boy, Galant, about 15 years old, he is of brown complexion, has a friendly appearance and beautiful white teeth and very much resembles a Bastard Hottentot. He was dressed in a kersey jacket, skin trousers, and had a black Hat on his head. Whoever....prosecuted. J.J. KOTZE, Sen. Blaauweberg.

name: Andries
physical_description: crooked legs
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U since the 1st January, his Slave Boy, Andries, having crooked legs. He was last seen at the Paarl. Whoever lodges…rewarded. W. BOTHA.

name: Adam (van de Kaap)
physical_description: brown complexion, 5 1/2 feet tall, long curly hair, hollow eyes, thick lips, small beard under his nose
clothing: drab hat, grey jacket with red lining, white shirt, white trousers
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] GEDROST op den 8 Jan. van den Ondergeteekenden met zyn terugkomst van de Kaapstad onder de Hottentotsch Hollands Kloof, de Slaven jongen gen,. Adam van de Kaap, oud 23 jaren, bruin van kleur, groot 5 1/2 voet, dik gekroest haar, holle oogen, een dikke lip en een kleine baart onder zyne neus om de kin hebbende {brown complexion, 5 1/2 feet tall, long curly hair, hollow eyes, thick lips, small beard under his nose}. Hy gelykt veel naar een bastaard Hottentot, en was gekleerd in een oude vale hoed, een grys boven baatje met roode voering, wit hembd, witte broek {drab hat, grey jacket with red lining, white shirt, white trousers}, en heest een velle kombaars {skin blanket} by zich. Die hem aan den O of in des Heeren Gevangenhuis bezorgt, zal bovenstaande belooning ontvangen. J.C. LINDE, J zoon.

name: Adam
full_text: [DUTCH - ENG FADED] GEDROST. SEDERT Il Zaturdag den 12 dezer, des O's Slavenjongen, genaamd Adam, van de Kaap, voormaals toebehoord hebbende aan Heer A.H. LOUW - Die hem in gevangenhuis bezorgt, sal beloond worden. 17 January 1833. G.F. STEGMANN.

name: Modin
physical_description: tall and slender, yellow complexion
clothing: drab, duffle, or grey kersey jacket, and wears a TOEDOE
intentions: Rondebosch on previous desertion; passes himself as a free Malay
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, the Slave MODIN [MADIN], by trade a Tailor. After last New Year he worked at Mr. LETTERSTEDT'S Rondebosch. He is tall and slender, of yellow complexion and cohabits with a Bastard Woman, and probably passes himself as a free Malay. He was dressed in a drab, duffle, or grey kersey jacket, and wears a TOEDOE on his head. Whoever lodges....prosecuted. Cape Town 22d january 1833. J HABLUTZEL.

name: Jacob
physical_description: stout figure, yellow color, long hair, three blue marks on his forehead, blue spots on his cheeks and on his right ankle a thick callousness
intentions: Koeberg on previous; Hires himself as a bastard, named Hendrik
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, the U's Slave Jacob, he is of stout figure, yellow color, has long hair, and three blue marks on his forehead, and some blue spots on his cheeks and on his right ankle a thick callousness. He hired himself out at Koeberg as a Bastard Hottentot, with the name Hendrik. Whoever...reward. C.F. BEYERS. Hopenburg Jan 22 1833.

name: Apollos
full_text: [POOR COPY ENG + DUTCH] 40 RDS REWARD. RAN away the Boy Apollos, formerly belonging to Mr. LOW, the shipwright, and servant to Mr. DASHWOOD, supposed to be in or near Stellenbosch. Whoever….{} [later update 0222 - left his master about 1 January - 50 RDS will be given to anyone that leads to the punishment of any person harbouring him]

name: Maart
physical_description: common figure, red eyes, long curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the 6th January last, the U's Slave Boy, Maart, of this Colony; he is of a common figure, has red eyes, and long curled hair, and is 35 years old.Whoever…Law. J.H.THEUNISSEN. Koeberg, Jan 25 1833.

name: Arend
physical_description: short stature, rather stout, yellowish complexion, curly hair, large whiskers, left eye much discolored and swollen from a recent blow
clothing: dark Kersey Jacket, Leathern Trousers, white unbleached shirt, Field Shoes, Palmiet Hat
full_text: NOTICE. WHEREAS Carel, Slave of Mr. HENDRIK DE NECKER, of Pampoenekraal, was atrociously murdered on the Public Road near that Place, on the Morning of Sunday last, and circumstances of strong suspicion having arisen against one Arend, Slave of Mr GERHARDUS SCHOLTZ, of Paardeberg, who has since absconded - the following description is given with a view of his apprehension: - He is of a short stature, is rather stout; has a yellowish complexion with curly hair, and large whiskers, and his left eye, when last seen (Sunday), was much discolored and swollen, from a recent blow. He was dressed in a dark Kersey Jacket, Leathern Trousers, a white unbleached shirt, Field Shoes, and a Palmiet Hat - He is about 30 years old. Clerk of the Peace Office, Cape Town, Jan 29 1833. DANIEL J CLOETE.

name: Salea
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. SALEA, Slave of the U, has absented herself with two children, for about one month since. Whoever lodges the girl (who is well known in Town)…according to law. M. VAN BREDA. As. Jan 21 1833. Garden Zorgvliet.

name: Albert
physical_description: mark on his left leg
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 8th jan 1833, a Slave Boy, named Albert, belonging to Mr. T.A. DU PLESSIE, of Groeneberg, in the District of Stellenbosch; very much resembling a bastard Hottentot, having a mark on his left leg, and being a Smith by trade. He is accompanied by his Wife, Griet, who is of a tall and slender make, and by her son, Keester, of about 13 or 14 years old, whose left leg is lame. _ Whoever....prosecuted. S.H. DE KOCK. qq. Cape Town, Jan 31 1831?

name: John
physical_description: blackish color, middle size, mark on his forehead
full_text: ABSCONDED since the Month of September last, the U's Slave Boy named John, of this Colony, he is of a blackish color, of a middle size, and has a mark on his forehead; he harbours himself in Cape Town and has a couple days past been seen in Hottentots square driving a cart with two horses. Whoever ...prosecuted. M.M. BASSON. Zwaartland, Jan 31, 1833.

name: Abraham
full_text: [THREEPEAT] ABSCONDED, SINCE the 2d December last, my Slave Boy, Abraham, of the Cape, Tailor. He has been seen in Town on Sunday and Monday last, and represents himself as a free black - Whoever… to law. C.P. WOLHUTER. Cape Town, Feb 6, 1833. [new ad May 10: 10 rds reward is offered to any person who can point out where my Tailor's Boy, ABRAHAM, is harbouring himself. Same to anyone lodging in prison. CP Wolhuter]

name: David
physical_description: short stature, yellow color
clothing: kersey and skin jacket, skin trousers
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD FOR EACH SLAVE. ABSCONDED since the 18th December, 1832, the Slaves David and Abraham, both born in this Colony. David is about 19 years of short stature, a yellow color, and resembles a Hottentot. He was dressed in a kersey and skin jacket and skin trousers. Abraham is 17 years of age, of a white color and stout make, has light blue eyes, and has had a hole in his left ear, of which mark is still visible. Whoever...Law. BARD. JAC. ERASMUS. Ls. Caledon, Feb 14, 1833.

name: Abraham
physical_description: white color, stout make, light blue eyes, hole in his left ear

name: Martinus
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY - there is an Eng one, but short and same] 10 RDS BELOONING. GEDROST, myn Slavenjongen, genaamd MARTINUS, voormaals het Eigendom van den heer J. HOETS, die hem in eine gevangenissen…vervolgd. C. MOSTERT. Den 20 Feb 1833.

name: Africa
physical_description: black colour, middle size, round face
clothing: blue kersey jacket, leather trowsers, palmiet hat
skill_occupation: Farm worker, works with horses and oxen
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. THE U hereby informs the several Field-Cornets and their inhabitants, that his Slave Boy Africa has absconded since the 2d January 1833, he is a Mozambique African of 20 years old, of black colour and middle size and has a round face - he was dressed in a blue kersey jacket, leather trowsers, and wears a hat made of palmiet; he is very handy in working with horses and oxen and understands all kinds of Farmers work and it is supposed he hires himself as a Prize Negro, the several Field-Cornets are kindly requested to make this advertisment as public as possible in their different wards. As those...law. J.S. HAUMAN. Franschhoek, Feb 21, 1833.

name: Siena
clothing: red {?} with brown bobben
full_text: ABSCONDED, from Wynberg, on Sunday afternoon, the 24th feb. last, a slave girl named Siena, very much resembling a Hottentot Woman; she was dressed in a red {?} with brown bobben. Whoever returns her to the Owner, No 81 Long Street, will be rewarded. Cape Town, March 8 1833.

name: Titus
physical_description: stout make, brown color, thick lips, long beard
clothing: kersey jacket, white shirt, brown Cape Hat
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the month of February last, the U's Slave Boy, named Titus, born in this Colony, he is of a stout make, brown color, has thick lips, and usually wares a long beard as a Malay Priest; he was dressed in a kersey jacket, white shirt, and had a brown Cape Hat on. It is said that he has been seduced by a Hottentot woman named Mietje, who left the U's place a few days before, she is of a light yellow colour and has a fine little brown dog with her. Both persons have, as it is supposed, proceeded to the interior, as they have been seen in the vicinity of Tulbagh. Whoever lodges said boy....law. Those apprehending him ought to be on their guard as he knows most quickly how to loosen himself. Tygerberg March 61833. A.J. MEYBERG. - An immediate notice of his apprehension is requested.

name: Frits
