physical_description: 5 feet high, yellow colour, black eyes, large black whiskers, forepart of the {?} finger of the left hand is crooked
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED on the 12th instant, my Slave boy Frits, he is 5 feet high, of a yellow colour, has black eyes and wears a large black whiskers, the forepart of the {?} finger of the left hand is crooked; he represents himself as a free man, and is a mason by trade. It is supposed that he is harboured either in Cape Town or Stellenbosch. Whoever... law. A.J. LOUW. Koeberg March 22 1833.

name: David
physical_description: about 5 feet high, mark on his forehead and on his chin
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the beginning of the Month of January last, the U's Slave Boy, David, of Mosambique, about 5 feet high, he has a mark on his forehead and on his chin; has lastly been seen at the paarl and hired himself, it is supposed, to a "Togt" Wagon; Whoever...Law. A.J. BESTER. Rietvaley.

name: Phoebus
physical_description: yellow colour and slender make
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 8th Feb, last, two Slave Boys of the U, the one named Phoebus, born in this Colony, is of a yellow color and slender make, and between 18 and 19 years old; and the other named Jamodien, and representing himself to have the name of Jan, is of a short and stout make and yellow color, and also born in this Colony, being about 23 years old; they have been seen on the road to Cape Town and are now, as it is supposed, harbouring themselves there, as their mothers are residing there. Any one lodging the said Boys in prison will be rewarded, on application to Mr. M HEYNEMAN, No 118 Loopstreet, while those harbouring them will be prosecuted. H.O. ACKER. N. ACKER. Mossel Bay, District George, 8th April 1833.

name: Jamodien
physical_description: short and stout make, yellow colour

name: Adam
physical_description: short stature, brown colour, some marks from a punishment he received in one of the prisons on his back
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the Lange Kloof, District George, in the month of February last, the Slave Adam, with his wife and daughter, all belonging to Mr. JH Van Rensburg. The said Boy is of a short stature, brown colour, and has some marks, from a punishment he received in one of the prisons on his back. His wife, Spatie, is of a stout make, has thick lips, curled hair, a stern countenance, and some marks on her ancles. Their daughter, named Diena, 15 years old, is also of a brown colour, and has a healthy complexion - Whoever...prosecuted. N.J. LOTZ. qq. Cape Town, April 25, 1833.

name: Spatie
physical_description: stout make, thick lips, curled hair, stern countenance, marks on her ankles

name: Diena
physical_description: brown colour, healthy complexion

name: Lendor
physical_description: stout make, bald crown
full_text: ABSCONDED EIGHT days since the U's Slave Boy, named Lendor, of Mozambique; he is of a stout make, has a bald crown, and is probably accompanied by a female Hottentot named Lys. He has with him a Mozambique musical instrument, being a bow of 4 feet long, spunned with a string, and it is supposed that he represents himself as a Prize Negro. Whoever...prosecuted. J.H. BLANKENBURG. Welbevond, April 22, 1833.

name: George
physical_description: middling size, slender make, yellow color, curled hair
clothing: striped trousers, jacket, white cap
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD, ABSCONDED, ON the 16th April, the U's Slave Boy George, of this Colony, he is 18 years old, of a middling size, slender make, and yellow color, and has curled hair; he had on a pair of striped trousers, a jacket, and a white cap; it is supposed that he has proceeded to Overbergen, at which place he has been apprehended at the time of his last desertion, being about 6 months ago. Whoever...prosecuted. Jonkershoek, near Stellenbosch. C.G. MARAIS.

name: Isaak
physical_description: short stature, thick lips
clothing: skin jacket, trousers, blue cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE U's Slave Boy, Isaak, being a Mosambique Africaander; he is of a short stature and has thick lips and was dressed in a skin jacket and pair of Trowsers, and had a blue cap on; whoever…will receive 10 Rds reward. W.A. VAN SCHOOR.

name: Jacob
physical_description: brown color, curled hair
clothing: kersey jacket, skin trousers, drab color hat
intentions: Klapmuts previous desertion; hires himself as a free person
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. THE U requests all persons and especially those in the Country Districts, to pay due attention to a Slave Boy, named Jacob, in case he might offer his services as a free person under another name, he having already hired himself as such to Mr P. CLOETE, of Klapmuts; the said slave, who is 20 years of age, has again absconded since the races; he is of a brown color, has curled hair, and was dressed in a kersey jacket, skin trowsers and a drab color hat. Whoever brings him to the U, in Cape Town, will receive 10 Rds reward above the usual costs of apprehension. H.O. Eksteen.

name: Abraham
physical_description: about 5 feet high, slender make, yellow colour
intentions: Cape Town family; Hires himself as a free person
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 14th Feb, my Slave Boy, Abraham, about 5 feet high, of a slender make, yellow colour; his parents are residing in Cape Town in a Lower Store of Mr. J.H. NEETHLING'S, St. Georges street. He has lastly been seen in the vicinity of Wynberg and presents himself as a Free person. Whoever...Reward. Paardeberg May 1 1833. F.X. JURGENS.

name: Rita
physical_description: mark on one of her hands
clothing: black Chintx Petticoat, black Handkerchief
intentions: Hires herself as a free person
full_text: ABSCONDED ON Sunday the 28th April, the U's Slave Girl, Rita, a Mozambique African, 24 years of age. She was dressed in a black Chintx Petticoat, and had a black Handkerchief round her head. She has a mark on one of her hands and has, it is supposed, hired herself out as a free Girl. C.P. WOLHUTER.

name: Spasie
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 12th of April last the Slave Girl, Spasie. She formerly belonged to Mr. JJL SMUTS. Whoever….prosecuted. R.J. LOEDOLFF. May 9 1833.

name: Fortuin
physical_description: short stature
intentions: Cape Town/ Camps Bay; Hires himself
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED on the 29th April last, the U's Slave Boy, named Fortuin, born in this Colony; he is of short stature, and very much resembles a Malabar: it is supposed he hires himself in Town or Camps Bay. C. MOSTERT, Se. May 8 1833.

name: Galant
physical_description: yellow color, curled hair, large mouth, large teeth, two black spots on his left cheek, on his forehead 2 cuts, black mark about one inch on the left side of his body
full_text: ADVERTISEMENT: ABSCONDED from the U, the Slave Boy named Galant, about 20 years old, yellow color, curled hair, large mouth, and large teeth; has two black spots on his left cheek, on his forhead 2 cuts, and a black mark about one inch on the left side of his body. Whoever...prosecuted. W.F. BEZUIDENHOUT.

name: Mei
physical_description: short and stout make, thick hands and feet
sightings: Often seen at the Washing House (Where?)
full_text: ABSCONDED THE U's Slave, Mei, of Mozambique, 42 years old, having formerly belonged to Mr R CLOETE; said Slave is of a short and stout make, has thick hands and feet, and is often seen at the Washing-house. Whoever… 5 rds as a reward. L.M. GREEFF. Roode Pan, District of Groenekloof, May 20 1832.

name: Fortuin
physical_description: long and stout make, walks rather lame with his right leg
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 1st of December 1832, the U's slave boy Fortuin, of Mozambique, of a long and stout make; he walks rather lame with his right leg; and is supposed he represents himself as a Prize Negro. Whoever…consequences. Klapmuts, April 15, 1833. GJ JOUBERT.

name: Joseph
physical_description: yellow complexion, thin face, and small figure
full_text: ABSCONDED, A slave named Joseph, belonging to the U, a Cooper by trade, yellow complexion thin face, and small figure. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. JJ MARAIS. Waterfal groot Drakenstein.

name: Mentor
physical_description: yellow color, round face, little finger of one of his hands is stiff, common size, thin and weak about hands and legs
full_text: 20 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, four months since, two slave boys of the U; the one named Mentor, is an African [heest voel van een Madagascar], of yellow color, round face, and the little finger of one of his hands is stiff; the other is named Afrika, of Mosambique, they are both of common size, and thin and weak about their hands and legs - Whoever....prosecuted. J.P. CLOETE. Constantia, June 4, 1833.

name: Afrika
physical_description: common size, thin and weak about hands and legs

name: Telemachus
clothing: blue jacket with black velvet collar, white trousers
full_text: 10 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, my slave boy, Telemachus, (lately the Property of Mr J Van Schoor). He was dressed in a blue jacket, with black velvet collar, and white trousers. Whoever…Law. D. PALLAS. Cape Town, June 20 1833.

name: Coridon
physical_description: short stature, stout and thick set, walks somewhat lame
intentions: Former service in Klapmuts; passes as a Hottentot belonging to a mission station
full_text: 50 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, since 16 November last, Coridon, slave of Lt Col Collette; he is an Africaner Mosambique, greatly resembling a Hottentot, about 28 years of age, short stature, but stout and thick set. In consequence of having some time since broken his left leg, he walks somewhat lame. Formerly belonged to Mr. M De Kock, of Klapmuts and it is supposed he now passes himself for a Hottentot belonging to one of the Missionary Institutions. Whoever....Reward. H.L. COLE. Witteboomen May 23 1833.

name: Siena
clothing: voorschitz gown with short sleeves
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 18th inst, a slave girl, named Siena, very much resembling a bastard Hottentot; she was dressed in a voorschitz gown, with short sleeves. Whoever returns her to her owner in Long street, No 81, will be rewarded. Cape Town, June 21, 1883.

name: Pieter
physical_description: short stature, yellow colour
full_text: ABSCONDED, MY little slave boy, named Pieter, about 15 years old, of short stature, and yellow color. Whoever lodge…prosecuted. JHG SCHRIKKER.

name: Schiebieon
physical_description: short stature,marks above the ancles on one of his legs, thin and lean, stoops a little
full_text: 25 RDS RW. ABSCONDED, my slave, SCHIEBIEON, OF Mozambique; he is of short stature. It is supposed that he represents himself as a Prize Negro, and has marks above the ancles on one of his legs - Whoever….prosecuted. T.A.M. VOIGT. Paarl, June 24, 1833. NB Said Slave has formerly been the property of Mr F Retief. [[[UPDATE 1227: 40 years old, thin and lean stature, stoops a little, has been seen at Stellenbosch, where he passes for a prize negro]]]

name: Francina
physical_description: tall, yellow complexion, rather stout
full_text: 20 RDS REW. The U, having purchased the slave girl, Francina, late the Property of Mr JC DE VILLIERS, of Drakenstein, and before him that of Mr Gerrit Kleyn, offers the above reward, either to herself, if she will return to her Duty, or to any body who will bring her home. She is a tall woman, of about 44 years of age, of yellow complexion, and rather stout. Cape Town, Aug 1, 1833. M THALWITZER.

name: Pieter
physical_description: about 5 feet 6 inches, make stout, slight limp in his walk, complexion black, hair wooly,small whiskers
clothing: leather trousers, blue cloth jacket and waistcoat, old shirt striped blue, blue handkerchief
full_text: NOTICE - WHEREAS PIETER, Slave of the Widow MARIA LA COCK, of Varse Valei, near Salt River, formerly in the service of Dirk Van Reenen, Js. Charged with wilful murder of GEORGE FREDERIK HENNING LA COCK, absconded from the said place last night, immediately after having perpetrated the act. The following description of him is given with a view to his apprehension: - Age, about 40 years; height about 5 feet 6 inches; make stout; has a slight limp in his walk; complexion black hair wooly with small whiskers, and when last seen was dressed in leather trousers, blue cloth jacket and waistcoat, old shirt, striped blue, and blue handkerchief on his head. DANIEL J. CLOETE, Clerk of the Peace. Clerk of the Peace office, Cape Town, Aug 8 1833.

name: Lys
physical_description: stout make
clothing: blue figured chintz gown, red striped shawl round her neck, red handkerchief round her head
full_text: 5 RIX DOLLAR REWARD – ABSCONDED on the 19th instant, from the house of Mr S van der Spuy, Cape Town, the slave girl LYS, of this Colony, about 18 years old; she is of a stout make, and was dressed in a blue figured chintz gown, a red striped shawl round her neck, and a red handkerchief round her head. It is supposed that she is still wandering in Town. Whoever can give information respecting her or bring her to the undersigned, or lodges her in Prison, will receive the above reward; while those harbouring her will be prosecuted according to law. NJ LOTZ, qq. [_171A]

name: Philip
physical_description: 5 feet in height, yellow complexion, long black hair
full_text: REWARD. THE Slave, Philip, of Bengal, belonging to the Estate of Hercules Jacobus Visser, deceased, having absconded from the place Naauwport, former residence of his late Master. The board of orphan masters as administering the estate, do hereby offer a reward to any person who will give such information at this office, or at the office of the civil commissioner, or clerk of the peace, acting for the orphan chamber, at Graaff Reneit, as shall lead to the apprehension of the said Slave. The following is a description of the slave Philip: he is about 47 years of age, 5 feet in height, of yellow complexion, with long black hair, and is by occupation a Shephard. H. TENNANT, ec. Orphan Chamber, Cape of Good Hope, Augt 29 1833.

name: UNNAMED
physical_description: 5 feet 4 inches high, crooked legs, black color, large eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE May last, a Slave Boy, belonging to David Jacobus Malan, of Brede River, District Worcester, he is 5 feet 4 inches high, has crooked legs, black color and large eyes. Whoever lodges him in prison will receive a reward. JJ MALAN (son). Groonebergh, 24 Aug 1833.

name: Cornelis
physical_description: yellow colour
full_text: 10 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, since the month of Feb last, the U's slave boy, Cornelis, of a yellow color, and much resembling a bastard hottentot; it is supposed that he conceals himself at Wagonmakers Valley. Whoever…prosecuted. Paardeberg Sept 13 1833. EL STEYN.

name: August
physical_description: mark in the form of a crescent on his forehead
full_text: 25 RDS REW. ABSCONDED from the U, on the road betw Swellendam and Graaff Reneit, his male slave August, he is a native of Mosambique, about 32 years of age, and has a mark in the form of a crescent on his forehead, caused by a fall. He has lately passed for a prize negro at Swellendam, where he hired himself out to different persons. Whoever apprehends... reward of 25 Rds. GL COETZEE. Graaf Reinet, Sept 23, 1833.

name: Oerson
physical_description: yellow complexion, scar under his left eye and close to the nose, scalding marks on his left elbow and back
full_text: 50 RDS REW. DESERTED about Two Years ago, the U's slave Oerson, 16 years of age, of yellow complexion, has a scar under his left eye, and close to the nose. He has scalding marks on his left elbow and back. Any person lodging said slave in prison …prosecuted. MH VAN RENSBURG. Field Cornet of Langkloof. {George District}

name: August
physical_description: black color, curled hair, mark on the upper lip in the form of a cut
clothing: blue kersey jacket, linen trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, ABOUT a month ago, the slave August, 14 years old, of black color, and curled hair. He has a mark on the upper lip in the form of a cut and was dressed in a blue kersey jacket and linen trousers and has lastly been seen at Tygerberg. Whoever...rewarded. No 35 Loop street. S. DE KOCK. {{{UPDATE 1834 1031: 20 RDS REWARD...absconded a year ago, and according to information received, is harbouring himself in the Districts of Swellendam or Caledon, in the so called Zandveld, at which place it is supposed he hires himself out as a free black.... S. DE KOCK. Cape Town Tuinwyk, Oct 30 1834.

name: Rachel
physical_description: yellow complexion
clothing: black chintz petticoat
full_text: DESERTED from the U, two slaves named Rachel and her daughter Siena, both purchased at the sale of Mr JH VUURMAN, formerly the property of Mr MULDER, at Graaff Reneit. The mother is of a yellow complexion and pretends to be sickly; was dressed in a black chintz petticoat - the Daughter perfectly resembles a female bastard Hottentot, with curled hair, and marks on the toes of her left foot. Those...prosecuted. JAN HENDRIK VOS, J. Js

name: Siena
physical_description: curled hair, marks on the toes of her left foot

name: Moses Jonas
physical_description: crooked little-finger on his right hand
clothing: kersey jacket, skin trousers, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED since 14 days, my slave boy, Moses, surnamed Jonas, of this Colony; was dressed in a kersey jacket, skin trousers and straw hat, and having a crooked little-finger to his right hand. Whoever…prosecuted. WH THEUNISSEN. Rooseboom, Nov 5 1833.

name: Maart
physical_description: stout make, marks on his left eyebrow and upper lip
clothing: old duffle jacket, leather trousers, blue cloth jacket, blue striped trousers
intentions: Former service in Riebeek's Kasteel; Hires himself as Prize Negro
full_text: 20 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, since the 18th April 1833, the U's male slave, Maart, a Mosambique African, born in this Colony, 23 years old, of stout make, has marks on his left eyebrow and upper lip; he was dressed in an old duffle jacket and leather trousers, and took with him a blue cloth jacket and blue striped trousers. He formerly belonged to Mr JF LOMBAARD, of Riebeek's Castle, and it is supposed that he has hired himself out in that district as a Prize Negro. Whoever...prosecuted. JH NEETHLING, Ms. Eerste Rivier, Nov 6, 1833.

name: George
physical_description: stout make, fair complexion
full_text: DESERTED, George, slave of Mr WJ Louw of Drakenstein, lately discharged from the public works; of stout make and fair complexion, was dressed like a Malay. Those lodging him…shall be rewarded. WJ LOUW.

name: Seronie
physical_description: black colour, slender make, short curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, since 23 Sept. last, Seronie, slave of N LAUBSER, Js. Of Saldannah Bay; she is of black color, slender make, and has short curled hair, representing herself as a female Hottentot. Those…rewarded. Cape Town, Nov 14, 1833. DJ ASPELING.

name: David
physical_description: almost six feet high, black colour, curled hair, mark on his neck
full_text: DESERTED SINCE Sunday last, my slave David, with his wife Annaatje {Hottentot??}, and his sister Lea - David is almost six feet high, of a black colour, has curled hair and a mark on his neck - his sister Lea is about the same stature - Any person…rewarded. BAREND DANIEL ESTERHUYZEN, of Winterveld. 2 Dec 1833. {{NB notice of Capture in GG 18340228}}

name: Lea
physical_description: tall stature

name: August
physical_description: short stature, white mark or sore on his head
full_text: ABSCONDED, THREE weeks ago, the U's slave boy, August, 16 years old, of short stature and has a white mark or sore on his head. Whoever…prosecuted. NB - The said slave has last been seen at the place Altona, of Mr HO EKSTEEN. JP ROUX - Eerste River, Dec 4 1833.

name: Richard
physical_description: one toe on his left leg, squints a little
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE U's slave boy , named Richard, who has only one toe on his left leg, and squints a little. Whoever imprisons him or returns him to his owner, No. 2 Stal plein, will be rewarded. CT, Dec 11, 1833. JH BRAND.

name: Jan
physical_description: spot underneath one of his eyes
full_text: 10 RDS REW - ABSCONDED, TWO months ago, the U's slave boys Jan and Adam, both Malabars, betw 15 and 16 years old. Jan has a spot underneath one of his eyes, and Adam's face is full of pimples. Whoever…law. Rondebosch Dec 26 1833. S. MOSTERT.

name: Adam
physical_description: face is full of pimples

name: Manis
physical_description: strong in stature, middle toes of his right foot are contracted
full_text: 100 RDS REWARD. 50 FOR SCHIEBION [169] And Rds 50 to any person lodging in prison the Slave Manis, a Bougies Africander, deserted since the month November last, he is a shoemaker by trade, and understands farming. 20 years old, healthy, strong in stature, {?}, middle toes of his right foot are contracted. his brother and sister belong to Mr T Dreyer, of Wynberg. PAM VOIGT, Berg River 20 dec 1833.

name: Ernst
full_text: ABSCONDED, the U's slave boy, Ernst, a saddler by trade; he has been seen at Hottentots Holland, in the vicinity of the place Wolvendans. Whoever…prosecuted. JF SERRURIER. No 16 Wale street.

name: Alie
physical_description: large spot on his nose
full_text: ABSCONDED. THE U's slave Boy Ali[e] - he has a large spot on his nose. Whoever…rewarded. S. VAN REENEN, Fs.

name: Jacob
physical_description: short and slender, very black
full_text: SLAVES ABSCONDED: Coridon [_166], was last seen near Saldanha Bay. JACOB, Africaner Mosambique, 16 years old, short and slender, very black and countenance pleasing; formerly belonged to Mr HOETS, and is supposed to be still in CT. ADAM, Aficaner, 10 years old, very small for his age and of brown complexion; had on leather clothes and a blue {?} cap. property of Lt Col Collette. H.L. COLE. Witteboomen Jan 15 1834.

name: Adam
physical_description: very small for his age, brown complexion
clothing: leather clothes and a blue cap

name: Jasmyn
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the month of November last, my slave Jasmyn, from Mosambique, formerly the property of Mr VOGET?; it is supposed he has hired himself out as a prize negro in Town. R. CLOETE, Hs. Koeberg, January 13, 1834. {{{UPDATE 1834 1024: he has 14 days ago been seen in a lane opposite the Fish Market in Cape Town, R Cloete, Koeberg, Oct 18 1834}}}

name: Felix*
clothing: Blue Jacket, White shirt, Leather Trousers, Black Hat
intentions: Former service in Eerste River; Former service in Cape Town;
full_text: 20 RDS REW. ABSCONDED from the U, 2 slave boys, Felix and Hendrick. The first slave is well known in this colony, having been in the service of the late Mr JAN MEYBURG, at Eerste River, and of Mr MOCKE in Cape Town - he is 45 years old, by trade a Tailor, and a Musician, and represents himself as a free black; was dressed in a Blue Jacket, White shirt, Leather Trousers, and Black Hat; he has been seen in Cape Town, at Mr Meyburg's Eerste River, and lastly at Wynberg and in Cape Town. The other boy, Hendrick, is 20 years of age, of stout make, has a mark from the kick of a horse under his left eye and was dressed in a Blue Jacket, Striped Shirt, and Leather Trousers; representing himself as a Bastard; hired himself as such at Eerste River, to cut Oats, and has lastly been seen in the Cape Downs - Whoever...Reward. F.J. BESTBIER. Zwartland, Jan 29, 1834.

name: Hendrick*
physical_description: stout make, mark under his left eye
clothing: Blue Jacket, Striped Shirt, Leather Trousers

name: Phillip
physical_description: short stature, black brownish colour
full_text: DESERTED, SINCE Monday the 3d of this Month, two young African Slaves, both about 20 years old, named Phillip and Jonathan; the first-mentioned is of short stature, and of black brownish colour; the other is tall and of a yellow brown colour. They have been seen in the evening with other loiterers in or near the canteens. Those...rewarded by the U. D. KRYNAUW, Sen.

name: Jonathan
physical_description: tall, yellow brown colour

name: Mei
physical_description: blear eyes
full_text: 10 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, SINCE the 4th December 1834, the slave boy, Mei, a Malay by birth, about 50 years of age, a Tailor by trade, he has blear eyes, and the use of but one of them. Whoever…rewarded. JP EKSTEEN. Bergvliet.

name: Abraham
physical_description: yellow complexion, curled hair
full_text: DESERTED, SINCE the 15th Feb last, the U's slave, named ABRAHAM, of yellow complexion, curled hair, and passes under the name of Abdol.Those lodging….prosecuted. FX JURGENS.

name: Cameel*
intentions: Hires himself as free person; false name Pieter Smal
sightings: Cape Town; Green Point; Mt Pleasant
full_text: ABSCONDED THREE weeks since, my slave boy, Cameel [Kameel], formerly the property of Mr J Van Reenen, J. As. He has been seen in CT and it is suspected that he hires himself out as a Groom. Whoever…to Law. H. CLOETE. Rs. Little Westervoort, Rondebosch, March 6, 1834. [[UPDATE 25051834 - according to information received, lurks about at Greenpoint, where he has hired himself for 3 weeks to Mr RUTHERFORD as a Free Person, by the name Pieter Smal. He is also often seen at the stable of Mr Cameron. - Mount Pleasant, April 15 1834]]

name: Moos
physical_description: large and strong make, no foreteeth, marks on his breast and face
full_text: 10 RDS REW. ABSCONDED on the 6th inst, my slave, Moos, of Mosambique, about 38 years old; he is of a large and strong make, has no foreteeth, and marks on his breast and face, caused by knotching, a custom of that nation - Those…reward. The Widow PAUL JORDAAN. Paardeberg March 7 1834.

name: Rebekka
physical_description: long stature, strong make, black colour, curled hair, mark above one of her eye brows
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, on the 14th Feb last, from the Place "Gouwsriver", in the District of George, a female slave named Rebekka, belonging to CJ Muller, Hs, of the same Place. She is accompanied by her husband, Jacob, a prize negro in the service of said Muller - Rebekka is about 26 years of age, born in this Colony; she is of long stature, strong make, black colour, has curled hair, and a mark above one of her eye brows - Her husband, Jacob, is of a short stature, stout make, black colour and has a white beard. It is supposed that they took their course to Cape Town, and are now harbouring themselves in its vicinity. Whoever lodges...punished. NJ LOTZ, qq.

name: Jacob
physical_description: short stature, stout make, black colour, white beard

name: Dolly [Dollie]
physical_description: short stature, long beard
clothing: white duffel jacket, leathern trousers, field shoes, Malay hat
intentions: Hires himself as a free person
full_text: ABSC. FROM the Insolvent Estate of JC FLECK, Esq., the Slave Dolly - He is a Malay, of short stature, about 35 years of age, has his beard long on his chin, was dressed in a white duffel jacket, leathern trousers, field shoes, and a Malay hat on his head; stutters rather in his speech; is a mason by trade, and is supposed to have let himself in the country as a Freeman - Whoever...will receive 10 Rds...prosecuted. RW EATON/ JT JURGENS - Trustees.

name: Hannibal
physical_description: short make, very flat and depressed nose, nasal sound in speaking, flat feet, both his toes inwardly bent
intentions: Country districts; as a free person
full_text: DESERTED since the month of Dec last the U's slave, named Hannibal, a native if Mosambique. He is about 40 years old, of short make, has a very flat and depressed nose, gives a nasal sound in speaking, has flat feet, and both his toes inwardly bent. He is supposed to wander about the Country Districts under another name, as a free person. Those lodging...rewarded. H CLOETE, Hs. Rondebosch, March 30 1834.

name: Jeck
full_text: ABSCONDED. SOME days ago, my slave boy, named Jeck, of Mosambique, about 40 years of age, formerly the property of Mr DUCKETT Sen, having the appearance of a Prize Negro - it is supposed that he has hired himself out as such. Whoever lodges him in prison or brings him to Mr PIET de VILLIERS of Tygerberg, will be handsomely rewarded. Cape Town, April 8, 1834. JOHS. LOUW, As.

name: Coridon
full_text: 25 RDS REW. ABSCONDED my slave boy name Coridon, bought at the Sale of Col Collette, and formerly the property of the late Mr De Kock, Klapmuts. The above…Undersigned. J. LETTERSTEDT. Rondebosch. [Re repeat - new owner]

name: Sabina
physical_description: yellow complexion
full_text: DESERTED SINCE Two months, my female slave Sabina, of this Colony, of a yellow complexion, about 43 years old, it is supposed that she is harboured at Tygerberg - Those lodging…prosecuted. JG WAGNER. CT May 9 1834.

name: Adonis
physical_description: yellow complexion, brown eyes, curled hair, length 5 ft 3 inches
clothing: duffle Jacket, grey Trowsers, new straw hat with a red ribbon
full_text: 10 RIX DOLLARS REWARD. RUN AWAY, since the 21st instant, ADONIS, a native of this Colony, slave of FJ RETIEF, of Koeberg, of yellow complexion, brown eyes, and curled hair, length 5 ft 3 inches, was dressed in a duffle Jacket, grey Trowsers, had on a new straw hat with a red ribbon, he is supposed to pass as a Bastard, and to have hired himself at Rondebosch or its environs – Those lodging him in Prison will receive the above Reward, and those harbouring him Prosecuted. Cape Town, May 29, 1834. NJ LOTZ, qq. [210A]

name: Sabina [+2 children under 6yrs]
physical_description: moderate size, brown complexion
full_text: DESERTED from the Undersigned, since Three months, my slave SABINA, about 30 years of age, with her two children, one of which also named Sabina, is 3 years old, and the other a suckling child; the slave Sabina is of moderate size, and brown complexion. Also Deserted, the slave ABRAHAM, from Mosambique, 18 years old – Any person lodging the above slaves in prison will be Rewarded. Stellenbosch, May 26, 1834. BR DANIEL. [_210B _210C]

name: Jacob Jaap
physical_description: brown color, curled hair, large eyes, mark on his left eyebrow
intentions: Hires himself as a Hottentot (as before)
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the month of March last, the U's slave-boy, Jacob, surnamed Jaap, about 12 years old, he is of a brown color, has curled hair, large eyes and a mark on his left eyebrow. Said Boy has on former occasion hired himself out as a Hottentot, and it is supposed that he is again representing himeself as such - All persons...prisons. Great Drakenstein, Jan 12, 1834. JP De Wet, Fs.

name: Cobus
full_text: 10 RDS REW. DESERTED two months since, my slave Cobus; has lately been seen near the back gate of Mr Klerck, Boom street. - Those lodging….prosecuted. CT June 13 1834. MJ DE OLIVIERA.

name: Papoa
physical_description: round face, curled hair
intentions: Cape Downs; Former hiring as prize negro in Simon's Bay
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 2d inst. The U's slave boy Papoa, a Mosambique African, accompanied by his wife, a female Hottentot - he has a round face and curled hair - two years ago he hired himself as a Prize Negro to Mr Gideon ROSSOUW in Simon's Bay - Whoever...prosecuted. Hout Bay, June 18 1834. J. STEYN. {{update in insolvent estate 1835 0306 - about 40 years of age, supposed to be in the Field Cornetcy of Mr Dempers, Cape Downs}}

name: John
physical_description: yellow complexion, spot on his right cheek
full_text: ABSCONDED, FIVE months since, Two African Slave Boys, and a Girl, viz. John, 18 years old, of a yellow complexion and having a spot in his right cheek; Salie, 19 years old, of a yellow complexion, and a flat face; and the Girl named Spatie, 17 years old, is of a yellow complexion and has a large spot on her neck. Whoever lodges the said Slaves (who have several times been seen at Wynberg and Hottentot's Holland, at which latter place their father, Ongo, is residing along the Beach) in one of the Prisons, will be Rewarded, and those harbouring them prosecuted. J. VAN REENEN, J. As.

name: Salie
physical_description: yellow complexion, flat face

name: Spatie
physical_description: yellow complexion, large spot on her neck

name: Hendrik
physical_description: yellow complexion, slender make, very crooked legs
clothing: skin trowsers, kersey jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the month of May, the U's slave boy, Hendrik, of this Colony - he is of a yellow complexion, slender make, has very crooked legs, and was dressed in a pair of skin trowsers, and kersey jacket - Whoever lodges…or returns him to the U at Koeberg...prosecuted. J.G. Van Heldzingen, J.Cs.

name: Jan Jochim
physical_description: curled hair, tall stature
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. DESERTED since three Weeks from the place Platterug, situated in Koeberg, my slave, named Jan Jochim, a native of this Colony, 26 years old, resembles a bastard Hottentot, has curled hair and a tall stature, is well known in the Cape District, particularly in the Field Cornetcy of Mr W Thuynsma, Swart Water - those harbouring him will be prosecuted. W. H. THEUNISSEN. Roseboomen, Tygerberg, July 16 1834.

name: Simon
physical_description: about four and a half feet high, stout make, scar across his nose, slanting cut on his right foot, marks between the shoulder blades caused by punishment with a 'cat-o'-nine-tails
full_text: DESERTED SINCE one Month and a half, my Slave, Simon, a native of this Colony, about four and a half feet high, stout make, has a scar across his nose, caused by a knife, a slanting cut on his right foot, and some old marks between the shoulder blades, caused by punishment with a 'cat-o'-nine-tails; he was last seen in the mountains of Franschehoek - Those lodging him in Prison will be Rewarded, and those harbouring him Prosecuted. J. MAREE. Bot River, District of Stellenbosch, July 24, 1834.

name: Alexander
physical_description: slender make, black color, curled hair particularly on his eyebrows
clothing: new kersey jacket with steel buttons, skin jacket, two pair skin trousers
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 12th July, 1833, the U's slave boy, Alexander, of this Colony, he is 29 years of age, of a slender make, and black color, has curled hair, particularly on his eyebrows; he was dressed in a new kersey jacket, with steel buttons, a skin jacket, and two pair skin trousers. It is supposed that he is wandering about in the district of Clan William, or in the Sandveld - Whoever...prosecuted. GT HUGO. Kleine Drakenstein, July 22, 1834.

name: Saartje
physical_description: stout and short stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, about two months since, the U's female slave, Saartje - She is of a stout and short stature, has the appearance of a Mosambique, and concealed herself lately between Simon's Town and Wynberg - Whoever…or brings her to the House of Mrs the Widow SCHIKKERLING, in Keerom Street, will be handsomely rewarded. July 23 1834. The Widow TREDOUX.

name: Jephta
full_text: DESERTED, MY Slave, Jephta, 12 or 13 years old; stammers much. Those delivering him to the U will be well rewarded and those harbouring him prosecuted. The said Jephta has recently been seen at the Shambles and Wynberg. Cape Town, July 23, 1834. JH BAM, Sen.

name: Flora
physical_description: tall, light complexion, one eye
full_text: ABSENT from the service of the Undersigned, the slave Flora, she is about 44 years old, tall, light complexion, one eye, looks like a Hottentot, and missed a Wagon in travelling from Eerste River, district of Stellenbosch, towards Worcester, about Two Years ago - Any person...prosecuted. JOHN FRANCIS GOODWIN. Beaufort, Sept 4 1834.

name: Frederik
physical_description: short and stout make, dark brown complexion, curled hair
clothing: blue linen Jacket and trousers, white waistcoat
full_text: ABSCONDED THREE weeks since, the Slave, Frederik, belonging to the U, he was dressed in a blue linen Jacket and trousers, and a white waistcoat, - he is of a short and stout make, dark brown complexion, and has curled hair, and is about 20 years of age. It is said that he is harbouring himself in the Country Districts. Whoever...rewarded. JP EKSTEEN. Bergvlied, Sept 26 1834.

name: Abraham*
physical_description: short stature, yellow colour, curled hair, short toes, stern appearance, marks of punishment on his back
clothing: brown cloth jacket
full_text: THREE SLAVES ABSCONDED. 10 RDS REWARD FOR EACH. On the 4th February last, Abraham, of this Colony, 28 years of age; he is of a short stature, yellow colour, has curled hair, short toes, a stern appearance, and marks of punishment on his back; was dressed in a brown cloth jacket and had four tanned skins with him - Shortly after the time of his absconding he has been seen in Cape Town, where he harboured himself on a former occasion. On the 24th March last, Geduld, of Mosambique, about 40 years of age, is of a long and slender make, has large hands and feet, incisions on his face, a scar on his forehead, and marks, occasioned by a scorch, on one of his knees. On the 29th March last, Telemachus, of Mosambique, 40 years of age, is of short make, has a serious countenance, an oval incision on his shoulder and marks of punishment on his back. It is supposed that the first mentioned represents himself as a Bastard and the two last mentioned as Prize Negroes - Whoever returns them within a month from this date...prosecuted. The respective Field Cornets are requested to have them apprehended and to give imediate notice thereof to CA HAUPT. Great Drakenstein, Sept 26 1834.

name: Geduld
physical_description: long and slender make, large hands and feet, incisions on his face, scar on his forehead, marks on one of his knees

name: Telemachus
physical_description: short make, serious countenance, oval incision on his shoulder, marks of punishment on his back

name: Jack
full_text: ABSCONDED - the U's slave boy, Jack, born in this Colony. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. October 8 1834. JJ BRINK, Js.

name: Goliath
full_text: ABSCONDED. FOURTEEN days since, the Slave Goliath, a Tailor by trade, in which capacity it is supposed that he hires himself out. Those to whom he might offer his services are kindly requested to forward him to prison or to the U, for which a reward will be given. Valkenburgh, Oct 8 1834. C. MOSTERT, Sr.

name: Kalonie
physical_description: brownish colour, curled hair, middling size
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U since March last, the Slave Girl named Kalonie, aged 15 years, of a brownish colour, curled hair, and of a middling size, has for some time ago been seen at Wynberg, Cape Town, and its environs. Whoever lodges…rewarded. CJ VAN DER MERWE.

name: Alexander
physical_description: between 5 and 6 feet high, stout make, black complexion, two scars on his back, missing one of his fore teeth
full_text: 100 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, two years since, the slave Alexander. He then belonged to Mr Ignatius Petrus du Preez, but is now the property of the Undersigned. He is a Mozambique Afrikander, between 5 and 6 feet high, of stout make, black complexion, has two scars on his back, and lost one of his fore teeth - Any person...prosecuted. JL FERREIRA. Langekloof, District of George, October 1834.

name: Willem
physical_description: stout, strong, black
intentions: Hires himself as Free person, under name of Cornelis
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] GEDROST sedert die maand Maart 1834, de slaaf Willem, van de Kaap, zynde een frissche sterke zwarte {stout, strong, black} Afrikaander, omtrent 35 jaren oud, behoorende aan JN REDELINGHUYS, van de Hantam. Volgens bekomen informatie, houdt hy zich in de stad en in het Kaapsche District op, en verhuurt zich als een vry man, zomtyds onder den naam van Cornelis. Die hem apprehendeert... in regten vervolg worden. Kaapstad, 12 Nov 1834. A BRINK, Dz qq.

name: Frits
physical_description: stout make, light yellow complexion, curled hair, has but one eye
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the month of April last {{see April update on _ }} the Slave Frits, belonging to the U, about 40 years old, stout make, light yellow complexion, and curled hair, has but one eye, formerly the property of the late Mr WARNIK, he is according to good information, harboring himself in Cape Town, where he has lately hired himself as a gardener to Mr Mackenzie, by the name of Jan - Those lodging...prosecuted. CG MARAIS. Jonkershoek, near Stellenbosch, Nov 1831.

name: December
full_text: NOTICE. WHEREAS the slave December, from Mosambique, about 47 years of age, now the property of the U but formerly of the late Mr JC LOOK, has deserted some months since; a reward of Rds. 20 is hereby offered…prosecuted. Cape Town, Nov 7 1834. A BRINK, Ds.

name: Jason
clothing: skin trousers, drab duffle jacket, drab hat
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. THE slave, Jason, the property of Mr M. Melk, absented himself out of the service of Mr R Cloete of Koeberg, about three weeks ago - He is a Mosambique, of about 36 years old, and was dressed in a pair of skin trowsers, drab duffle jacket, and drab hat - Whoever lodges...according to law. RJ VAN DER RIET, qq.

name: Lubyn
physical_description: yellow colour, middling size, long black hair of which a part is fallen out, missing part of the fore finger of his right hand
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U in the month of October 1833, the Slave Boy Lubyn, of this Colony, he is of a yellow colour, middling size, has long black hair, of which a part is fallen out, and he has also lost a part of the fore finger of his right hand. He understands a little of the Tailor's trade and it is supposed that he represents himself as a free person - Whoever lodges...rewarded. The Widow AB DE VILLIERS. Great Drakenstein, November 20 1834.

name: Carolus
physical_description: yellow colour, stout stature, curled hair
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 11th November, my 2 slave boys, one named Carolus, a Bouganees African, of a yellow color, stout stature, has curled hair and is about 32 years of age - The other named Joas, a Mosambique African, of 24 years old, is of a black color, short and stout stature, and has a mark occasioned by a pestilential ulcer under one of his eyes; he is accompanied by a Hottentot woman named Griet of a yellow color and slender make, and it is supposed he took his direction to Saldanha Bay. Whoever lodges them in prison will receive the above-stated Reward for each of them. Wagonmakers Valley, Nov 18, 1834. D RETIEF.

name: Joas
physical_description: black colour, short and stout stature, mark under one of his eyes

name: Moses
physical_description: middling size, yellow colour, long black hair
full_text: ABSCONDED 3 months ago, my slave boy, Moses, of a middling size, yellow color, and has long black hair. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. Moddergat, Nov 18, 1834. JJ DE VILLIERS.

name: Dappat
full_text: ABSCONDED about 5 months ago, the Slave Dappat, of Bougies, about 60 years of age, formerly the property of the late GC GREFFRATH. Whoever…prosecuted. He has been seen along the Rondebosch road. Slangekop, Nov 18 1834.

name: Jacob
physical_description: yellow colour, middling size, long hair
full_text: ABSCONDED - LIBERAL REWARD. WHOEVER lodges the Slave Jacob, of this Colony, belonging to the Widow Jan Fredrik Heydenrych, Sen, of Cape Town, (absconded for about 3 years ago, on the road between Uitenhage and Graaf-Reneit) in Prison, will be liberally rewarded. The said boy is about 42 years old, of a yellow color, middling size, and has long hair - Any person apprehending him is kindly requested to give immediate notice thereof to Mr JH HOFMEYER, No 1 Burg Street, Cape Town, where the reward will also be paid. Cape Town Nov 18 1834.

name: Maandag
physical_description: common posture, Mozambique figures marked on chest, white of eyes often become red
clothing: hat with a high crown
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY - see ENG COPY found] 30 RDS BELOONING. GEDROST van den O. sedert de maand April 1832, desselfs Slaaf genaamd "Maandag", van Mosambiek, hy heest zich voor een geruimen tyd in het District Swellendam, aan Gousrivier, met twee andere slaven als Prysnegers verhuurd. is van een ordinair postuur, heest gekerste Mosambieken bloemen op zynen borst en het wit van zyne oogappelen wordt dikwyls rood {common posture, Mozambique figures marked on chest, white of eyes often become red}; ook heest hy de gewoonte van een hoed met eenen hoogen bol {hat with a high crown} te dragen. Die hem by den O bezorgt, zal bovengen belooning genieten. P DE VILLIERS, Jz. Groot drakenstein, 13 November, 1834.

name: Job
physical_description: middling size
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. DESERTED about two months since, from the place Halfaamtjes-kraal, situate in the District of Caledon, my Slave, named Job, of Mosambique. He is of a middling size, and about 45 years old. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. DG VAN BREDA. Orangezigt, Cape Town. Nov 26, 1834.

name: Appollos
physical_description: short, stout stature
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE THE 17TH November last, my Apprenticed Labourer Appollos; he is of a short, stout stature, and born of Mozambique, but speaks good Dutch. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. J LAUBSCHER. Patrysberg, Saldanha Bay, Dec 6 1834.

name: Adriaan
physical_description: brownish color, middling size, large squint eyes, curled hair, flat nose
clothing: drab jacket, leather trousers, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, IN the beginning of this month, my Apprentice Adriaan, 18 years of age; he is of a brownish color, middling size, was in the service of Mr J van Schoor, and has large squint eyes - It is supposed that he harbours himself in the vicinity of Cape Town - Whoever lodges...prosecuted. Dec 22 1834. C FISCHER. {{{UPDATE 1836 0304 - has curled hair, flat nose and squints a little... He was seen some weeks ago behind the Castle, leading a Wagon supposed to belong to a farmer residing in the District of Drakenstein, and was then dressed in a drab jacket, leather trousers and had a straw hat on. CT March 3 1836 - CC FISCHER}}}

name: Dantjie
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE Apprentice DANTJIE, belonging to Mr JD MOHR, of the Paarl; he is employed somewhere about Cape Town. Any person giving information at the Tronk that may lead to his apprehension, or lodging him in the P, will be rewarded and those persons employing or harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted.

name: Cyster
physical_description: middling height, this stature, and black complexion
clothing: leathern trouser, blue jacket, white shirt, colored handkerchief
full_text: DESERTED, my Apprentice CYSTER, of a middling height, thin stature, and black complexion. He was dressed in a leathern trouser, blue jacket, white shirt, and colored handkerchief - Those lodging him in P shall be rewarded. GABRIEL LOUW. Cape Town, Jan 22, 1835.

name: Christian
full_text: TWENTY RDS REWARD - Deserted the Apprentice named Christian, belonging to Mr PJ De Villiers, at Riebeek's Kasteel; those lodging him in P…reward.

name: Henry Trew
physical_description: fair complexion, dark hair, near 5 feet high
other_description: born in St Mary's Islington, London
full_text: NOTICE - DESERTED, FROM THE U, AN Apprentice Servant, named Henry Trew, about 15 years old, fair complexion, with dark hair, and near 5 feet high, born in St Mary's Islington, London; he was last seen in Cape Town - A reward will be given to anyone…prosecuted. O.M. BERGH. Stellenbosch, Jan 27, 1835.

name: Willem
physical_description: yellow complexion, long stature, black hair, missing one of his fore-teeth
full_text: ABSCONDED - WILLEM, about 25 years old, of a yellow complexion, long stature, has black hair, and lost one of his fore-teeth - Whoever lodges him in P or brings him to the U, will receive 25 rds as a reward; and if Willem returns home on his own accord he will not be punished. JJ KOTZE, Jun, Berg River, Cape District.

name: Regina
physical_description: stout and short make
full_text: ABSCONDED - About two months since, the U's female apprentice, Regina, of this Colony, she is of a stout and short make, and formerly belonged to Mr M Horak. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. Caledon, 15th Feb, 1835. PH WESSELS.

name: Casper
physical_description: about 5 feet high, brownish colour, curled hair, mark on his forehead
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 27th December last, the U's Apprentice, named Casper, about 5 feet high, a brownish color, has curled hair, and a mark on his forehead. Those lodging him in prison, bringing him to the U or pointing out where he harbours himself, will receive a Reward of One Pound Sterling. [+-13 RDS] Feb 12 1835. RJ LOEDOLFF.

name: Jacob
clothing: moleskin and a kersey jacket, moleskin trousers, white shirt, red handkerchief, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED - Since the 12th jan last, my Apprentice Jacob - he was dressed in a moleskin and a kersey jacket, a pair of moleskin trousers, white shirt, and had a red handkerchief and straw hat on, and has been seen in the Cape Flats on the 15th Feb - those confining him... rewarded. HO EKSTEEN.

name: William Henry Priestley
physical_description: 5 feet 4 inches in height, light complexion
full_text: TEN RDS REWARD - Whereas my Indentured Apprentice, William Henry Priestley, absconded from my house on the 24th Feb last, and is supposed to be in Cape Town or its vicinity. The above reward will be paid to any person who shall Apprehend and Lodge him in P. He is about 18 years of age, 5 feet 4 inches in height, light complexion, and has a slight obliquity of vision. Great Constantia, March 5, 1835. JP CLOETE.

name: Alie*
physical_description: dark brown complexion, about five feet high, black mole on his nose, curled hair, upper lip contracted by the kick of a horse
full_text: {repeat offender - new owner} THE U, having by purchase become entitled to the services of the Apprentice Alie, of the Insolvent Esatte of S VAN REENEN, Fs., will give a good Reward to any one lodging him in P, or bringing him to the U. - He has a dark brown complexion, about five feet high, has a black mole on his nose, curled hair, the upper lip contracted by the kick of a horse; and has been lately seen at Kafferkuils River, District of Swellendam - He will not be punished. JG STEGMANN. Cape Town, Feb 24, 1835. [UPDATE 1836 0715 - has lately hired himself as a free person to Mr Jan BUIS at Gaurits River, by the name of Jan Boveland. Stegman, CT July 14 1836]

name: James Lolly
clothing: new leathern trousers, blue jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED - my apprentice, named James Lolly, about 13 years old; was dressed in a pair of new leathern trousers and blue jacket - Any person finding him is requested to lodge him in prison. TF DREYER, Sen. Alphen, at Wynberg.

name: Alie
full_text: In the insolvent Estate of JACOBUS STEYN, Douw Gerbrand's Son, of Hout Bay, in the Cape District, Wine Farmer: THE following apprentices belonging to this estate having absconded, Notice is hereby given, that a reward will be given for their apprehension; and those found harbouring them will be prosecuted according to Law: ALIE, of the Cape, a Tailor by trade, about 50 years of age; he has a Son living in Cape Town, named Frerik Alie. Said Alie has been seen in the vicinity of Keerom Street, Cape Town. PAPOEA (_213), a Mosambique African about 40 years of age - supposed to be in the Field Cornetcy of Mr DEMPERS, Cape Downs. PD HOHNE. Provisional Trustee.

name: Ajerdien
physical_description: long and slender make, mark under his right eye, long hair
clothing: kersey jacket, leathern trousers, red handkerchief, straw hat
items_taken: took all his clothes with him
full_text: TWENTY-FIVE RDS REWARD - Deserted, since the 7th March, THE FOLLOWING Apprentices, viz. _Ajerdien, of this Colony, about 21 years old, long and slender make, has a mark of a fall under his right eye, long hair, and resembles a Moor, was dressed in a kersey jacket, leathern trousers, had a red handkerchief, and straw hat on his head, and took all his clothes with him. JOAQUE - of this Colony, about 24 years old, short and stout make, of a very black color, thick broad nose, has a sore on his left knee and was dressed in a kersey jacket and leathern trousers, with a Ravenduck shirt and drab hat. MASOER, of this Colony, long and slender make, has lost one of his upper fore teeth, has thick and pointed lips, resembles a Caffer, and had a new kersey jacket, white shirt, leathern trousers and a drab hat on; they are supposed to have gone to Cape Town - the above reward will be given to any person bringing them in P or to the house of the U, while those harbouring them will be prosecuted. George, March 16, 1835. B DUMINY.

name: Joaque
physical_description: short and stout make, very black color, thick broad nose, sore on his left knee
clothing: kersey jacket, leathern trousers, Ravenduck shirt, drab hat

name: Masoer
physical_description: long and slender make, missing one of his upper fore teeth, thick and pointed lips
clothing: new kersey jacket, white shirt, leathern trousers, drab hat

name: Fortuin
physical_description: long stature, brown colour, short curled hair, scar on his breast
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 13th inst my two apprentices Fortuin and Jacob. The firstmentioned is between 21 and 22 years old, of a long stature, brown color,has short curled hair, and a scar on his breast; the lastmentioned is 39 years old, of a short stature, brown color, and has also short curled hair, some of which is already grey. Any person...prosecuted. CJR BRESLER. Paardeberg Dist Stellenbosch Maart 21 1835.

name: Jacob
physical_description: short stature, brown colour, short curled hair (some of which is already grey)

name: Esau
physical_description: long curled hair, mark under his eye, yellow complexion
full_text: DESERTED, since the 31st march last, my two Apprentices Esau and Afrika, both of the Cape; the first mentioned is about 35 or 40 years old, has long curled hair, and a mark under his eye, of a yellow complexion, and took with him a boy, aged 6 or 7 years, named kleine Esau; the second apprentice is 20 or 21 years old, has long curled hair, slight brownish looks, and is supposed to be accompanied by a Bushman woman having stump little fingers. The above apprentices are supposed to have gone to the District of Worcester thence to proceed into the interior; those lodging...prosecuted. Groeneberg, District stellenbosch, 6 April 1835. JD ROSSOUW, Ps.

name: Afrika
physical_description: long curled hair, slight brownish looks

name: Job
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U's place "Halfaamtjes Kraal" District of Caledon, on the 24th Jan last, the Apprentice Job, of Mosambique, about 40 years old, and took with him a hound bitch. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. DG VAN BREDA. Garden Oranjezigt, Cape Town, 9 April 1835.

name: Kiepie
physical_description: yellow colour, curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, about one month ago, a little bastard Hottentot, named Kiepie, about 12 years old, of a yellow color and curled hair; he attended a wagon to Town, and it is supposed he is now harboring himself there - Whoever lodges him in prison…rewarded. RH MYBURGH. Elsenburg, April 20, 1835.

name: Abraham
physical_description: short and stout, black curly hair, long forehead, toes bent inward
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] tien rds belooning (10 Rds reward) – Gedrost op den 22 April 1835, myn Apprentice, ABRAHAM, hy is kort en Frisch (short and stout) van postuur, heest zwart gekroest haar, een langwerpig hoofd, en de groote en kleine toonen van zyne heide voete staan buitenwaards (black curly hair, long forehead, toes bent inward). Ik veronderstel dat hy zich onder den naam van Jacob uitgeest, en zich in de nabyheid van Stellenbosch ophaeld {presumed to pass under the false name Jacob, presumed in Stellenbosch) – Die hem by den Ondergetekene of in het Gevangenhuis bezorgt zal beloond en die hem ophoudt in regten worden vervolgd. FJ ROSS, Fz. Moddergat, 18 Mei, 1835. [_267A]

name: Juny
physical_description: bald head, crooked little finger
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U, on the 15th December last, an Apprentice named JUNY, aged 50 years, has a bald head, and a crooked little finger - any one…rewarded. JC BOSMAN. Bottelary May 15 1835.

name: Adam
physical_description: yellow colour, stout make, short curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, since Jan last, my Apprentice named Adam, about 22 years old, of a yellow colour, stout make, has short curled hair, and took with him his wife and child; his wife is lean, of a brown complexion, long hair, and named Silvia; his child is 1 1/2 years old. They state themselves to be Bastards and were last seen at oliphant's River. those lodging....prosecuted. Koeberg, Cape District, 1st June 1835. DJ THEUNISSEN.

name: Silvia
physical_description: brown complexion, long hair

name: Joseph
physical_description: short stature, short curled hair
clothing: blue kersey jacket, red waistcoat, white shirt, leathern trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 27th April 1835, my Apprentice named Joseph, nick-named Camies, of a short stature, has short curled hair and was dressed in a blue kersey jacket, red waistcoat, white shirt, and leathern trousers. Any person…rewarded. FJ STOFFBERG. Paalen, 2d June 1835.

name: Maart
physical_description: slender make, somewhat crooked legs
intentions: Formerly harboured at Wynberg and Kogel Bay
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 7th of June, my Apprentice Maart, of Mosambique, - he is of a slender make, and has somewhat crooked legs; - at the time of his last Desertion he was Apprehended by Mr W MOORE at Wynberg, and has also harboured himself at Kogelbay - Every one is kindly requested to apprehend him, while those harbouring him will be prosecuted. CC MOCKE.

name: William
physical_description: scar on one of his arms
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the month of Feb last, the Prize Negro, William, about 15 years old, much resembling a bastard Hottentot, and having a scar on one of his arms - Whoever…Prosecuted. No 8 Buitenkant. The Wife of H. MULLER.

name: Goliath
physical_description: large and stout make
full_text: ABSCONDED, from the U, the Apprentice Goliath and his wife Martha and child Dampie. The first-mentioned of Mosambique, about 48 years old, and of a large and stout make. Fredrik alias Saptoe, is twintig jaren oud, geelachtig van kleur, omtrent vyf voeten lang, en loopt met zynen toonen binnenwaards {yellow colour, about 5 feet high, walks with his toes bent inwards}. full_text: Advertisement - Absconded since the 1st inst, the U's App named Apollos, from Mosambique, about 40 years old, of a middle stature, having on each cheek a small mark resembling a star; some fingers of his left hand and the toes of his left foot are bent inwards; he was dressed in a new kersey jacket, new leather trousers, and a new black hat with broad brim, having in his possession some clothes, and two new Caffer baskets - he has been seen on the road towards Cape Town, and would from there proceed to Wynberg or Simon's Town, pretending to be a Free Person - Those meeting him are requested to lodge him in Prison. JMA Blommestein, Saxenburg, District Stellenbosch, Sept 8 1835.

full_text: In the Insolvent Estate of Jan Daniel Etzard Grimbeek, of Banghoek, Farmer. Seventy Five RDS Reward - Abdsconded, the following Apprentices, belonging to the said estate, viz. Since the middle of October Last: Christiaan, of this Colony, about 25 years old, white color, middle sized, dark brown hair, brown whiskers, white trousers, and straw hat. European cast of features. Galant, of this Colony, about 33 years old, color black, middle sized, black hair, is bandy-legged, was dressed in a drab duffle jacket, leather trousers, handkerchief, and straw hat. Mosambique cast of features. Have both been seen Langhoogte, in the sub-district of Caledon. Since last year: Africa, about 28 years old, color brown, tall, black hair, has a scar under his left eye, and defect on one of his little fingers. Hottentot cast of features. Has likewise been seen at Langehoogte. Whoever shall secure thm and lodge them in any public prison, shll receive TWENTY FIVE RDS for each of them, upon information and proof thereof to F. GODF. WATERMEYER, Prov. Trustee.

full_text: ABSCONDED from my Service on the 3d February 1835, Philis, an Apprentice, supposed to be either in Graham's Town or Somerset, where he is well known as a Mason, Carpenter, or Thatcher. He is about 5 feet 5 inches high, dark eyes, long black hair, brown complexion, stout make, 45 years, and has a mark of an incised wound on the left side a little behind the hip, wears a Handkerchief round his head, and has the appearance of a Malay; is in company of a Hottentot Woman named Griet, his reputed Wife, well known in either of the above places as a notorious drunkard. I have no doubt that he has hired himself as a Free Person; and owing to the want of a "Vagrant Law", he and others in a similar situation, can do so without fear of detection. Any person in whose service he might be is requested to have him sent to the nearest Gaol, and those harbouring him shall be prosecuted. MJ VAN NULDT ONKRUYDT. Kleine Gustrouw, Jonker's Hoek, July 4 1836.
