full_text: FIFTEEN RDS REWARD - Absconded since Tuesday last, my app ANTHONY. He was dressed in a kersey jacket, leather trousers and had a red handkerchief round his head; is about 40 years, a native of Mosambique, and somewhat short of stature, but strong made; was formerly the prop of Mr F LIESCHING of Tygerberg. He took with him his Wife (a free woman of Madagascar), with her white Infant, about 9 or 10 months old - Any person...prosecuted. SJ HOFMEYR, Js, Jun. Leeuwendal, Aug 30 1836.

name: Tapner
physical_description: red hair, red flushing face
full_text: ABSCONDED since Saturday last, the Juvenile Apprentice 'TAPNER', who has been employed in the Branch Apothecary Establishment of Messrs PALLAS & POLEMAN, in Longmarket-street; he may be reconnoitred by his red hair, and red flushing face - Whoever apprehends...rewarded by PH POLEMAN. CT Sept 8 1836.

name: Thamar
physical_description: long hair, white spot on cheek
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 12th June last, my app THAMAR, a Mallabar Africander, she has long hair, and a white spot on her cheek, is about 40 years old; and has with her two Children, a boy of 14 years of age of yellow complexion, and a girl of 10 years old, brown hair, and thick lips. Those harbouring...prosecuted. Klip Bank, Aug 30, 1836. DJ KOTZE.

name: ? Child 1
physical_description: yellow complexion

name: ? Child 2
physical_description: brown hair, thick lips

name: Arnoldus
physical_description: knees bend inwards, thick lips
clothing: kersey jacket, white trousers
intentions: Former service in Constantia; heading to interior
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] GEDROST sedert den 15 Aug, myn app Arnoldus, voormaals het eigendom en laatst in dienst van den Hr RAM CLOETE, naby Constantia. Er zyn gene byzondere merken om hem te onderkennen, behalve dat zyne knieen binnenwaards gebogen zyn, en dat hy dikke lippen heest {knees bend inwards, thick lips}; hy was by die opdrossing gekleed in een karsaayen bovenbaatjie en witte broek {kersey jacket, white trousers}, men veronderstelt dat hy naar buiten heest begeven. Ieman hem...worden. CJ BRAND.

name: Caesar
physical_description: black complexion, small thin stature, middling size
clothing: grey cloth trousers, black waistcoat, duffel jacket with yellow buttons, red handkerchief
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] 10RDS BELOONING - Gedrost sedert den 14 dezer, my app CAESAR, zwart van kleur, schraal van postuuren middelmatig van lengte {black complexion, small thin stature, middling size}, gekleed in grys lakensche broek, zwarte onderbaatje, sito duffelsche bovenbaatje met gele knoopen, en roode doek {grey cloth trousers, black waistcoat, duffel jacket with yellow buttons, red handkerchief} op het hoofd, hy heest zich by zyne laaste desertie, in January 1835, aan den heer M HORAK, te Rondebosch, als een vry persoon verhuurd, onder den naam van Adriaan. Die hem, belooning geniten van GABRIEL LOUW, Breestraat 27, CT, 16 Sept 1836.

name: John Cooper
full_text: DESERTED - My Juvenile App, JOHN COOPER, aged 14 years, left Home on the 27th Aug, and has not since been heard of - Any person…rewarded. HA TRAUTER, 29 Plein Street. NB Any person detaining him after this notice will be prosecuted according to Law. Sept 28 1836.

name: Thomas
physical_description: yellow color, walks somewhat lame, mark on one of his eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 26th Dec 1835, the U's App, THOMAS, a Tailor by trade, of a yellow color, and much resembling a Bastard: he walks somewhat lame, his right hip having been fractured; he has a mark on one of his eyes and lately been seen in the vicinity of Mr SMUTS's Garden in the Kloof. Also, since the 3d inst, the app, ANDRIES, a Tailor by trade, much resembling a Malabar, and was dressed in a brown cloth jacket, black trousers, and a red cap under his hat. Whoever lodges...prosecuted. CT Sept 29, 1836. AJ SMITSDORFF.

name: Andries
clothing: brown cloth jacket, black trousers, red cap under his hat

name: Willem
physical_description: yellow complexion, slender stature, thick mustachios
clothing: duffle jacket and leather trousers, red handkerchief
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 7th June last, my App Willem; he is a Mason of yellow complexion, slender stature, and has thick mustachios; was dressed in a duffle jacket and leather trousers, and had a red handkerchief round his head - Any person…prosecuted. CT Oct 5 1836. EJA Grimbeek.

name: Joseph
physical_description: missing one of his front teeth, several scars on his face
clothing: blue jacket, trousers, straw hat
full_text: DESERTED - Since the 12th ult., my app named Joseph, 21 years old, dressed in a blue jacket and pair of trowsers, and a straw hat on his head; he has lost one of his front teeth, and has several scars on his face, - it is supposed that he has hired himself out as a Labourer. Whoever secures him in one of the Gaols, will receive a Reward of 10 Rds, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. A DE SMIDT. CT 13th Oct 1836.

name: Solomon
physical_description: about 5 feet 4 inches high, stout, dark complexion, wears small mustachios
clothing: new blue duffle jacket and trousers
full_text: £5 REWARD - Absconded from the service of the U, his apprenticed laborer, SOLOMON, by Trade a Mason - The Indentures of this App were purchased in CT, about Six Weeks ago, from Mr Jacob Van Reenen, Fs. - He arrived in Algoa Bay in the St Helena on the 9th of last month and has since absconded from Port Elizabeth. He is 27 years of age, about 5 feet 4 inches high, stout, dark complexion, wears small mustachios; was dressed in a new blue duffle jacket and trousers - Any person...reward on application to... LH MEURANT, Graham's Town; or to the publishing clerk at the Gazette Office, CT.

name: Andries
full_text: ABSCONDED since a considerable time, the U's Apprentices named ANDRIES & CORNELIS, the first was formerly the property of Doctor Bailey, and the latter of Notary BECK; also JAN PIETER, who passes himself as a prize negro named Dollie. Those lodging…prosecuted. JACOB VAN REENEN, Fs. CT, Oct 25, 1836.

name: Jacob
physical_description: short stature, black complexion
clothing: green duffle jacket and leathern trowsers, red cap
intentions: Hires himself as a brick carrier
full_text: ABSCONDED since 5 weeks ago, my app JACOB, 14 years old, of short stature, and black complexion - he was dressed in a green duffle jacket and leathern trowsers, with a red cap on his head, and has probably hired himself at one of the Brick-kilns as Brick Carrier - All persons...Prison - He is stated to have been seen on the Road to Rondebosch. S DE KOCK. CT, Tuinwyk, 26th Oct 1836.

name: Jonathan
physical_description: yellow complexion, curled hair, long pointed head
clothing: duffle Jacket and leathern trousers
intentions: Fomerly hired himself as a Hottentot
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 7th inst. My Apprentice Jonathan, 16 years old, was dressed in a duffle Jacket and leathern trowsers, of yellow complexion, has curled hair, a long pointed head, resembles a Hottentot, and has once hired himself as a bastard Hottentot; any persons...rewarded. Klein Bottelary 18 Oct 1836. JG FISCHER.

name: Moses
physical_description: has only one hand
full_text: ABSCONDED - My app MOSES, who can easily be identified, as he has only one hand; - Also, for Sale, an app who understands Cookery. H CLOETE, P.son. Bouquet-street No 1.

name: Daniel
physical_description: short stature, small pointed head, and large wide fore-teeth
full_text: ABSCONDED on the 22d March last, my app DANIEL, stating his name to be October, of short stature, and has much the resemblance of a Mozambique; has a small pointed head, and large wide fore-teeth - Those…prosecuted. JP JORDAAN. Worcester, Nov 5 1836.

name: Demas
physical_description: stout make, brown complexion, curled hair, lefthanded, scar under one of his eyes,missing two of his front teeth
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 29th Oct last, my App DEMAS, 26 years old, of a stout make, brown complexion, and has curled hair, he works lefthanded with the spade and sickle, has a scar under one of his eyes, and has lost two of his front teeth. Any person…rewarded. DJ MALAN, Js. Wagonmakers Valley, 22 Nov 1836.

name: Mei
physical_description: short and middling size, pearl in one of his eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 19th Sept 1835, the U's App, MEI, of Batavia, about 50 years of age, of a short and middling size, and has a pearl in one of his eyes; it is supposed that he harbours himself in Cape Town or its Environs - Whoever lodges….a reward of Ten Rixdollars. P MEIRING.

name: Marthinus
physical_description: moderately built and badly broken
full_text: [DUTCH ONLY] GEDROST op den 1 Dec myn App MARTHINUS, een Mosambiek Afrikaander, matig van postuur, en is zwaar gebroken {moderately built and badly broken}, die hem in een der gevangenhuizen…worden. Bottelary 5 Dec 1836. JJ BOSMAN, Jz.

name: Pierre
physical_description: short stature, dark color, small beard under his chin
full_text: ABSCONDED Three months since, my two App MOSES (356) & PIERRE, the first is easily to be distinguished having but one hand; the second is of a short stature, dark color, and has a small beard under his chin - It is requested to apprehend and lodge them in priosn. H. CLOETE, Ps. Bouquet-street.

name: Asia
physical_description: brown complexion, short curled hair, spouting lips, two blue marks on his face, scar on the right side of his head
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U since the 20th of this Month, the Indentured Hottentot, ASIA, much the appearance of a native of Madagascar, of brown complexion, has short curled hair, spouting lips, two blue marks on his face, and a scar on the right side of his head - Any person...prosecuted. COBUS JOHANNES, Js. CT 12th Jan, 1837.

name: Caesar
physical_description: black complexion, slender make, middling stature
clothing: grey trousers, black waistcoat, duffle jacket with yellow buttons, red handkerchief
intentions: Former desertion Rondebosch; uses different name
full_text: REWARD OF 10 RDS - Absconded since the 19th Dec 1836, my App, CAESAR, of black complexion, slender make, and middling stature; was dressed in grey trousers, black waistcoat, and duffle jacket, with yellow buttons, and had a red handkerchief round his head; he hired himself, on his last desertion in January 1835, to Mr M HORAK, at Rondebosch, as a free person, by the name of Adriaan. Any person...reward. G LOUW, Bree-street, 27, CT, 25 Jan, 1837.

name: Jephta
physical_description: small stature
full_text: ABSCONDED - since the 13th last, my App JEPHTA - he is a Mosambique Africander, of small stature, about 16 or 17 years old, smatters much - Any person…prosecuted. Widow JH BAM , No 20 Grave-street. Jan 20 1837.

name: Sabina
physical_description: dark complexion, round face, short stout make, scar on one of her cheeks
full_text: ABSCONDED since the beginning of October last, my App SABINA, of this Colony; she is of dark complexion, round face, short stout make, and has a scar on one of her cheeks; it is supposed that she harbours herself in Town - Whoever…10 rds Reward…prosecuted. JJ DU PREE. Groot Drakenstein, 28th Jan 1837. {See imprisoned slave GG

name: Jacob
physical_description: middling stature and rather stout; has large eyes, thick lips
full_text: £2 REWARD - Absconded on Monday the 30th of January last, my App JACOB, a Mosambique African, of a middling stature and rather stout; has large eyes, thick lips, and is a Shoemaker by Trade. Any person…prosecuted. CM VILLET. CT March 13 1837.

name: Willem
physical_description: light yellow complexion, blond hair and whiskers
clothing: white duffle jacket, drab trousers, and red cap
full_text: TWENTY RDS - Absconded since one month, from the service of A M'Donald, Esq. the U's App, WILLEM, of this Colony, has light yellow complexion, blond hair and whiskers, was dressed in a white duffle jacket, drab trousers, and red cap; it is supposed that he accompanied a Girl to Graham's Town. Any person...prosecuted. The Widow GYSB. VAN RENEN. CT March 30 1837.

name: Baatjoe
physical_description: aged, has tender eyes
clothing: leathern trousers, duffle jacket, Toudoe hat
intentions: Wynberg; pretends to be a coolie
full_text: FIVE RDS REWARD - Absconded from the U, his App, BAATJOE, of Boegis, a Mason; he is aged, has tender eyes, and was dressed in leathern trousers and duffle jacket, with a Toudoe on his head; he pretends to be a Coolie, and frequents the environs of Wynberg. - Any person...prosecuted. JA VAN BREDA. Garden de Hoop, March 29, 1837.

name: Zidien
physical_description: weak eyes, feet bent inwards
clothing: Sailor's jacket with large buttons, leathern trousers, toudoe hat
full_text: THIRTY RDS REWARD - Absconded, Zidien, alias Abdol, a Mosambique African, 20 years old, has weak eyes, and feet bent inwards; was dressed in a Sailor's jacket, with large buttons and leathern trousers, and a toudoe on his head. Jardine, alias Job, an African, 18 years old; squints a little, is of short stature, and roams in CT. Piet, an Indentured Hottentot, 15 years old; has a scab on his head, and was dressed in a blue duffle jacket, leathern trousers, and a striped shirt; is supposed to be at Groenekloof - Those harbouring...prosecuted. S V RENEN. Hoog Constantia, April 15, 1837.

name: Jardine
physical_description: squints a little, short stature

name: Piet
physical_description: scab on his head
clothing: blue duffle jacket, leathern trousers, striped shirt

name: Marcus
physical_description: pock-marked, sore on his left hip, stumpy fingers
full_text: TWENTY-FIVE RDS REWARD - Absconded since six months the Undersigned's App MARCUS, of Mosambique; he is pock-marked, stutters a little, has a sore on his left hip, and stumpy fingers - Those…rewarded. The Widow J MECHAU. Bottelary, District of Stellenbosch, April 19 1837.

name: Louis
physical_description: duffle jacket, leather trousers, red cap
full_text: ABSCONDED - my app, LOUIS; was dressed in a duffle jacket, leather trousers, and had a red cap on. On his former desertion he roamed about at Visschershok, pretending to be a free person - those lodging…rewarded. The Widow PC HAMMES. Cape Town, 20 April, 1837.

name: Adonis
physical_description: small and lean stature, one short leg, walks lame
full_text: ABSCONDED two months ago, my herdsman named Adonis, of Mosambique, old about 50 years, of small & lean stature, has one short leg, and walks lame, was formerly the property of Mr Cornelis Brink, of Groot Drakenstein. Any person lodging…or to my farm "Schoongezigt" in the District Stellenbosch, will be rewarded...prosecuted. AP CLOETE.

name: Hercules
physical_description: small stature
full_text: ABSCONDED since the beginning of January last, my App HERCULES, about 15 years old, of a small stature; he was seen at MR FRONEMAN'S, at River Zoner Einde, to whome he wanted to hire himself as a Free Person, under the name of Hendrik. - Also, since the 15th of last month, my App LEANDER, formerly the property of Mr S HEUSER, and ADRIAAN; - the first named is crooked, has black whiskers, and wears a red handkerchief round his head - Adriaan is of a strong stature, a Mosambique African, and has curled hair; Leander and Adriaan has marks on their shoulders of former punishments - Those lodging...rewarded. Stellenbosch May 1 1837. PH FAURE.

name: Leander
physical_description: crooked, black whiskers, marks on shoulders from punishment
clothing: red handkerchief

name: Adriaan
physical_description: strong stature, curled hair, marks on shoulders from punishment

name: Martinus
full_text: ABSCONDED - The U's App MARTINUS, about 14 years old, much resembling a bastard Hottentot - Any person lodging him in Prison…prosecuted. N HOFMEYR. Garden situate in Hof-street, April 28, 1837.

name: Jan
full_text: ABSCONDED since the month of April, my App JAN, he much resembles a bastard Hottentot, and has lately been seen at Hottentots Holland, where it is supposed that he is harboured - Any person…bringing him to Mr J DESVAGES, in CT…Rewarded. W MORKEL, Hs. River Zonder Einde.

name: UNKOWN
physical_description: strong stature, long curled hair and roguish appearance, walks with his head bent downwards
clothing: grey cloth jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED on the 30th April last, an African Apprentice of strong stature, long curled hair and roguish appearance, walks with his head bent downwards, was dressed in a grey cloth jacket, and accompanied by a small, lean female Hottentot; those bringing...rewarded. Paarl 5 May 1837. PJ DE VILLIERS, Ps.

name: David
physical_description: middle stature, dark brown complexion, long curled hair, scar under one of his eyes, scar on his chin
intentions: Koopman's River; Cape Districts; hires himself as Prize Negro
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD - Absconded, since the 2d April last, my App DAVID, a Madagascar African, 17 years old, of middle stature, and dark brown complexion, has long curled hair, and a scar under one of his eyes, caused by the kick of a horse, and also a scar on his chin; he is supposed to have proceeded with a Trader's wagon to the Koopman's River, but to now again be in the Districts close to Cape Town, where he hires himself as a Prize Negro - Any person lodging him...prosecuted. Paardeberg, May 20 1837. MM BASSON.

name: Damon
full_text: TEN RDS REWARD - Absconded since 15th March, 1837, my App DAMON, a Cooper, formerly the property of Mr WA MARAIS - Those detaining…lodging in Stellenbosch Prison shall receive the reward. JH NEETHLING, Ms. Neethling's Hof, June 19, 1837.

name: Frederick
full_text: ABSCONDED from the service of Mr A Brown, the U's app FREDERICK - Any person lodging him in prison will be rewarded; and those harbouring him prosecuted. ABM. BRINK.

name: Jacob
physical_description: about 5 ft 9 in high, not stout, yet strong make, fine white teeth, large hands and feet, small yet black prominent spot on the bone below his right eye
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U's farm, on Wed 12th inst, the App in his service named JACOB, a native of this Colony, but much resembling a Mosambique; he is about 5 ft 9 in high, about _ years old, and though not stout, yet strong make; has fine white teeth, large hands and feet, and may be further identified by a small yet black prominent spot on the bone below his right eye; he is supposed to have accompanied a Hottentot, his wife, and a Hottentot lad, and to have gone in the direction of Tulbagh - Any person...prosecuted. STEPH. G. JOUBERT, Gs. Farm De Hoop, Paardenberg, at Malmesbury. July 22, 1837.

name: Joemat
physical_description: middle stature, yellow complexion, flat face, and small eyes
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U, on the 19th July last, his App. Named Joemat, a Shoemaker, of middle stature, yellow complexion, flat face, and small eyes; has some resemblance to a Chinese - Any person…prosecuted. Tockai, 26 July, 1837. PW EKSTEEN.

name: Telemachus
full_text: DESERTED since the 8th May last, and supposed to be in the direction of Groenekloof, my Apprentice, by name TELEMACHUS (Wagon-driver) - Whoever …prosecuted. Widow D PALLAS. Strand-street, CT, 3d May, 1837.

name: Apollos
physical_description: short stout figure, black colour, curled hair
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 30th July last, the U's app APOLLOS, he is 20 years old, of a short stout figure, black color, and has curled hair. - Whoever lodges him in Prison or brings him to the U, …prosecuted. JC KRIEGLER. Wagonmakers Valley, Aug 16, 1837.

name: Joseph
physical_description: short stature
clothing: whitish moleskin Jacket, ravenduck Trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, my App JOSEPH, of Mosambique, about 50 years, of short stature, a Baker and Basket maker by trade, was dressed in a whitish moleskin Jacket, and ravenduck Trousers. Having deserted after the discovery of a theft committed by him, it is requested not to harbour him...rewarded. JA BAM. CT Aug 29 1837. [UPDATE 1838 0302: {45 years old?}, formerly the property of Mrs the Widow DEKENAH]

name: William Muns
physical_description: 4 feet 5 inches in height, marks from ear to ear from Scrofula, right eye diseased, mark like a cut on the right side of his chin 2 inches long, light brown hair
clothing: new suit of dark drab colour Fustian, seal skin cap, black silk handkerchief
full_text: ABSCONDED, my Juvenile Apprentice WILLIAM MUNS, aged 14 years, 4 feet 5 inches in height, marks from ear to ear from Scrofula, the right eye also deseased, a mark like a cut on the right side of his chin, 2 inches long, light brown hair; was dressed in a new suit of dark drab color Fustian, seal skin cap and a black silk handkerchief on his neck. Any person...rewarded. GEO. TWYCROSS. {{{1839 0503 - once deserted at Groene Kloof, and then to Zwartland}}}

name: Cesar (Caesar)
physical_description: dark brownish color, middling size, and tender make
clothing: white duffle jacket, red handkerchief
full_text: ABSCONDED about a month ago from the Shamble No 6, the U's App, CESAR, about 22 years old, of a dark brownish color, middling size, and tender make. He was dressed in a white duffle jacket, had a red handkerchief on his head, and was formerly in the service of Mr GABRIEL LOUW - Those lodging...prosecuted. F VAN REENEN. CT Sept 25 1837.

name: Adam
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 4th inst, the U's app, ADAM {Dutch AWIE}, a Coachman, whoever lodges…rewarded. 5 Oct 1837. HA SANDENBERGH

name: Goliath (repeat)
full_text: 75 RDS REWARD - Absconded, my Apps, GOLIATH and EDUARD, Tailors and JOSEPH, a Wagondriver; the 2 first are supposed to be harboured in Town, and the latter in the Cape Downs - those apprehending them will receive the above Reward; or for each 25 rds. Valkenburg, Oct 10, 1837. C MOSTERT.

name: Slinger
presents_as: wife presents as a free person/apprentice
physical_description: lost all his underteeth, bald head
clothing: leathern trousers, blue duffle jacket, red handkerchief round the head
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U since the 16th instant, an Indentured Hottentot, named SLINGER, he was dressed in leathern trousers, blue duffle jacket, and had a red handkerchief round the head; he lost all his under teeth, and has a bald head; his wife, ROSELYN, who pretends to be a Free Person, but has much the appearance of an Apprentice, went with him, and committed theft before Absconding – Any person lodging them in Prison will be Rewarded, those harbouring them Prosecuted. M Jurgens, Sen. Garden Vredehoek, Oct 17, 1837. {{Roselyn not included as only a suspected apprentice}} [_394A]

name: Cupido
physical_description: long and thin stature, yellow complexion, bald head
clothing: cap
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD - Absconded, since the 24th Dec 1836, my App CUPIDO, of a long and thin stature, yellow complexion, and has a bald head; he generally wears a cap, resembles a half-caste, and was formerly the property of Mr Isaac Cornelis De Villiers, of Drakenstein - Those lodging...prosecuted. PJ MARAIS. Coetzenburg, near Stellenbosch, 1 Nov 1837.

name: Titus
physical_description: strong stature, yellow complexion, red eyes, pointed beard
full_text: THE U's App TITUS, a native of this Colony, has absconded on Monday, the 6th inst, with his wife; he is of strong stature, yellow complexion, has red eyes, and wears a pointed beard as a Malay. Any person…prosecuted. AJ MEYBURG. Tygerberg 8 Nov 1837. {{{NB there is a female app, Diana, captured in Caledon - see GG 18380420 - possibly the wife? perhaps not as not mentioned...}}}

name: Hagar
physical_description: black curled hair
clothing: black gown
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 1st November 1837, my App named HAGAR, 15 years old, having black curled hair, and was dressed in a black gown; also my indentured Hottentot named WILLEM BLOMBERG, 18 years old, of yellow complexion and thin stature. Whoever lodges them in Prison will receive a Reward of Twenty Rds, and those bringing them to my farm at the Paarl, Forty Rds. Paarl, 3 Nov, 1837. J RETIEF.

name: Willem Blomberg
physical_description: yellow complexion and thin stature

name: Flux
physical_description: stout stature
clothing: wears generally a straw hat, trimmed with a ribbon
full_text: ABSCONDED, since 19th March 1837, my App named FLUX, born at Mosambique, 42 years old, of stout stature, wears generally a straw hat, trimmed with a ribbon, and formerly the property of Messrs Adriaan de Waal and Stephanus Malan(n), of Koeberg. He is supposed to pass himself as a Free Person - Any person lodging...prosecuted. R CLOETE. Brewery, Nov 14 1837. {Lisa - 2197??}

name: Edward Trubshaw
physical_description: stout stature, light hair
clothing: brown bombazet jacket, white shirt on which is his name, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED - EDWARD TRUBSHAW, Juvenile Emigrant Apprentice, about 14 years of age, stout stature, light hair, was dressed in brown bombazet jacket, white shirt, on which is his name, and straw hat - Field Cornets and others…send him to Rustenberg, Stellenbosch. GH DE WET.

name: Martinus
physical_description: yellow colour, middling stature
clothing: white duffle jacket, moleskin waistcoat, leathern trousers, white hat
intentions: Hires himself as a bastard; Constantia former service
full_text: ABSCONDED - since the 15th inst, my App MARTINUS, formerly the property of Mr JA DREYER, Ts. Near Constantia; - he was apprehended about three weeks ago at Mr P De Villiers, Banghoek, near Stellenbosch, where he hired himself as a Bastard Hottentot. Was dressed at the time of his absconding in a white duffle jacket, moleskin waistcoat, leathern trousers and had a white hat on; is of a yellow colour, and of middling stature. - Those lodging....prosecuted. HJ HOFMEYR. Weltevreden No 30 1837.

name: John Lapham
physical_description: 5 1/2 feet long, fair complexion
clothing: brown duffle jacklet, dark moleskin trousers, straw hat
intentions: Uses a different name; possibly armed
full_text: ABSCONDED, a Juvenile Emigrant named JOHN LAPHAM, (who on his second desertion passed himself by the name of John Thompson) he is about 19 years old, 5 1/2 feet long, and of fair complexion; was dressed in a brown duffle jacklet, dark moleskin trousers, and had a straw hat on. He is supposed to have taken with him a single barreled Gun - All persons...prosecuted. JP CLOETE. Groot Constantia, 27 Nov 1837.

name: David
physical_description: short and thick stature, holds his eyes half shut, one of his toes is inwardly bent
clothing: blue checked shirt, leathern trousers, drab hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 18th inst, my App DAVID, of Mosambique, of a short and thick stature, holds his eyes half shut, and one of his toes is inwardly bent; he was dressed in a blue checked shirt, leathern trousers, and had a drab hat on - Those…prosecuted. J DE VILLIERS. Klain Drakenstein, 29 Nov 1837.

name: Casper
physical_description: brown colour, mark on his forehead
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 17th January last, the U's App, CASPER, 23 years old, brown color, and has a mark on his forehead. Those lodging…prosecuted. RJ LOEDOLFF. Garden Uitkyk, 1 Feb 1838.

name: Rogers
physical_description: short stature, red hair, freckles on his face
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 15th Jan last, the U's indentured Settler, named Rogers, about 18 years old, of short stature, red hair, and has freckles on his face; he took with him 30 Rds belonging to different persons. Wynberg. TF DREYER, Senior.

name: April
physical_description: middling length, bare spot at the back of his head, marked on one cheek
other_description: witty, difficult of speech and fond of {ardent?} spirits
intentions: Cape Town; hires himself as Prize Negro
full_text: ABSCONDED, since September last, near Salt River, my App named APRIL, of Mosambique, of middling length, has a bare spot at the back of his head and is marked on one cheek, he is witty, difficult of speech and fond of {ardent?} spirits [sterke drank]; it is supposed that he has hired himself as a Prize Negro in the vicinity of Cape Town - Those lodging...prosecuted. MATTHYS M LOUW. Klein Drakenstein.

name: Edward Hayman
physical_description: red hair, freckles in the face
full_text: NOTICE Absconded, since the 20th Feb last, my App EDWARD HAYMAN, he has red hair and freckles in the face; said App has been absent 3 weeks before; and it has appeared on inquiry that there are persons harbouring and employing such Deserters, I consider it my duty to notify the same, and to warn such person or persons, that in the event of a similar recurrence, they will be prosecuted according to law. D CLOETE, Ds. Mariendal, District Klapmuts, 1 March, 1838.

name: Pieter Johan de Vilante
full_text: NOTICE - PIETER JOHAN DE VILANTE, a Native of Italy, who Indentured himself to the U on the 1st July 1837, for three years, having Absconded on the 18th inst., any person…will be rewarded by JM BRINK. Groot Drakenstein, March 19, 1838.

name: Mentor
physical_description: right leg bent inward, mark under his left eye
clothing: new leathern trousers and half worn kersey jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED - The App MENTOR, his right leg is bent inward, he has a mark under his left eye, and was dressed, on absconding, in new leathern trousers and half worn kersey jacket - Any person…rewarded. Moddergat, 2 April, 1838. CW LIEBETRAU.

name: Unnamed
physical_description: short stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, in February, 1837, my App, of short stature, much resembling a Hottentot, and is harboured at Saldanha Bay. Any person…rewarded. Koeberg, 8 April, 1838. SS LOMBARD.

name: Philip
physical_description: short stature
clothing: brown duffle jacket, leather trousers, red cap
full_text: RDS 10 REWARD - Absconded, since the 4th Feb last, my App, PHILIP, a Tailor, of short stature, and dressed in a brown duffle jacket, leather trousers and red cap - Any person…reward. H CLOETE, Ps.

name: July
physical_description: short and stout stature, yellow complexion, pearl on his left eye
full_text: ABSCONDED, on Sunday, the 5th Nov, 1837, my App JULY, of a short and stout stature, yellow complexion, and has a pearl on his left eye; he was formerly a Slave of Mr GREFFRATH, Sen. Any person…prosecuted. PJ WAHL. Blaauweberg, Cape District, 13 April, 1838.

name: Salomon
physical_description: about 5 feet
clothing: leathern trousers, moleskin jacket, white shirt, and white cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 5th inst, the U's App SALOMON, a Mosambique African, he is about 5 feet, and was dressed in leathern trousers, moleskin jacket, white shirt, and white cap. Those lodging…prosecuted. JJ BOSMAN, Js. Bottelary, 8 April, 1838. [My note: Haazendal?]

name: Jacob
physical_description: middling and rather stout stature
clothing: blue jacket, leather trousers, red handkerchief
intentions: Simon's Town; hires himself as a free person named Hendrik Johannes
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 3d Feb last, my App, JACOB, formerly of Mr H de Neecker, - is of a middling and rather stout stature, has the appearance of a Bastard, is about 36 years old, and was dressed in a blue jacket, leather trousers, and had a red handkerchief on his head; said Jacob has lately hired himself as a free person under the name of Hendrik Johannes, to Mr J Munnik, at Bass Herman Kraal, and is still lodging about in the vicinity of Simon's Town. The U therefore requests...prison. JM BRINK. Groot Drakenstein, April 18, 1838.

name: Fredrik
physical_description: yellow complexion
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD - Absconded , on the 5d instant, my App FREDRIK, formerly of Mr CM Pietersen, of yellow complexion, and has lately been seen in Cape Town. AJ VAN DER BYL, As. Klapmuts, April 15, 1838.

name: Jephta
physical_description: squints, brown curled hair, short and stout made, walks with his legs bent inwards
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 9th inst, my App JEPHTA, from this Colony, about 20 years old, squints, has brown curled hair, is short and stout made, walks with his legs bent inwards, has some resemblance to a Hottentot, and is supposed to hire himself as such. Any person...prosecuted. DJ LE ROEX. Wagonmaker's Valley, 30 April, 1838.

name: Africa
physical_description: somewhat yellow complexion
full_text: ABSCONDED, my App AFRICA, of somewhat yellow complexion, formerly a slave of Mr CH Esterhuysen. Any person…reward of 15 Rds. Widow J MECHAU. District of Stellenbosch.

name: Willem
physical_description: dark color, middle stature
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 6th March last, my App WILLEM, about 30 years old, of Mosambique extraction, dark color, and middle stature. A female Hottentot, name Vytjie, of short stature, accompanied him. Any person…prosecuted. DIRK DE VOS. Hex River, May 1, 1838.

name: Isaak
physical_description: yellow complexion, and has a scar near his eye
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD - Absconded, my App ISAAK, of yellow complexion, stammers, and has a scar near his eye; three dogs accompany him - Those bringing…20Rds…prosecuted. GA HAUBTFLEISH. Wagonmaker's Valley, 13 May, 1838.

name: Aron
physical_description: middle and lean stature, thin face, crooked nose
full_text: ABSCONDED, since September 1837, my App ARON, formerly the property of the late Isaak van Heerden, Sen, of a middle and lean stature, a thin face, and crooked nose; those lodging…prosecuted. Hex River, 1 May 1838. P MEIRING.

name: William Wake
physical_description: full countenance, stout make
clothing: checked trousers, leather frock, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, the U's App named WILLIAM WAKE, about 15 years old, of full countenance, stout make, and was dressed in checked trousers, leather frock, and a straw hat on; all persons…prison. RH MYBURGH. Elsenburg, 28 May, 1838.

name: Mattheus
physical_description: black complexion
clothing: new kersey jacket, new leathern trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, from the U's Farm OLIFANTS FONTEIN, at Zwartland, since April last, two Apps named MATTHEUS and DOLLIE; both were recently seen on the road to Saldanha Bay. Mattheus is of black complexion, about 20 years old; Dollie is of yellow complexion, both were dressed in new kersey jackets, and new leathern trousers. A Hottentot named HANS NIEUWVELD, likewise absconded since the 11th June last, and took with him two black Bastard Cows, and a black speckled Calf, entrusted to his care, to be brought to Zwartland. Any person..or Mr PG van Breda, at Zwartland...liberally rewarded. JA VAN BREDA.

name: Dollie
physical_description: yellow complexion
clothing: new kersey jacket, new leathern trousers

name: Hans Nieuwveld
items_taken: two black Bastard Cows, black speckled Calf

name: Jan Davitz
items_taken: three cows, and a black, white backed Ox, with crooked horns pointing towards the head
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U, a Hottentot named JAN DAVITZ - he took with him three cows, and a black, white backed Ox, with crooked horns pointing towards the head. All persons are requested to detain them. J VAN REENEN, Fs.

name: Afrika
physical_description: black complexion, walks rather lame
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 9th inst, my App AFRIKA, of this Colony, of black complexion, walks rather lame, and was formerly the property of Mr Thielman De Villiers.

name: Jack
physical_description: good physiognomy
clothing: kersey or leathern jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED, 14 days since, my App named JACK, a native of Mosambique, formerly the property of Mr Jacs. LOUW, of Rondeberg - he was dressed either in a kersey or leathern jacket, has a good physiognomy, and is 35 years old. - Any person…Prosecuted. FLC BICCARD. Rozenboom, Tygerberg, Aug 11, 1838.

name: Hector
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 8th August last, my App HECTOR, (a Painter), formerly of Mr RAUCH; any person…prosecuted. Rondebosch, Sept 6, 1838. J MEYER.

name: David
physical_description: black complexion, short stature
items_taken: two cows; the one red and the one red with a white back
full_text: NOTICE. AN Apprentice, who hired himself to the U as Herdsman, by the name of DAVID, has absconded on Sunday, the 7th inst, with two cows; the one red and the one red with a white back. - He is of a black complexion, short stature, and is accompanied by a Hottentot girl named Mietje. Any person...rewarded. - Apply to T MORRIS, Wynberg, or MM LOUW, Klein Drakenstein.

name: Aap
clothing: drab trousers, blue jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE the 7th instant, the U's apprenticed Hottentot AAP, about 14 years old, has much the resemblance of a Mosambique, and was dressed in drab trousers, and blue jacket. - Those lodging…prosecuted. CT, Nov 14 1838. PU FISCHER.

name: Henry Vine
clothing: white Duck trousers, moleskin Jacket, brown cloth waistcoat, black silk stock, - wears a "palmiet" hat
items_taken: Pointer Dog, answering to the name of "Fear Not", with a tin collar round the neck
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 4th March, my Apprenticed Juvenile Emigrant HENRY VINE; he is about 14 years old, was dressed in white Duck trousers, moleskin Jacket, brown cloth waistcoat, and black silk stock, - wears a "palmiet" hat, and has taken with him a Pointer Dog, answering to the name of "Fear Not", with a tin collar round the neck. Those lodging said App with me...prosecuted. PFR DE VILLIERS. Paarl, March 16 1839.

name: Lendor
full_text: ABSCONDED, LENDOR, late Apprentice of Mr MARTHINUS VAN DER SPUY, of Koeberg, and FLORIS, late Apprentice of Mr DE VILLIERS, at Jonkershoek, both indentured to the Undersigned for the term of One Year, by Contracts, severally bearing the date of the 28th and 29th December last, executed before DJ CLOETE, Esq. Clerk of the Peace, having, on the 4th instant, left his service. Notice is hereby gives, that those harbouring them will be prosecuted. J VAN REENEN, Fs. CT, March 21 1839.

name: William Richard Bay
physical_description: fair and rather handsome countenance
full_text: A RUN-AWAY JUVENILE APPRENTICE. A JUVENILE APPRENTICE, by the name of William Richard Bay, about 13 years of age, and of a fair and rather handsome countenance, has absented himself, with another person called John Stone, of a tall, red and sailor-like appearance, from the service of the U; and as it is surmised, from the things which they carried with them, that they must have proceeded into the Interior of the Country; {{{yes, to Caledon}}} so the U kindly requests that if any Person might fall in with the said Bay, he would be so kind as to detain or lodge him in the first Prison, and give the U notice of it. Great Constantia, March, 1839. JP CLOETE.

name: Charles George
physical_description: black whiskers
clothing: new pair of leathern trousers, white shirt, blue waistcoat
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 30th April last, the following Apprenticed Servants Absconded themselves from the place Bergvliet, viz. - 1. Charles George, alias Tjalie [Charlie?], resembles a Malabar, with black whiskers, and dressed with a new pair of leathern trousers, white shirt, and blue waistcoat. 2. James Benjamin, 16 years old, dressed with a pair of new leathern trousers, white shirt, moleskin jacket, and a cap on his head. 3. Joseph Benjamin, alias Joo, big and strong, and has marks on his face, dressed with new leathern trousers, and white shirt. The abovementioned persons have lately arrived here from St. Helena, and speak the English language - Those apprehending them and lodging them in Prison, or bringing them to teh undersigned, will be Rewarded. JP EKSTEEN. Bergvliet, May 1, 1839.

name: James Benjamin
clothing: new leathern trousers, white shirt, moleskin jacket, cap

name: Joseph Benjamin
physical_description: big and strong, and has marks on his face
clothing: new leathern trousers, white shirt

name: William Mimms (previous Muns)
physical_description: 4 feet 7 inches in height, a mark, from ear to ear from scrofula and an accident, a mark of a cut on the right side of his chin 2 inches long, right eye rather sore, light brown hair
clothing: blue jacket, brown cloth cap
intentions: Groenekloof and Zwartland on former desertion
full_text: ABSCONDED. WILLIAM MIMMS, Juvenile Apprentice of the U, aged 16 years, 4 feet 7 inches in height, a mark, from ear to ear from scrofula and an accident, a mark of a cut on the right side of his chin 2 inches long, right eye rather sore, light brown hair, was dressed, on his leaving, with a blue jacket and brown cloth cap, and took with him a small sack with old clothes; once deserted at Groene kloof, and then to Zwartland, was seen last week to Wynberg. Any person apprehending...prosecuted. GEORGE TWYCROSS. {{Update 18291129 - Looks like a young sailor - lately has been seen at Mr Taylor's, behind the Castle, also at Hottentots Holland.}}

name: William Richard Bay
full_text: JUVENILE APPRENTICE. AS the same Juv App, named WILLIAM RICHARD BAY, whose desertion was advertised in the Zuid-Afrikaan of the 29th March, and who has since been apprehended at Caledon, has again absented himself from his employer's service; so the U will feel thankful to any person who ight fall in with him...notice of it. JP CLOETE. Great Constantia. June 11, 1839.

name: Joe Benjamin (Joseph)
physical_description: long stature
clothing: leathern trousers, white shooting jacket, Scotch cap
full_text: £5 REWARD - ABSCONDED, from the Farm "Bergvliet," about 8 days ago, the following apprenticed Laborers, viz: - 1. Joe Benjamin, of long stature, - dressed in leathern trousers, white shooting jacket, and had a Scotch cap on his head. 2 Jane Benjamin, 16 years old, - dressed in leathern trousers, and had a Scotchcap on his head. 3. Tjalie - has the appearance of a Malabar - dressed as above. 4. Thom Stephen - dressed as above. Said apprentices have lately been imported from St Helena and speak the English language. 5. Edmund, a Juvenile Emigrant - dressed in leathern trousers, duffle jacket, and had a Malay hat on. Whoever apprehend the above 5 persons, and deliver them in the Wynberg or CT Prison, or to the U at Bergvliet, will receive a Reward of £5. JP EKSTEEN, J. Ps. Bergvliet, June 25, 1839.

name: Jane (sic) Benjamin (James)
clothing: leathern trousers, Scotchcap

name: Tjalie (Charles George)
clothing: leathern trousers, Scotchcap

name: Thom Stephen
clothing: leathern trousers, Scotchcap

name: Edmund
clothing: leathern trousers, duffle jacket, Malay hat

name: Anton Daubern
full_text: ABSCONDED. WHEREAS ANTON DAUBERN, a Native of Germany, and contracted Servant to THOS. TENNANT and JAMES MAC CABE, having absconded from their service since the 1st day of his arrival here, and is now supposed to be living at or near Cape Town. THIS IS TO GIVE NOTICE, That any person found harbouring or employing the said Anton Daubern, without the sanction of his legal Masters, will be prosecuted at law for all losees, costs, and damages sustained by them. A REWARD of One Pound (20B.??) will be paid to any person giving such information as may lead to the apprehension of the said Anton Daubern. THOS TENNANT.

name: Sarah
full_text: ABSCONDED from the service of the U, since Saturday last, SARAH, an indentured servant - She is 12 years of age and of Hottentot origin and is supposed to be harbouring herself in the Cape Flats - Any person lodging her in one of HM Gaols will be rewarded, but those detaining her after this notice will be prosecuted according to law. JG ASPELING.

name: James Sherman
physical_description: slender shaped, full of marks of small pox, light hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE about a month, the Juvenile App JAMES SHERMAN, aged 13 years, has absented himself from the service of the U, - he is slender shaped, full of marks of small pox, and has light hair. It is supposed that he detains himself at Tulbagh, and has entered into service at that place - the person imprisoning...prosecuted. B DANIEL, No 12 Church Street, CT, August 6, 1839.

name: John Harris
physical_description: visible mark on one of his temples as if it has been burnt {brown complexion, with a scar under his left eye}
clothing: Moleskin {moleskin jacket and trousers}
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U, about a month ago, JOHN HARRIS, 12 years old, a native of St Helena, dressed in Moleskin, he has a visible mark on one of his temples as if it has been burnt; and EDMUND a Juvenile Emigrant, about 18 years, dressed in blue Moleskin and straw hat - Those apprehending...a reward of One Pound Sterling. JP EKSTEEN. Bergvliet, October 17, 1839. {{{Mother SARA HARRIS places an ad 1840 0207 - ABSCONDED about 3 months ago from the service of Mr J Paulus Eksteen, of Bergvliet, my son JOHN HARRIS, aged about 14 years, brown complexion, with a scar under his left eye, was dressed in a moleskin jacket and trousers. Said John was imported from St Helena by Mr Eksteen - The U kindly requests every person who can give any information about her said son to lodge the same at the place of Mr SV CLOETE, at Wynberg, for which she will feel herself very grateful. SARA HARRIS.

name: Edmund
clothing: blue Moleskin and straw hat

name: Jack Stockey
clothing: blue kersey Jacket and leathern Trowsers, Scotch cap, some Moleskin Clothing.
full_text: Absconded, THIS MORNING, two of my Juvenile Emigrants, JACK and DANIEL STOCKEY, 17 and 19 years old, were dressed in blue kersey Jackets and leathern Trowsers, DANIEL had a hat on his head and JACK a Scotch cap - Whoever lodges…Rewarded. JWJ VERSVELD. Klasenbosch, Oct 24, 1839. PS They also had with them some Moleskin Clothing.

name: Daniel Stockey
clothing: blue kersey Jacket and leathern Trowsers, cap, some Moleskin Clothing.

name: James Ferril
physical_description: cannot move the lids of one of his eyes which is rather smaller than the other, freckled in his face
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 11th inst, my Juvenile Emigrant, named JAMES FERRIL, betw 13 and 14 years old; he cannot move the lids of one of his eyes which is rather smaller than the other; he also is freckled in his face, and it has been reported that he has been seen at Gouwdine, in the District of Worcester. the person lodging...prosecuted. DS VAN DER MERWE. Wagonmaker's Valley, Oct 28, 1839.

name: Damon
physical_description: light colour, coarse hair
clothing: leathern Trousers, duffle Jacket, red Cap, white Shirt with the letter D on the back
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 18th October last, my App named Damon, aged 16 years, was dressed with a pair of leathern Trousers, duffle Jacket and a red Cap, a white Shirt with the letter D on the back, is of a light colour, coarse hair - A reward of pound 1 will be paid...Prisons. JG FISCHER. Kleine Bottelary, Oct 22, 1839.

name: James Sherman
physical_description: slender made, blue eyes, light hair, and pock fretten
full_text: ABSCONDED, about two months ago, the Emigrant, JAMES SHERMAN, 14 years of age, slender made, blue eyes, light hair, and pock fretten. B DANIEL. Cape Town, Curch-street, No 12.

name: George Hare
physical_description: has a slight mark from the root to the point of his nose, and on the back of his right hand scars from the bite of a dog
clothing: black cloth jacket, white cotton-velvet double-breasted waistcoat, dark brown striped trousers, blue striped shirt, and black neck handkerchief
full_text: REWARD OF £1. ABSCONDED, on Sunday, the 29th December last, GEORGE HARE, Juvenile App of the U, aged about 24 years, dressed in a black cloth jacket, white cotton-velvet double-breasted waistcoat, dark brown striped trousers, blue striped shirt, and black neck handkerchief, has a slight mark from the root to the point of his nose, and on the back of his right hand scars from the bite of a dog. Any person...Prosecuted. JT JURGENS.

name: David Boer
physical_description: shape tall and stout, colour brown
clothing: white duffel jacket, and skin trousers
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, on the 16th November last, from my service, the Hottentot DAVID BOER (calling himself Willem), shape tall and stout, colour brown, and was dressed in a white duffel jacket, and skin trousers; he has been seen in the District of Worcester - Whoever lodges...Reward. PE HAMMAN. Welgevalley, in the vicinity of Stellenbosch, Jan 11 1840.

name: Morley
clothing: white cloth jacket, striped coloured trousers, blue striped shirt, sailor's cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 2d January, two of my Emigrants, MORLEY AND HENRY CLARKE; the former about the age of 17, and the latter 13 years - Morley was dressed in a white cloth jacket, striped coloured trousers, blue striped shirt, and wore a sailor's cap; Henry Clarke a blue cloth jacket, white trousers, and had much the manners of a sailor - Any person giving information...the law. PM DREYER. Petersburg (near Wynberg) Cape District, January 16, 1840.

name: Henry Clarke
other_description: much the manners of a sailor
clothing: blue cloth jacket, white trousers

name: Ruiter
physical_description: tall and slender stature
clothing: kersey trousers and jacket, blue kersey cap
full_text: DESERTED from my Service, from the farm Holsloot, Basin of Tulbagh, on the 6th January, 1840, a Hottentot, taking with him my gun and shot belt; the powder horn is a buffalo one, with an ivory stopper, and having on the bottom of it the name of Rademeyer. The gun is made according to the Zeeland pattern; the stock being split at the mussel, which is covered over with a piece of leather; in the but-end of the same a hole has been drilled - The Hottentot is of a tall and slender stature, was dressed in kersey trousers and jacket, had a blue kersey cap on his head, and goes by the name of RUITER - Whoever lodges...well rewarded. OT VAN NIEKERK. Tulbagh, Jan 8, 1840.

name: Margareth Mason
physical_description: brown complexion, about five feet high
clothing: black figured silk, white straw bonnet with black ribbon
full_text: ABSCONDED, since Monday, the 20th of January last, the App of the U, named Margareth MASON, native of St Helena, brown complexion, about five feet high, dressed in black figured silk, a white straw bonnet with black ribbon - Whoever lodges…rewarded. Jan 30 1840. R LOEDOLFF.

name: Jan Afrikaander
clothing: new drab duffle jacket, black striped waistcoat, blue gambroon trousers, drab hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, in the night between the 22d and 23d February instant, from the U's, his Apprenticed Bastard, Jan Afrikaander, having with him a Bastard girl called Fytjie, likewise apprenticed to the U. Afrikaander was dressed in a new drab duffle jacket, black striped waistcoat, blue gambroon trousers, and had a drab hat on. Said FYTJIE has an observable mark on her right thumb, caused by the whitlow, and a scar on the back of her neck caused by burning. Whoever lodges...handsomely rewarded. G COETZEE, Js. Matjiesfontein, District George, Ward Mossle Bay, Feb 25 1840. NB The girl is the wife of a late apprentice Jonas, at present in my service, has left him and children, and deserted with her present spouse.

name: Fytjie
physical_description: mark on her right thumb caused by the whitlow, and a scar on the back of her neck caused by burning

name: Machin Racheera
physical_description: 5 3/4 feet in length, marked Z on the left breast, several marks on his forehead and nose
clothing: striped cotton shirt, new moleskin trousers and jacket, soldier's cap
location: Cape Town, corner Loop and Shortmarket
full_text: DESERTED. On Monday last, my Negroe Apprentice MACHIN RACHEERA, aged 24 years, 5 3/4 feet in length, marked Z on the left breast, and having several marks on his forehead and nose, he was dressed in a striped cotton shirt, new moleskin trousers and jacket, and a soldier's cap - Whoever returns...rewarded. PJ HAUPT. Corner of Loop and shortmarket streets.

name: Denampeda
physical_description: a little taller than 5 feet and 1 inch high
clothing: blue cloth Jacket, striped Shirt, black Stock, black Hat, Duck Trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON Sunday the 15th inst, the Prize Negroe Apprentices of the Undersigned, the one named DENAMPEDA, and the other KAMOASA, dressed in a blue cloth Jacket, striped Shirt, black Stock, black Hat, and Duck Trowsers; - KAMOASA has a ring in the left ear, is 5 feet and 1 inch high, and the other DENAMPEDA a little taller. Such person as shall return...rewarded. AP DE VILLIERS. Moddergat, March 19, 1840.

name: Kamoasa
physical_description: 5 feet and 1 inch high, ring in the left ear
clothing: blue cloth Jacket, striped Shirt, black Stock, black Hat, Duck Trousers

name: William Baker
physical_description: stout, some marks of the small pox on his face, dark brown hair, a sharp look
clothing: blue pair of trowsers, white shirt, topboots, straw hat with broad ribbon {brown jacket, white pair of trousers}
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE last Tuesday Afternoon, my Juvenile Apprentice WILLIAM BAKER, between 13 and 16 years of age, Coachman, is stout, and has some marks of the small pox in his face, he was dressed in a blue pair of trowsers, white shirt, a pair of topboots, and a straw hat with broad ribbon round the same, and resembles a sailor - whoever...rewarded. M JURGENS, Sen. Garden Vrede Hoek, March 26, 1840. {{{UPDATE 1840 0403 - since 24 March, betw 15 and 16 years, dark brown hair, a sharp look; according to information, has since put on a brown jacket, and a white pair of trousers, and much resembles a Sailor.}}}

name: Thomas Hemmings
physical_description: stout, light hair and eyes
clothing: coloured striped trousers
full_text: £1 REWARD - Absconded since Friday, the 27th March, THOMAS HEMMINGS, Apprentice, 18 (16?) years old, Baker; stout, light hair and eyes, dressed with a pair of colored striped trousers - He must have hired himself into the service of some baker or other - Whoever brings...rewarded. HO EKSTEEN.

name: Namaanda
physical_description: 5 feet 4 inches in height, marked Z on the right breast
clothing: duffle jacket and moleskin trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED. The Prize Negro NAMAANDA, dressed in a duffle jacket and moleskin trousers. He is 28 years old, 5 feet 4 inches in height and marked Z on the right breast - Whoever lodges…rewarded. A DE SMIDT. Great Schuur, Rondebosch, May 5 1840.

name: Marino
physical_description: stout, mark Z on right breast, bare spot on his head
clothing: black bombazett jacket, drab trousers, blue apron
full_text: ABSCONDED OR WANDERED. SINCE the 12th inst, MARINO, Prize Negroe of the U, is stout, aged 10 years; has the mark Z on his right breast, and a bare spot on his head; was dressed in a black bombazett jacket, drab trousers, and blue apron - Those returning...prosecuted. Vredehof, St John's Street, May 21, 1840.

name: Jambe
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 15th April last, JAMBE, formerly a Slave of Mr Jacobus ROEX, and now under contract to me. Any person…prison, or to… JACOBUS MARTHINUS THEUNISSEN, Ms. Hottentot's Holland, June 17, 1840.

name: Mayan Flam
physical_description: 5 feet 5 1/2 inches high, marked with Z on his left breast
full_text: STRAYED from the Farm of the U, a Negro named MAYAN FLAM, 5 feet 5 1/2 inches high, and marked with Z on his left breast - Whoever…rewarded. J VAN RENEN. Ganzekraal, District of Groenekloof.

name: Capindora
clothing: white Shirt, red cap, and skin jacket and trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED on Monday, the 20th July, a Prize Negro named Capindora, dressed in a white Shirt, red cap, and skin jacket and trousers - Any person…rewarded. JA BEYERS. Clapmuts.

name: Ballagua
physical_description: slender shaped, mark G on right breast, pearl on left eye
clothing: blue cloth jacket and drill trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED OR WANDERED. SINCE the 24th inst, the Prize Negro of the U, named BALLAGUA, slender shaped, 12 years old, has a mark G on his right breast, and a pearl on his left eye, was dressed in a blue cloth jacket and drill trousers - Any person…to law. PM TESSELAAR. Cape Town, No 14 Buitengracht.

name: Kammozoo
physical_description: tall and stout made, marked Z B on the right, and B on the left breast
clothing: kersey jacket under, leathern frock, leathern trousers, sailors' hat
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the service of the U, a Negro Apprentice named KAMMAZOO, tall and stout made, marked Z B on the right, and B on the left breast; was dressed in a kersey jacket under, and a leathern frock over the same; leathern trousers, and has a sailors' hat on - Any person...reward. MW THEUNISSEN. Hottentot's Holland, Sept 16, 1840.

name: Chio Chanduo (Anthony)
physical_description: short stature, many marks on his face
clothing: kersey jacket and leather trousers
full_text: [0925 DUTCH ONLY, 1009 REPEAT ENG WITH EXTRA DETAIL:] 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED since one month two Negro Apps CHIO CHANDUO and CADAOLO, alias ANTHONY and JACK, dressed in kersey jackets and leather trowsers. The firstnamed Anthony is of a short stature, has many marks on his face and is a famous rogue, having already broken out of the Negro Hospital, and is very well known. The last mentioned Jack is of a slender stature, smooth in his face, and has a very good appearance. Such persons...to law. WH THEUNISSEN, Sen. Rozeboom, Oct 6, 1840.

name: Cadaolo (Jack)
physical_description: slender stature, smooth in his face, very good appearance
clothing: kersey jacket and leather trousers

name: James Lamb
physical_description: 5 feet 5 inches in height, fair complexion
clothing: brown duffle jacket, dark coloured trousers and a grey cap
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED from my Service, my App, JAMES LAMB, 17 years of age, 5 feet 5 inches in height, fair complexion, had on when he left a brown duffle jacket, dark coloured trousers and a grey cap. A Reward of Rds 20 will be given to any person…Public Gaol. GEORGE HAVERY, Blacksmith. Stellenbosch, Nov 9, 1840.

name: Henry Vine (repeat)
physical_description: tender made, fair hair
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE the month of February last, my Juvenile Emigrant, HENRY VINE, aged about 15 years, tender made, and has fair hair. From the information received, there is reason to believe that he is at the Warm Bokkeveld, Division of Worcester, or hired himself there. Persons having opportunity...to law. PFR DE VILLIERS. Paarl, 18th November, 1840.

name: Thomas Cooper
physical_description: about 5 feet high, black curled hair, white face
clothing: drab moleskin jacket and trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 15th Nov last, one of my Juvenile Emigrants, named THOMAS COOPER, 15 years old, about 5 feet high, he has black curled hair, white face, and was dressed in a drab moleskin jacket and trowsers - Any person…prosecuted. P MARAIS. Groot Drakenstein, Dec 21, 1840.

name: Africa
physical_description: front teeth are very large and has a broken tooth on one side of his mouth
clothing: blue striped shirt, canvas trousers, white waistcoat
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 31st December, 1840, an Apprentice of the U, an Africander Mozambique Boy, about 12 years of age, named 'Africa'; - he was dressed in a blue striped shirt, canvas trousers, and white waistcoat; his front teeth are very large and has a broken tooth on one side of his mouth - Any person...Law. W HART, Jr. No 19 Wale Street, Cape Town.

name: William Barlow
physical_description: 4 feet high, rough hair, knees are bent in, one of his little toes is cut off
full_text: ABSCONDED, ABOUT five months ago, my Juvenile Immigrant, WILLIAM BARLOW, about 16 years old, and 4 feet high, he has rough hair, his knees are bent in, and one of his little toes is cut off. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. Koeberg, Jan 5, 1841. S. VAN BREDA, As.

name: Edward Harrison
physical_description: fair complexion
clothing: straw hat, white jacket, yellow waistcoat, light trousers and a pair of shoes
full_text: ABSCONDED on Saturday, 23d inst, EDWARD HARRISON, Juvenile Emigrant, 14 years old, fair complexion, had on a straw hat, white jacket, yellow waistcoat, light trousers and a pair of shoes - Any person…prosecuted. HA SANDENBERGH. Cape Town, Jan 27, 1841.

name: Jan Byleveld
physical_description: wound under the sole of the left foot
clothing: light blue jacket and trousers, white straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, on Wednesday, the 27th instant, a boy of 9 years old, named JAN BYLEVELD, was dressed with a light blue jacket and trowsers, and a white straw hat; has a wound under the sole of the left foot - he was seen on a wagon loaded with coals, for the Paarl, belonging to Mr HAUPT - The expences will be paid, to such person as shall bring him to Town, at the Shambles, No 1, by ABRAHAM MILES.

name: Eliza Foulger
physical_description: tall, strong, fair complexion, short brown hair, blue eyes
clothing: open straw bonnet, light printed dress
full_text: ABSCONDED from Hottentots Holland, on the 21st Jan last, two persons answering to the following descriptions: ELIZA FOULGER, Juvenile Emigrant, 17 years old, a tall strong girl, of fair complexion, short brown hair, blue eyes, wore an open straw bonnet and a light printed dress. JAMES SMITH, fisherman, a Native of Germany, his real name said to be JOACHIM CAREL THEODORE REICH, about 27 years of age, fair complexion, middle size with short neck. They were accompanied by a pack-ox, carrying luggage. The former is an Apprentice and has deserted, and the latter has connived at the desertion, and has harboured the said apprentice - Any information...received by Rev J EDGAR, Hottentots Holland, or Mr J BRESLER, 96 Long Street, Cape Town.

name: Wanoa
physical_description: middle stature, brown colour
clothing: leather jacket and trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED in the night of the 7th inst, 2 of my indentured Prize Negroes, named Wanoa, middle stature, brown colour, about 30 years of age, dressed in a leather jacket and Trousers; and JORRY, long stature, and black color, 22 years of age, dressed in a blue duffle jacket and leather trousers. Such persons returning them to the U or lodging them in one of the P...according to law. JJ MARAIS. Great Drakenstein, February 15, 1841.

name: Jorry
physical_description: long stature, black colour
clothing: blue duffle jacket, leather trousers

name: George Holmes
physical_description: marks of the Small Pox in the face and arms, figure as seamen usually have
full_text: ABSCONDED ON TUESDAY LAST. GEROGE HOLMES, an Apprentice of Mr JH WICHT, about 17 years of age, has marks of the Small Pox in the face and on the arms the same, figure as seamen usually have - He absented himself without his jacket or hat, and is supposed to be present in the vicinity of the Paarl. Whoever lodges...rewarded.

name: Charles Sickby
full_text: ABSCONDED, MY Juvenile Emigrant, CHARLES SICKBY, and having been informed that he detains himself at the Kars River, District of Caledon, all persons…to law. DD VOS. Hottentot's Holland.

name: Salimbo
full_text: ABSCONDED on Sunday last, our two Negro Apprentices SALIMBO and MOANEO - they are supposed to be in company with three other Negroes belonging to JH Versveld and N Colyn, Esqs, who have absconded at the same time - Any Person…Undersigned. JWJ VERSVELD, WJ VERSVELD. Clasenbosch, near Wynberg, March 9, 1841.

name: Lasooka
physical_description: marked on his right breast Z, short and stout, marks of the Small Pox visible on his face
clothing: skin clothes, kersey jacket, red cap, hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, two Apps belonging to the U, LASOOKA, marked on his right breast Z, short and stout, marks of the Small Pox visible on his face, and KANGA, with the letter C on his breast, slender make, smooth on the face, about 20 years old, dressed in skin clothes, kersey jackets, red caps and hats on their heads - Any person...rewarded. HJ MORKEL. Hottentot's Holland, March 6, 1841.

name: Kanga
physical_description: marked with the letter C on his breast, slender make, smooth on the face
clothing: skin clothes, kersey jacket, red cap, hat

name: Kareema
physical_description: marked M on his left breast, five feet four inches high
