full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 29th Feb, 1841, the Prize Negro App of the U, KAREEMA, about 20 years of age, marked M on his left breast, five feet four inches high - he was dressed in a blue kersey jacket, skin trousers, palmiet hat, and white duck trousers - Any person...prosecuted. DJ JOUBERT. Drakenstein, March 12, 1841.

name: Canchaba (Antonie)
physical_description: 5 feet and 1/2 inch high, marked Z on his left breast, many marks of the Small Pox, large holes in the ears
full_text: ABSCONDED, THE U's Prize Negro, CANCHABA, who calls himself Antonie; he is 20 years old, 5 feet and 1/2 inch high, and marked Z on his left breast; he has many marks of the Small Pox, large holes in the ears, and has last been seen at the Berg River - Any person lodging...to law. BH EYBERG. Groenrivier, District Malmesbury.

name: James
clothing: leathern trousers, black jacket and waistcoat, straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, the U's App, named JAMES, born at St Helena; was dressed in leathern trousers, black jacket and waistcoat, and a straw hat; speaks the Dutch language with an English accent - Any person lodging…Liesbeek River… rewarded. FJ KOTZE. - He has been formerly in the service of Mr S Van Renen, High Constantia.

name: Jacofo
physical_description: marked Z on the right breast
full_text: ABSCONDED, TWO months ago, one of my apps, called JACOFO, aged about 9 years, is marked Z on the right breast, and is, according to information, on one of the Country Places near to Simon's Town; - I therefore request…prosecution. JS KRIEGE.

name: John Butcher
physical_description: having red hair, large nose, middle stature
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED from the place of the U, on the night of the 28th April last, after having previously stolen some goods, two Emigrants, formerly in the service of Mr W Proctor, named JOHN BUTCHER, having red hair and a large nose, and JAMES BERTRAND, both of middle stature; - any person...authorities. FH SCHEUNDORFF, Fieldcornet. Mosselbank's River, May 12, 1841.

name: James Bertrand
physical_description: middle stature

name: William Smith
physical_description: short stature, very much marked with small pox
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED from the place Boschman's Kloof, behind the Frenchhoek Mountains, the Emigrant WILLIAM SMITH, of short stature, and very much marked with small pox. All persons…his Master. JC FAURE, Sen. Eerste River, May 10, 1841.

name: William Herpur
clothing: new Duffle Jacket, leathern trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 4th inst, from Bottelary, the Juvenile Emigrant, named WILLIAM HERPUR, old between 15 and 16 years; was dressed in a new Duffle Jacket and leathern trousers - Whoever lodges him…prosecuted. JG FISCHER. Klein Bottelary, July 17, 1841.

name: Chava
clothing: duffle Jacket, leathern trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED on the 20th July, my apprenticed Prize Negro named CHAVA, dressed in a duffle Jacket, and leathern trousers - Whoever…rewarded. JA BEYERS. Klapmuts, July 25, 1841.

name: Jacob
physical_description: brown complexion
clothing: leather trousers, white shirt, black gambroon jacket
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 10th August last, my App JACOB, about 14 years of age. He is of brown complexion, and was dressed in a pair of leather trousers, white shirt, and black gambroon jacket. Any person loding said JACOB in one of the prisons...law. CW LIEBETRAU. Moddergat, 27 Aug 1841.

name: Thomas Reilly
physical_description: much freckled, light hair, large mouth, nose rather flat, fair complexion
clothing: dark brown jacket, drab colored cloth trousers, oil cloth cap, Scotch tartan great coat, white trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON Saturday night, the 11th ult, my Juvenile Apprentice THOMAS REILLY, who was dressed in a dark brown jacket, drab colored cloth trousers, and oil cloth cap, besides he took with him a Scotch tartan great coat and white trousers, is much freckled, light hair, large mouth, nose rather flat, fair complexion, and frequently laughs when spoken to; whoever apprehends...law. R CROZIER. Boom-street, Cape Town.

name: Jeem Ben
physical_description: marks of Small Pox, black complexion
clothing: brown moleskin jacket, leathern trousers
full_text: £1 REWARD, ABSCONDED. JEEM BEN, apprenticed to the U by his parents, has absconded himself since 3d of August; was dressed in a brown moleskin jacket, and leathern trousers, is 17 years of age, has marks of Small Pox, and was abetted by a certain EDWARD, both from St Helena, he is of black complexion, and said to have been seen at Hottentot's Holland - Any person bringing... to Bergvliet... One Pound Sterling...to law. JP EKSTEEN, Bergvliet.

name: James Punt
physical_description: rather stout, light hair, blue eyes, ruddy complexion, several warts on his hands
clothing: drab coloured Moleskin Jacket, black do. Trousers, blue Cloth Cap
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON Sunday Morning, the 10th inst, my Juvenile App named JAMES PUNT, about 19 years old, rather stout, light hair, blue eyes, and ruddy complexion; has several warts on his hands; was dressed in a drab colored Moleskin Jacket, black do. trousers and blue Cloth Cap. Whoever apprehends the said app will be handsomely rewarded...to law. Garden "Maisonette" October 19, 1841. D KUYS.

name: Dennis Tidence
physical_description: short and stout make, broad face, marks of Small Pox
clothing: Moleskin Jacket, Canvas Trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED on Wednesday last, my Juvenile Emigrant DENNIS TIDENCE, aged 15 years, of a short and stout make, broad face and marks of Small Pox, lisps when speaking, and dressed in a Moleskin Jacket and Canvas pair of Trousers - Any person…rewarded. RJ LOEDOLFF. Garden Uitkyk, Nov 25, 1841.

name: Berrie
physical_description: marks of the Small Pox in his face
clothing: new mouse colour moleskin jacket, checked trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 20th Nov 1841, the Emigrant BERRIE, was dressed in a new moleskin jacket, mouse colour, and a pair of checked trousers; he is 17years of age, and has marks of the Small Pox in his face. Any person lodging him in Prison at Wynberg …will receive 10 shillings for his trouble...to law. Nov 22, 1841. WF VERSVELD.

name: Richard Kely
physical_description: drab cord velvet jacket, white shirt, leathern trousers, old straw hat
other_description: always keeps his mouth half shut so that two large front teeth are always visible
full_text: ABCONDED, ON the 15th December last, from the U, a Juvenile Emigrant named Richard Kely; he was dressed in a drab cord velvet jacket, white shirt, and leathern trousers, and had an old straw hat on; he is very cognizable from his custom of always keeping his mouth half shut, whereby his two large front teeth are always visible. He has been last seen on an open bullock wagon passing Banghoek, on its way to Great Drakenstein. Any person lodging him in Prison at Stellenbosch or Cape Town...prosecuted. JA GROENEWALD. Driesprong, Klapmuts, Dec 27 1841.

name: George Iley
physical_description: straight hair, marks of Small Pox in his face
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE last Friday, the U's Juvenile Emigrant GEORGE ILEY, 15 years old, he has straight hair, has marks of Small Pox in his face, and was dressed in a drab pair of trousers and blue shirt - Any person…law. M PENTZ, M. son. Cape Town, 20th January 1842.

name: Thomas Reysey
physical_description: short and stout stature
clothing: leathern pair of trousers, black Moleskin Jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 22d January, my Juvenile Emigrant THOMAS REYSEY, aged about 15 years, short and stout stature, was dressed in a leathern pair of trousers, and a black Moleskin Jacket; he is supposed to detain himself in the Cape Downs. Any person…rewarded. Great Drakenstein, 28th Jan 1842. P MARAIS.

name: Kiewa
physical_description: stout and strong stature, 5 ¼ feet high, mark G on her right breast
clothing: Voerchitz Gown
full_text: ABSCONDED, the U’s Price (sic) Negress, of a stout and strong stature, named KIEWA, 5 ¼ feet high, she has a mark G on her right breast, and is aged about 20 years, was dressed in a red Voerchitz Gown, and has lately been seen at the lower part of Wynberg. Any person lodging her in Prison will be rewarded, and those detaining her prosecuted. Cape Town, 3d feb. 1842. M PENTZ. [_510A]

name: Souza
physical_description: marked A on his right breast
full_text: [ADVERTISEMENT] ABSCONDED from the Place “Rome,” on Sunday, the 23d Instant, my two Negro Apprentices, one SOUZA, is marked A on his right breast, and MEENBY, with the mark N on his right arm, the former aged 26 years, and the latter 20 years. Any person lodging said Apprentices into any of the Prisons, or returning them to the U will be rewarded. Hottentots Holland, 28th January 1842. PIETER G WIUM. [_510B, _510C]

name: Meenby
physical_description: mark N on his right arm

name: Manuare
physical_description: 5 feet 11 inches high, markled MB on the right breast, yellow complexion
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Place Voorburgh, the following Negroes: - MANUARE, 28 years of age, 5 feet 11 inches high, markled MB on the right breast, yellow complexion; FARSISCO, 28 years of age, 5 feet 6 inches high, marked with an anchor on the right breast and S on the left ditto. Any person ... returning them to Mr PL MORKEL, in Cape Town, at the Butchers Shambles, or at my place...rewarded. They are supposed to be in company with those of Mr P WIUM's, having absented themselves on one and the same day. Hottentot's Holland. The Widow W MORKEL, Sr.

name: Farsisco
physical_description: 5 feet 6 inches high, marked with an anchor on the right breast and S on the left ditto

name: Manara (aka Manuel)
physical_description: 6 feet high, slender stature, marked N on his right arm
clothing: grey Duffle Jacket, Duck Trousers, and still wore No 119 round his neck
full_text: ABSCONDED on Monday, 24th January, my Negro Apprentice MANARA, but listens rather to Manuel, he is about 30 years old, 6 feet high, of slender stature and marked N on his right arm; was dressed in a grey Duffle Jacket, and a pair of Duck Trousers, and still wore No 119 round his neck - Persons at whose Residence he may arrive are kindly requested to inform the Undersigned thereof and lodge him in one of the Prisons. RJ MYBURGH, Js. Banghoek, Feb 3, 1842.

name: Tama
physical_description: 5 feet 5 1/4 inches high, marked on right arm with figure N
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 14th inst, my Prize Negro named TAMA, and his wife named MOOAUT, the former is 5 feet 5 1/4 inches high; the second 5 feet 4 inches high, they are both marked on their right arm with figure N. Any person…rewarded by JG HOFMEYR. Great Drakenstein, Feb 16, 1842. PS - On said day, also absconded a Boy and a Girl (also Prize Negroes) belonging to Mr FRANS BRINK, therefore they are probably together.

name: Mooaut
physical_description: 5 feet 4 inches high, marked on right arm with figure N

name: Frans/Francois
physical_description: hollowness on his chest, middle stature, looks young
clothing: Duffle Jacket, Moleskin Trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE Monday , the Mosambique Africander Boy FRANS, also known by the name of FRANCOIS, who is under contract with the Undersigned; he was dressed in a Duffle Jacket, and old Moleskin pair of Trousers; he has a hollowness on his chest, occasioned by an accident, is of a middle stature, looks young, and has a wife and child with him. Any person who may meet him, is requested to send him to the Prison, whilst they who harbour him will be prosecuted according to Law. M JURGENS. Garden, Vredehoek, Feb 21, 1842. [_515A]

name: Dennis Tidence
physical_description: short and stout stature, broad, and has marks of Small Pox in the face
clothing: Moleskin Jacket and Trousers, blue Shirt, Farmer’s straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED ON Tuesday last, my two Juvenile Emigrants, DENNIS TIDENCE, aged 15 years, short and stout stature, broad, and has marks of Small Pox in the face; lisps when speaking; was dressed in a Moleskin Jacket and Trousers, and blue Shirt, and had a Farmer’s straw hat on. He has detained himself during the last three months in the District of Caledon, and has been confined in the Town Prison last week, and released from the same the day previous to his present desertion. THOMAS SERJENT, 15 years of age, slender stature, pale countenance, whitish hair; was dressed in a Moleskin Jacket and Trousers, and had on a drab filt hat with a low crown. Any person lodging them in one of the Prisons, will be rewarded. Cape Town, Garden Uitkyk, Feb 24, 1842. RJ LOEDOLFF. [_515B, _515C]

name: Thomas Serjent
physical_description: slender stature, pale countenance, whitish hair
clothing: Moleskin Jacket and Trousers, drab filt hat

name: Tjawa
clothing: Moleskin Jacket, Leathern Trousers, Duffle Jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 10th inst, my Prize Negroe TJAWA, was dressed in a Moleskin Jacket and Leathern Trousers, and has with him a Duffle Jacket. Whoever lodges…rewarded. Klapmuts, 18th March 1842. JA BEYERS.

name: Roamby
physical_description: stout proportionate figure, five feet 4 inches high, marked F on the right breast
clothing: duffle jacket, moleskin trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED. ON the 26th of March last, my African Apprentice ROAMBY, he was dressed in a duffle jacket, and moleskin trousers, stout proportionate figure, five feet 4 inches high, and marked F on the right breast, aged 35 years. Whoever…rewarded. HC ESTERHUYSE. Onrust, Klapmuts, District Stellenbosch.

name: Godsena
physical_description: well made, about 4 feet high, branded on one of his breasts
full_text: ABSCONDED OR STRAYED, since the 2nd inst, the U's Prize Negro GODSENA; he is well made, about 4 feet high, and branded on one of his breasts. Whoever lodges him with Mr P Truter, Clerk to the Clerk of the Peace, Cape Town…will be rewarded. JD FREISLICH. Malmesbury, April 11, 1842.

name: Zoozy (aka Dick Turpin)
physical_description: 5 feet high, rather slim figure
clothing: grey cloth jacket and trousers, white beaver hat
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED, on Monday Morning, 25th ult. (before daylight), my Apprentice Prize Negro Boy named ZOOZY, or DICK TURPIN, about 5 feet high, rather slim figure and nearly 16 years of age; had on a grey cloth jacket and trousers nearly of the same colour, and a white beaver hat - any person...to law. T ADNEY.

name: Daala
physical_description: marked with the letter S on both shoulders
clothing: drab duffle Jacket, duck frock and trousers, striped cotton shirt, red and blue Cap
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the U's Place at Salt River, his Apprenticed Prize Negro named DAALA, marked with the letter S on both shoulders; was dressed in a drab duffle Jacket, duck frock and trousers, and striped cotton shirt, and having a Cap on his head, one side of which is blue and the other red. All persons...prisons. cape Town, 11th may 1842. FH TRUTER.

name: Maluel
physical_description: height 5 feet 10 1/4 inches, marked S faintly on the right shoulder blade
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the place of the U, situate at Paardenberg, two liberated Africans, one named MALUEL, aged 22 years, height 5 feet, 10 1/4 inches, marked S faintly on the right shoulder blade; and the other GOOMA, aged 17 years, height 5 feet, 4 1/4 inches, no marks - Any person...law. EL STEYN. Paardenberg, May 24, 1842.

name: Gooma
physical_description: height 5 feet 4 1/4 inches

name: Samuel Harrington
physical_description: slender make, light hair
clothing: striped Moleskin Trousers, grey striped Velvet Jacket, blue Cap
full_text: £1 REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 10th instant, the U's Juvenile Emigrant SAMUEL HARRINGTON, surnamed SAM; he is upwards of 15 years of age, is of a slender make, speaks rather unintelligible, has light hair, and was dressed in a pair of striped Moleskin Trowsers, a grey striped Velvet Jacket and blue Cap. Whoever lodges...the law. M JURGENS, Sen. Garden Vredehoek, June 16, 1842.

name: Atenda
physical_description: stout stature, marked F on the right breast, missing the top joint of his left little finger
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the Month of April last, ATENDA, a Negroe, aged about 24 years, stout stature, was dressed in a drab duffle jacket, leathern trousers, striped cotton shirt, and a red cap on his head; marked F on the right breast, and has lost the top joint of his left little finger. GAVA, a Negress, aged about 16 years, of slender stature, marked S on the right shoulder blade, has large eyes, and is pock marked. They have taken their route tio Saldanha Bay. Both are in the service of the Undersigned; and all...to him. JMA VAN BLOMMESTEIN. Saxenburg, near Stellenbosch.

name: Gava
physical_description: slender stature, marked S on the right shoulder blade, large eyes, pock marked

name: Kakelabooa
physical_description: tall stature
clothing: duffle jacket, red baize shirt, leathern trousers, red cap
full_text: WARNING. ABSCONDED, on the 17th instant, two of my apprenticed Liberated Africans, conveyed hither from St Helena, named KAKELABOOA and KAMEA, being man and wife, the firstnamed is 26 years of age, tall stature, and was dressed in a duffle jacket, red baize shirt, leathern trousers, and red cap on his head; - the second, aged 25 years, is of tall, stout and strong stature, and was dressed in a red voerchits gown, white flannel peticoat, white shirt, and red handkerchief on her head, but has taken with her several articles of clothing and two colored counterpanes {bedspreads}. Those persons... to law. HC Van Niekerk, Ms. Frymansfontein, Koeberg, July 24, 1842.

name: Kamea
physical_description: tall, stout and strong stature
clothing: red voerchits gown, white flannel peticoat, white shirt, red handkerchief

name: Thomas Perry
physical_description: long and slender stature, mark on his breast and knees bent inwards
clothing: dark blue duffle jacket, nankeen trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED, 3 Weeks since, the U's Juvenile Emigrant THOMAS PERRY, aged about 17 years, long and slender stature, has a mark on his breast and knees bent inwards. He was dressed in a dark blue duffle jacket and nankeen trousers. Whoever…prosecuted. DJ THEUNISSEN. Koeberg, Sept 12, 1842.

name: Maba
physical_description: mark on his right cheek
clothing: duffle jacket and moleskin trousers
full_text: ABSCONDED ON the 21st September inst, my Prize Negro named MABA; has a mark on his right cheek; was dressed in a duffle jacket and moleskin trousers; on the jacket the name of the U is found; he has also with him a skin blanket. Whoever lodges…prosecuted. JA BEYERS, As. Langerug, September 26, 1842.

name: Europa
physical_description: small stature, impediment to his right hand
full_text: ABSCONDED. THE Free Person EUROPA, indentured to the U as Cattle Herd, has gone to Town on the 3d Sept, for 2 days at the longest, has taken with him without leave, a Fowling Piece, and detains himself in Town. Any person…reward of Rds. 5. He is of small stature, and has an impediment to his right hand. ML NEETHLING. Tygerberg, October 27, 1842.

name: William aka John Hendries
physical_description: middle age and stature, stout, scar over right eye, very dark, thick wooly hair

items_taken: DEAL BOX or CASE, containing various Utensils, Apparel, Books, Stationery
full_text: £5 REWARD. WHEREAS my Servant William alias JOHN HENDRIES, did on the Morning of THURSDAY the 20th instant, or Friday the 21st inst, receive into his charge a DEAL BOX or CASE, containing various Utensils, Apparel, Books, Stationery &c., from the Stores of Messrs BORRADAILES, THOMPSON & PILLANS - I hereby offer the above reward to any persons that may procure, or give such information as may lead to the apprehension of the said servant (vide his description at foot) and the recovery of the above Case with its contents. HENRY F DRINKWATER. Simon's Town, October 28, 1842. II DESCRIPTION OF THE ABSENTEE. A man of middle age and stature, but stout and active withal, of Mozambique extraction, has a scar over the right eye, is very dark and has thick wooly hair. Wore on leaving his service a felt hat with a feather in the tie, a white cotton shirt, a coarse blue cloth jacket, drill trousers and half boots or high shoes. Speaks English fluently.

full_text: ONE GUINEA REWARD. ABSCONDED since the 11th instant, NEWOWALLER, a Male African, between 12 and 13 years of age, short and stout, marked G on the right breast, Indentured Servant of Mrs CA HAUPT. The above Reward is offered…or bring him to the residence of Mr Notary JG DE VILLIERS, Plein Street No 37. Cape Town, October 26, 1842. NB NEWOWALLER was dressed at the time of his desertion in a duffle jacket, a white waistcoat, much longer that the Jacket, a pair of brown stuff trowsers, white shirt and striped neckerchief.

full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 3rd instant, my Juvenile Emigrant JAMES FERROL, aged 16 years, slender stature, brown hair, and one of his eyes rather smaller than the other, he has taken with him a new pair of skin trousers and one pair of blue ditto, a blue frock, a palmiet hat, a pair of field shoes, a white shirt and a tin basin; any person or persons lodging him in prison, will be well rewarded...law. DJ VAN DER MERWE, Wagonmaker's Valley.

name: Cupido

JG TREDOUX, Sen, No 47, Strand-street.

full_text: REWARD. THE Slave KAREL, belonging to the Estate of the late Dirk Wouter Hoffman, and last in the Service of Mr J Chisholm of CT, having absconded - the Board of Orphan Masters, as administering the said Estate, do hereby offer a Reward to any person who will give such information at this Office, as will lead to his apprehension. The following is a description of the said Slave Karel - he is about 43 1/2 years of age, 5 feet in height, has small eyes, Hottentot features, scars on his face, and is by trade a Blacksmith. Orphan Chamber, Cape of Good Hope, 13th May 1830. H Tennant, Sec.

REYNIER VAN ROOYEN Sen/HEND L PIO - Executors

G. LEEWNER.

full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 7th April last, a slave named JOUMAT (formerly belonging to Mr Theunis Dirkse Van Schalkwyk), a Wheelwright; short stature, broad shoulders, large mouth, thick lips, squints with both eyes, wooly hair, a round bald spot on his head, a long mark on the inner part of his left leg or calf; brown complexion, resembles a bastard Madagascar; had on a pair of leather trowsers, checked shirt, drab hat, striped waistcoat, blue cloth jacket, with yellow buttons, and had with him a spring-buck knapsack; he was last seen in CT, and it is supposed that he harbours himself there, or perhaps has enlisted as a soldier in the Cape Corps - Whoever lodges him in a public Prison shall receive a reward of Thirty Rix dollars and those harbouring him, must abide the consequences. Tulbagh, 8th June, 1831. Daniel Pieter Rossouw.

physical_description: rather tall and thin, yellow complexion, and long black hair
full_text: ABSCONDED, from the U, about the end of April last, the following Slaves, viz: EVA, about 19 years old, rather tall and thin, yellow complexion, and long black hair; JULINA, about 38 years old, short stature, yellow complexion, short curly hair, and has lost almost all her teeth, particularly in front; and APPOLLUS, about 29 years old, short stature and thin, yellowish complexion, short curly hair and is a little lame in his left leg. Eva, is supposed to have gone towards Cape Town - Any person lodging any of the above-mentioned slaves in Gaol or bringing them to the U shall receive a reward of Ten Rix-dollars for each. Matjiesfontein, Nieuwveld, District Beaufort, 26th May 1831. Giliam Du Toit.

ABSC, since the Month of Feb last, two male slaves as described hereunder - Whoever lodges both or one of them in the Prison, or returns them to the U's Place at Koeberg, shall receive 20Rds reward for each. 1. DAMON, of Malabar, about 50 years old, short and stout figure, dressed in a pair of leather trowsers and jacket; formerly the property of Mr Wessel Pretorius, and it is supposed he conceals himself in the District of Worcester. ADONIS, of this colony, 45 years old, tall and stout figure, dressed the same as Damon, states he is looking for Cattle, and harbours himself in the neighbourhood of Koeberg or Zwartland. 5th October 1831. R Cloete, Rs.

name: Sans Souci
physical_description: middling stature, high forehead, has lost nearly all his foreteeth, an one ancle is thicker than the other
full_text: 10 RD REWARD. ABSC, since the 25th February last, the U's male slave named SANS SOUCI, of Mosambique, of middling stature, high forehead, has lost nearly all his foreteeth, an one ancle is thicker than the other. He is a good Milker, and very handy at Farmer's work: as he probably hires himself as a Prize Negro in one of the Country Districts, the U kindly solicits the Field-Cornets to give notice therof. Mount Pleasant, 12th October, 1831. H. Cloete, Rs.

name: October
physical_description: short stature, strong beard
full_text: ABSC, in the month of July 1829, from Laurens P Erasmus, two male slaves, viz: OCTOBER, of the Cape, short stature, a strong beard and stammers a little; MAURITS, of Mosambique, short stature, and crooked fingers - Whoever lodges them in Prison shall receive a Reward of Fifty Rix-dollars - They were apprehended in the District of Uitenhage, and escaped; it is supposed they conceal themselves in that District.

name: Maurits

ABSC, from the U, since the 15th October last, a male slave named Salomon, of this colony, about 5 feet 7 inches high, stout figure, white complexion, small eyes, light brown curly hair - Whoever returns…wards. Bottlerivier, Rivier-Zonder-Einde, 25th November 1831. Jac Theunissen, Senior.

name: David

full_text: 20 RD REWARD. ABSC, from the U, on Sunday the 18th inst, a Slave Boy, named David, 18 years of age, 5 feet 4 inches high, dark complexion, curly hair, full face, and has much the appearance of a Madagascar Boy; had on when he absconded a black jacket and blue trowsers. The above Slave was born at Mr WM van de Meldemert's, Groot Drakenstein, and was bought of the late Mr Bletterman, CT. Whoever will give any information to lead ...reward. Robert Thompson. 54 Long-street, 29th Dec 1831.

name: David
physical_description: 5 feet 1 inch high, of yellow complexion, right finger stiff

full_text: ABSCONDED, from the U, on Monday, the 23d January last, a male slave named DAVID, of this Colony, 5 feet 1 inch high, of yellow complexion, right finger stiff; had on a white frock, a pair of leather trowsers, and a black hat; also the female Slave Lena (his wife), much resembling a Madagascar Woman, and squints; both lately belonging to Mr W Botha - Whoever...prosecuted. Plattekloof, 2d Feb 1832. GC GREFFRATH

name: Lena
physical_description: squints

Rondeboschje, 8th Feb 1832. FJ KOTZE.

name: Silvester
physical_description: short and stout figure, has an ugly appearance, with thick lips
clothing: new kersey jacket, striped cotton shirt, new leather trousers, and drab hat
full_text: ABSC, since the 4th inst, the slave SILVESTER, with his wife SPAAS, both of Mosambique; Silvester was dressed in a new kersey jacket, striped cotton shirt, new leather trousers, and drab hat; is of short and stout figure, has an ugly appearance, with thick lips; Spaas was dressed in a new voerchits petticoat and shirt gown, is of middling and stout figure, has a long visage, with long lower lip - Whoever lodges one or both...shall be rewarded. Swellendam 14 Feb 1832. P Van der Spuy.

name: Spaas
physical_description: middling and stout figure, has a long visage, with long lower lip
clothing: new voerchits petticoat and shirt gown

name: Frits
physical_description: near 5 feet high, is slender made, of light yellow complexion, part of the hair on the back of his head is grey, and has a mark on one of his eyebrows
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 7th February last, the U's slave FRITS, about 18 years of age. He stands near 5 feet high, is slender made, of light yellow complexion, part of the hair on the back of his head is grey, and has a mark on one of his eyebrows. He left this place in company with a young Bushman named Vlak, of short size and small eyes. They have been seen in the Du Toits Kloof, pretending to go to the Wine Farmers to help them in pressing, and Frits probably passes himself as a Bastard Hottentot. Whoever lodges him...reward. Hex River, Worcester, 6th March 1832. Pieter Meiring.

physical_description: proportionate figure, yellow complexion, thick hands and feet, and forefinger of the left hand stiff
full_text: ABSC, FROM the U, on the 24th January, 1831, a female slave, aged 28 years, proportionate figure, yellow complexion, thick hands and feet, and forefinger of the left hand stiff - Whoever…a Reward of 25 Rds;…prosecuted. Tulbagh, 8 May 1832. Widow A De Wet.

name: Adam
physical_description: about 5 feet high, of a yellow colour, has some white spots on his face, and a bent nose
clothing: white moleskin jacket, fancy waistcoat, and leather trousers
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSC, from the U, the slave Boy named ADAM, about 5 feet high, of a yellow colour, has some white spots on his face, and a bent nose; speaks good Dutch; was dressed in a white moleskin jacket, fancy waistcoat, and leather trousers. Whoever lodges the above...reward. J KOTZE, Sen, Blaauwberg.

name: Caesar
full_text: REWARD. THE Slave Caesar, belonging to the Estate of the late Pieter Benjamin Wiese, and surviving widow Martha Jacoba Gobrechts, having absconded, the Board of Orphan Matsres, as administering the said Estate, do hereby offer a Reward to any person…apprehension. Orphan Chamber, Cape of Good Hope, 13th June, 1832. H TENNANT, Sec.

name: Eleas
physical_description: long stature
clothing: dark duffle jacket, a voerchits waistcoat, a white shirt, a pair of nankeen trousers, half boots, and a coarse drab hat
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSC from the U last Saturday, a male slave named ELEAS, a Mosambique African, about 22 years old, long stature, stammers a little, had on a dark duffle jacket, a voerchits waistcoat, a white shirt, a pair of nankeen trousers, half boots, and a coarse drab hat, and has with him a skin cover, and mason's tools. Said slave passes as a prize negro, under the name of Martinus, and hires himself as a Mason; at the time he first absconded, on the 15th August 1830, he hired himself to Barend Bredenkamp, at the Place Berendal, to cut corn, afterwards to Isaac Metselaar, Paarl, Jan Simenie, Stein Malerme, Dr Addey, near the Pont, Daniel Russouw, Hout Bay, Jan Gous, and since a whole year at Koopman's River, in the field cornetcy of Samuel Walters - Whoever...Law. Constantia, 13th June 1832. JN COLYN.

name: Jason
physical_description: middle size and strongly built
full_text: 15 RDS REWARD. The slave boy JASON, about 30 years of age, by birth an Africaner Mosambique, of a middle size and strongly built, has again absconded about the middle of last month, having been only a short time before apprehended by Mr Van der Spuy, at Zwartland: he is generally in company with his Hottentot Wife named Lys, and is seldom without a Hottentot Violin. Whoever...reward. Else River, near Simon's Town, 24th May 1832. WR OSMOND.

name: Spadille
full_text: 10 RDS REWARD. Ran away, a few months ago, Spadille, of Mosambique, a slave belonging to the insolvent estate of the widow Michiel Jan Smuts. The above reward will be given … prosecuted. GH MAASDORP, FG WATERMEYER, EA BUYSKES - Joint Trustees

name: Jephta
physical_description: short and stout
clothing: blue cloth trousers, a striped waistcoat, and white shirt, and wearing a new black silk hat
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. Deserted, on the 13th of June inst, from the service of Mr Dickinson, a slave named Jephta, about 17 years of age, short and stout in person, being dressed when he left home in blue cloth trousers, a striped waistcoat, and white shirt, and wearing a new black silk hat; and it is presumed he states himself to be a prize Negro. The above...prison. Stellenbosch 26th June 1832.

name: Satiera
physical_description: yellow complexion, short stature, and has a mark on her neck
full_text: MISSING, from the U, since the 29th Dec 1831, a female slave of this colony named SATIERA, aged 13 years 2 months; who went from the place of Mr AB De Villiers, behind the Paarl, to the place of Mr HJ Van der Spuy, adjoining the above, but has not yet arrived - She is of yellow complexion, short stature, speaks well, and has a mark on her neck. Any person discovering...a reward will be given. Cape Town 28 June 1832. DJ ASPELING, Sr.

name: Maart
physical_description: proportionate figure, long curly hair
clothing: new blue kersey jacket, lined with blue baize, leather trousers, striped cotton shirt, and an old drab hat
items_taken: several Articles of clothing, and a small iron pot which belong to him; Silver money, viz; Half Crowns and Shillings
full_text: ABSC on the 20th inst, a male slave of the U, named MAART, of this colony, 30 years old, proportionate figure, long curly hair, resembling a bastard Hott, dressed in a new blue kersey jacket, lined with blue baize, leather trousers, striped cotton shirt, and an old drab hat, taking with him several Articles of clothing, and a small iron pot which belong to him; likewise, some Silver money, viz; Half Crowns and Shillings; is accompanied by a Hottentot named Adam, sbout 7 years old. - Said slave belonged formerly to Mr HC V Niekerk, Blaauwbloemetjes Kloof, and was bought from Mr P Auret, CT, 1.5 years ago - Whoever,,, rewarded. Koeberg 26th July 1832. Jan H Theunissen.

name: Gezwind
full_text: 25 RDS REW. The slave GEZWIND, born in this colony, about 25 years old, belonging to the Insolvent estate of Mr Jan Daniel Cilliers, C. Son, of Swagershoek, District of Somerset, having absented himself from the Service of his Master during the last three years, the above reward is offered to... and give info to C Moller, Esq at Somerset, or the U, No 2 Church-square. CT 2 August 1832. EA Buyskes, Sole Trustee.

name: Arend
physical_description: fair complexion, short and stout figure, high shoulders, and a stiff gait
full_text: 50 RDS Rew. ABSCONDED, from the U, two male slaves: - Frits {_80}, aged 17 years but appearing to be only 14 years, and AREND, aged 50 years; Frits since the month of Feb last, and Arend, the father of Frits, since April last - Frits is of slender make, light yellow complexion, an open mouth, curly hair, which is grey at the back of his head, and a small scar on one of his eyebrows; Arend is of fair complexion, short and stout figure, high shoulders, and a stiff gait. - Both were formerly the property of Mr Frans Roos, Jan's Son, of Stellenbosch - Whoever lodges...prosecuted. Worcester, 19th July, 1832.

name: Francis
physical_description: a crooked leg, and walks lame
full_text: ABSCONDED, the slave Francis, of Mosambique, aged 42 years; has a crooked leg, and walks lame, formerly belonging to Michiel Coetsee, Gs of Cape Downs; according to information, he harbours himself in the Cape Downs - Whoever lodges…rewarded. 31st July 1832. Jan Jurgen Kotze.

name: Dumas
physical_description: slender make, 5 feet 5 inches high, curly hair, yellow complexion, with a scar above one of his eyes, and a mark on his right side
clothing: kersey jacket, leather trousers, white shirt, and a drab hat
full_text: ABSCO, from the U on the 28th March 1832, the male slave Dumas, of this colony, 23 years old, slender make, 5 feet 5 inches high, curly hair, yellow complexion, resembles a Bastard Hottentot, with a scar above one of his eyes, and a mark on his right side; dressed in a kersey jacket, leather trousers, white shirt, and a drab hat; took with him a little Bastard Hottentot named Willem, 12 years old, with white spots on his face, long hair, slender make, whose Father lives at Hans Botha's, District of Clanwilliam, and where it is presumed they have gone - Whoever...rewarded. Joh Alb Basson, Js.

name: Goliath
physical_description: about 5 feet 7 3/4 inches high, black curly hair, dark brown face, flat nose, stout proportions, has marks of punishment with the cat on his back, the print of his foot very broad
full_text: 20 RDS REW. Absc, since the 1st of May, GOLIATH, slave of the U, about 5 feet 7 3/4 inches high, black curly hair, dark brown face, flat nose, stout proportions, has marks of punishment with the cat on his back, the print of his foot very broad: was last seen in the District of Worcester, and it is suspected he hires himself out as a Bastard. Whoever...reward. Silvermyn, 26th 1832. PH De Villiers.

name: Daantje
physical_description: 5 1/2 feet high, of fair complexion, black hair, and good figure
clothing: blue jacket, black trousers and waistcoat, black hat with crape round it, and shoes

full_text: ABSC. Since the 24th September last, the U's male slave DAANTJE, of the Cape, formerly the property of Mr Andries Teubes; he is 5 1/2 feet high, of fair complexion, black hair, and good figure; had on a blue jacket, black trousers and waistcoat, black hat with crape round it, and shoes; he left the Place Nooitgedacht with a saddled bay Mare, with white forehead and white hind legs. On the 26th September he was seen on the Market square in Cape Town, and afterwards at the Races - Whoever lodges...receive a Reward of Ten Rix-dollars; and...prosecuted. Nooitgedacht, 9th October 1832. D Cloete, Sen.

name: Nabal
physical_description: 5 feet high blear-eyed
full_text: ABSC, from the U, his male slave named NABAL, of Mosambique, about 5 feet high blear-eyed, and is fond of smoking. Whoever…rewarded. Zoutrivier, District of Groenekloof, 24th Oct 1832. NC Van Schalkwyk.

name: Adonis
physical_description: short stature, black complexion, flat nose, a scar on his face, walks a little lame
full_text: FIFTEEN rds REW. ABSC, 14 days ago, my slave ADONIS, aged about 26 years, short stature, black complexion, flat nose, a scar on his face, walks a little lame, speaks the Dutch well, and much resembles a Damraat, for which he has hired himself three times. Whoever lodges...reward. Blueberg, 19th November, 1832. JJ Kotze, Sen.

name: Galant
physical_description: mild countenance, bright eyes, and a fine set of large white teeth
clothing: kersey jacket, leather trousers, and a new hat
full_text: TEN RD REW. ABSC, eight days ago, a male slave of this Colony, named Galant, aged about 18 years; was dressed in a kersey jacket, leather trousers, and a new hat; he much resembles a Bastard, has a mild countenance, bright eyes, and a fine set of large white teeth - Whoever...reward. Blueberg, 29th November, 1832. JJ Kotze, Sen.

name: Adam

full_text: 20 RDS REW. RAN AWAY, from the U, on the 8th Jan. on his return from CT, at the foot of Hottentot's Holland Kloof, a male slave named ADAM, of the Cape, aged 23 years, of brown complexion, 5 1/2 inches high, thick wooly hair, hollow eyes, thick curled upper lip, and a slight beard: resembles much a bastard Hottentot; had on a drab hat, a gray jacket with red lining, white shirt, white moleskin trowsers, and has with him a skin blanket - Whoever...reward. River zonder Einde, 15th January 1833. JC Linde, Jac. Son.

name: Apollos
physical_description: about 5 feet 5 inches high; tremendous thick lips, and large mouth
skill_occupation: Shipwright assistant, cook, groom, bricklayer, Speaks English
full_text: 20 RDS REW. RAN AWAY, the boy APOLLOS, formerly belonging to Mr Low, the Shipwright; he worked some time also with Mr Teubes, and was Servant to the late Mr DASHWOOD: he professes to do everything - Cook, Groom, Bricklayer etc etc about 5 feet 5 inches high; tremendous thick lips, and large mouth, a kind of Mosambique, and speaks English - Whoever...reward. {{Update 18330222: NOTICE. FORTY RDS REW. WILL be given...APOLLOS... he left his master about the 1st January; formerly servant of late Mr Dashwood, since then he has served Mr Low, the Shipwright. 50 RDS REWARD will also be given to any person who shall give such information as shall lead to the punishment of any one that may harbour him; it is supposed the Boy may be at Stellenbosch, where he is well known}}

name: Dirk
physical_description: proportionate figure, fair complexion, black curled hair; mark of a wound on his throat, marks of stripes on his back
full_text: 50 RDS REW. ABSCONDED, since the month of November 1831, the U's male slave named DIRK, about 26 years old, proportionate figure, fair complexion, and black curled hair; he has a mark of a wound on his throat, and marks of stripes on his back, and probably passes himself as a Bastard - Whoever...reward. Bottelary, District of Stellenbosch, 21st January, 1833. JP Bosman. Ps.

name: David
physical_description: yellow complexion, short stature
clothing: kersey and a leather jacket, leather trousers
full_text: 25 RDS REW. For each Slave. ABSC, without reasons, since the 18th December, 1832, the male Slaves DAVID and ABRAHAM, both Natives of this Colony. David, aged about 19 years, of yellow complexion, short stature, resembling a Hottentot; was dressed in a kersey and a leather jacket, and leather trousers. Abraham, aged 17 years, of fair complexion, stout figure, light blue eyes, has a hole in his left ear, of which the mark is still visible. Whoever...prosecuted. Caledon 14th Feb 1833. Bar. Jac. Erasmus, Ls.

name: Abraham
physical_description: fair complexion, stout figure, light blue eyes, hole in his left ear

name: Albert
physical_description: 5 feet high, mark on his left eye and on his lower lip
full_text: ABSC, since the 24th January last, from the U, a male Slave named Albert, of this Colony, with his Wife and Child; he is about 30 years, 5 feet high, much resembles a Hottentot, for which he probably hires himself; has a mark on his left eye and on his lower lip; is a Blacksmith by Trade. His wife is a bastard Hottentot, long and thin stature, of brown complexion and the child is 13 years old, goes lame when it walks quick, of light yellow complexion - The field cornets are kindly requested to make this known in their respective Wards, and on discovery to lodge said slave in the nearest prison, for which a Reward of Fifty Rix-dollars will be given. Groeneberg 7th March 1833. TA Du Plessie.

name: Bietja
full_text: JH WICHT vs JAN ANDS. DE WET. ON SATURDAY, the 23d March, 1833, in front of the Town House, the female slave BIETJA. As this slave is at present in the country, a Reward will be given to any Person who will forward her to the Undersigned. Messenger's Office, Cape Town, 14th March, 1833. EDW. MOORE, Messenger. {High Sheriff}

name: Joemat
physical_description: yellow complexion, one of his front teeth out
full_text: ABSC, about a month ago, a slave named JOEMAT, belonging to Mr George, formerly the property of PB Borcherds, Esq.; is about 24 years old, yellow complexion, and has one of his front teeth out; is supposed to harbour himself in the Village of Stellenbosch. CT, 14 March 1833.

name: Robert
physical_description: nearly white
full_text: RUN AWAY, THE slave Boy ROBERT, the property of the undersigned: he is supposed to conceal himself in the neighbourhood of Rondebosch. Whoever will return him to the U…prosecuted. He is nearly white and gives himself out as a free Person. John Johnstone, Shambles No 7.

name: Abraham
physical_description: about 5 feet high, of a slender make, yellow complexion

full_text: 10 RD REW. ABSC, since the 11th February, my slave boy ABRAHAM, about 5 feet high, of a slender make, yellow complexion; his Parents are residing in CT, in a lower Store of Mr JH Neethling, St George's-street. He was last seen in the vicinity of Wynberg, and represents himself as a free Person. Whoever...reward. FX Jurgens. Paardeberg 1st May 1833.

name: Coridon
physical_description: short stature, but stout and thick set; in consequence of having some time since broken his left leg, he walks somewhat lame
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABS, ever since the 16th November last, Coridon, Slave of Lieut. Col. Collette; he is an African Mosambique, resembling a Hottentot, about 23 years of age; short stature, but stout and thick set; in consequence of having some time since broken his left leg, he walks somewhat lame; he formerly belonged to Mr M De Kock, of Klapmuts, and it is supposed that he now passes himself for a Hottentot belonging to one of the Missionary Institutions. Whoever...reward. Wittboom, 23d May, 1832. HL Cole. [update 18330117 - was last seen near Saldanha Bay.]

name: Telemachus
full_text: 25 RD REW. ABSC, about six weeks since, my slave boy TELEMACHUS, coachman, formerly the property of MJ Van Schoor; he was lately seen near the Lion's Rump. Whoever lodges him in any of the Prisons, will receive the above Reward; while…prosecuted. CT 1 August 1833. D Pallas.

name: Francina
physical_description: tall, sallow complexion, rather stout
full_text: 20 RD REW. THE U having purchased the Slave Girl FRANCINA, late the property of Mr JC De Villiers, of Drakenstein, and formerly of Mr Gerrit Kleyn, he offers the above Reward either to herself, if she will return to her duty, or to any Person who will bring her home. She is a tall woman, of about 44 years of age, of sallow complexion, and rather stout. CT. 1 Aug, 1833. Maximilian Thalwitzer.

name: Pieter
physical_description: about 5 feet 6 inches, make stout, has a slight limp in his walk, complexion black, hair wooly, with small whiskers
clothing: leathern trousers, blue cloth jacket and waistcoat, old shirt striped blue, blue handkerchief on head
full_text: NOTICE. WHEREAS PIETER, slave of the wid Maria La Cock, of Varse Vlei, near Salt River, formerly in the service of Dirk Van Reenen, Jac son, charged with the wilful murder of George Frederik Henning La Cock, absconded from the said place last night, immediatley after having perpetrated the act. The following description of him is given, with a view to his apprehension. Age about 40 years, height about 5 feet 6 inches, make stout, has a slight limp in his walk, complexion black, hair wooly, with small whiskers, and when last seen was dressed in leathern trousers, blue cloth jacket and waistcoat, old shirt striped blue, and blue handkerchief on his head. Clerk of the peace office, CT, 8th Aug, 1833. Daniel J Cloete, Clerk of the Peace.

name: Philip
physical_description: 5 feet in height, of yellow complexion, with long black hair
full_text: REWARD. THE slave PHILIP, of Bengal, belonging to the Estate of Hercules Jacobus Visser, deceased, having absconded from the place Naauwport, formerly the Residence of his late Master - the Board of Orphan Masters, as administering the said estate…Orphan Chamber of Graaff Reinet, as shall lead to the apprehension of said slave. The following is a description of the slave Philip; he is about 47 years of age, 5 feet in height, of yellow complexion, with long black hair, and is by occupation a Shepherd. Orphan Chamber, Cape of Good Hope, 29th August, 1833. H Tennant, Sec.

name: August
physical_description: a mark in the form of a crescent moon on his forehead, caused by a fall
location: Graaf Reinet (absconded on road between Swellendam and Graaf)
full_text: 25 RD REW. ABSC, from the U, on the road between Swellendam and Graaff-Reinet, his male slave AUGUST; he is a native of Mosambique, about 32 years of age, and has a mark in the form of a crescent moon on his forehead, caused by a fall; he has lately passed for a prize negro at Swellendam, where he hired himself out to different persons. Whoever apprehends this slave and lodges him in any of the Gaols, will receive the above reward of rds 25. Graaff-Reinet, 23d Sept, 1833. Gert Lodewyk Coetzee.

name: Eva
physical_description: middling stature, and rather stout, light yellow complexion, and has long black hair, snub flat nose, rather thick lips, and a long narrow scar on her forehead; has lost almost all her tusk teeth

full_text: 20 Rix Dollars Reward. ABSCONDED, about the end of August last, and supposed to have gone to Cape Town, my female Slave EVA; she is of middling stature, and rather stout, light yellow complexion, and has long black hair, snub flat nose, rather thick lips, and a long narrow scar on her forehead; has lost almost all her tusk teeth, and wears usually a handkerchief or bonnet. Whoever lodges her in Prison, on application personally by letter, to Mr KINNEAR, of Beaufort, will receive the above Reward. Zwarteberg, 5th October, 1833. J.J. Oosthuizen.

name: Lodewyk

full_text: ABSC, on the 4th inst, a male Slave named LODEWYK, of this Colony, with a female Hott named Rachel; he is 5 ft and a few inches, of yellow complexion, resembles a Bastard; squints a little, long black curly hair, a little gray - Whoever…prosecuted. CT, No 14, Bree-street. GC Dreyer.

name: Rachel
physical_description: yellow complexion
clothing: black chintz petticoat
full_text: DESERTED from the U, 2 slaves named RACHEL, and her daughter SIENA, both purchased at the sale of Mr JH Vuurman, formerly the property of Mr Mulder, at Graaff-Reinet. The mother is of a yellow complexion and pretends to be sickly; was dressed in a black chintz petticoat, - the Daughter perfectly resembles a female bastard Hottentot, with curled hair and marks on the toes of her left foot - Those apprehending them...prosecuted. Jan Hendrik Vos, J Js. NB The mother is accompanied by her Husband, a Bastard Hottentot named Jacob.

name: Siena
physical_description: curled hair and marks on the toes of her left foot

name: Joseph Heyns

WHEREAS Joseph Heyns, an Apprentice of the U, having absconded from his employ since August 1832, this is to give notice that whoever lodges the said Joseph Heyns in any Prison, so that he may be conveyed to Cape Town, shall receive the above reward; and whoever...Law. He is at present in the neighbourhood of Graaf Reinet; he is of light brown complexion, of short stature, and much subject to epilepsy. D Williams, 13 St Georges-street.

name: Laback Kiewiet
physical_description: 5 feet 4 1/2 inches; Hair black curled, Eyes black, Nose large, Mark a scar upon his right cheek
clothing: blue kersey jacket, a white Guernsey frock, with black spots on it, a white shirt, a pair of skin trousers, a pair of field shoes, a grayish hat, of which the edge of the top was painted red, with four red stripes downward to its brim
full_text: NOTICE. THE Hottentot LABACK KIEWIET, lately in the service of Philippus Johannes van Koppen, residing at the place Hamelkop, in the ward of Gourits River, in the district of George, having made his escape on the 20th inst, from the Escort charged to convey him to the prison of George, in order to be examined on a charge of theft preferred against him, - the Public is hereby requested, if possible, to apprehend the said Laback Kiewiet, and to lodge him in one of the gaols, in order to be forwarded to the prison of George, a Warrant having been obtained to that effect. Description: Height 5 feet 4 1/2 inches; Hair black curled, Eyes black, Nose large, Mark a scar upon his right cheek; was dressed in a blue kersey jacket, a white Guernsey frock, with black spots on it, a white shirt, a pair of skin trousers, a pair of field shoes, a grayish hat, of which the edge of the top was painted red, with four red stripes downward to its brim. Office of Clerk of the Peace. George Town, 23d December 1833. WC Kuys. Clerk of the Peace.

name: Jacob
physical_description: short and slender, very black, countenance pleasing
full_text: SLAVES ABSCONDED. CORIDON [_109], Africaner Mosambique, resembling a Hottentot, 21 years of age, short stature, but very stout make, and somewhat lame with the left leg; he deserted in November, 1832, and was last seen near Saldanha Bay. JACOB, Africaner Mosambique, 16 years old, short and slender; he is very black, and his countenance pleasing; formerly he belonged to Mr Hoets, and is supposed to be still in Cape Town. ADAM, African, 10 years old, very small for his age, and of brown complexion; had on leather clothes, and a blue cloth cap. These slaves are the property of Lieut-Col. Collette, and whoever lodges the in Prison or brings them to the U, shall be most liberally rewarded. Witteboomen, 15th Jan 1834. HL Cole.

full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 16th October last, DAVID, aged 25 years, of the Cape, upwards of 5 feet high, thick lips, long wooly hair, stout thick fingers, a Madagascar Africaner, formerly belonging to Hendrik Albertyn, of Papendorp. And on the 10th Jan last, Carel, aged 18 years, of yellow complexion, long hair, formerly belonging to Albert Van Niekerk. Whoever...rewarded. Berg River, 16th January, 1834. Jan Jurgen Kotze.

name: Carel
physical_description: yellow complexion, long hair

name: Felix
clothing: blue jacket, white shirt, leather trousers, and a black hat
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, from the U, two male slaves named FELIX and HENDRIK; the first is well known in the Colony, having been in the service of the late Mr Jan Myburg, Eerste River, and of Mr Mocke, CT; is a Tailor by trade, also a Musician; passes as a free Person, aged 45 years, was dressed in a blue jacket, white shirt, leather trousers, and a black hat; was first seen in CT, afterwards at Mr P Myburg's, Eerste River, where he has Children, and last at Wynberg and CT; the second slave Hendrik, is 20 years old, stout figure, has a mark above his left eye, was dressed in a blue jacket, striped shirt, and leather trousers; he passes as a bastard Hott and has been cutting Oats at Eerste River; is now in the Downs - Whoever lodges these slaves in the Prison, shall receive the above reward. Zwartland, 29th January, 1834. FJ Bestbier.

name: Achilles

name: Abraham
physical_description: yellow complexion, straight hair, short stature
full_text: RAN AWAY, ON the 15th February, my slave Boy Abraham; is of yellow complexion, straight hair, short stature, and about 24 years old - Whoever…Reward. Oliphant's Fontein, 6 March 1834. FX Jurgens.

name: Hannie Snyders
clothing: neatly dressed, having on a fine white gown
full_text: ONE POUND STERLING REWARD. ABSCONDED, or taken away from the U, a Girl named HANNIE SNYDERS, aged about 11 years; she went away last Tuesday, about 3 o clock, in a wagon to Zwartberg's Bay, lying along the Road to Saldanha Bay - This Girl was neatly dressed, having on a fine white gown, and worked comb in her hair - As this Girl is duly apprenticed to the U, every person is requested not to harbour her, but to send her forthwith to the Town Prison, for which the above reward will be paid with pleasure. CT, 27 Feb 1834. M Theron.

name: Carel {MR PADDY}
physical_description: about 5 feet long, bald head, and a mark on his face and on one of his armed, occasioned by fire
skill_occupation: Copper and tin smith, Speaks fluently
intentions: former employ Stellenbosch; lived as a free person many years
full_text: ABSCONDED, this Morning, from the U, his male slave named Carel, formerly the property of Mr Hoffman, of Stellenbosch - passed for many years as a free Person under the name of Mr Paddy - by trade a Copper and Tinsmith, about 55 years old, speaks fluently, about 5 feet long, bald head, and a mark on his face and on one of his armed, occasioned by fire - It is requested, on discovery, to lodge him in the nearest prison, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Worcester, 20th February, 1834.

name: Moos
physical_description: tall and stout figure, marked on the face and breast, and has lost his foreteeth
clothing: drab hat
full_text: 10 RDS REW. ABSCO, from the U, on the 6th inst, a male slave named MOOS, of Mosambique, about 38 years old, tall and stout figure, marked on the face and breast, and has lost his foreteeth; had on a drab hat, and passes himself as a Prize Negro. Whoever lodges him in the Prison, shall receive the above reward. Paardenberg, 17th March 1834. Widow Paul Jordaan.

full_text: ABSCONDED from the Insolvent Estate of JC Fleck, Esq. the Slave DOLLIE; he is a Malay, of short stature, about 36 years of age, has his beard long; was dressed in a white duffle jacket and leather trousers, field shoes, and a Malay hat; stutters rather; is a Mason by Trade, and is supposed to have hired himself in the Country as a free Man - Whoever lodges him in Prison will receive a Reward of 10 Rix-dollars; and those harbouring the said slave will be prosecuted. RW Eaton, JT Jurgens - Trustees.

All Persons are hereby warned against harbouring the said App; and a Rew of Twenty rd will be given… He is about 19 years of age, 5 feet 6 inches high, of a florid complexion, and stout make; he was clothed in new striped shirt, silk handkerchief, and white trousers and black hat. 8th May 1834. CW Richardson.

The last is between 20 and 25 years old; has woolly hair, rather brown of complexion, and squints a little; it is supposed he is accompanied by a Bushman Girl, who got two stumps little fingers. Whoever lodges said Apps in one of the Prisons, (who are supposed to have gone to the District of Worcester, with intention to proceed to the interior,) shall be rewarded; and those harbouring them will be prosecuted. The respective Magistrates and Field-Cornets are hereby solicited, should the above App be discovered in their districts or wards, to have him apprehended. Whoever...prosecuted. JOHS. Louw, Alb son. Rondeberg, 29 May 1835.

He deserted from the Amsterdam Battery, a Convict, on the 16th August 1834. He is a native of the Cape, of a yellow complexion, about 6 feet high: he may be known by a tremor on his upper lip when spoken to. M. Morison, No 6, Keizersgracht.

name: Flip
full_text: THE app FLIP, (who calls himself a free Person,) belonging to Mrs Martha Maria Jacoba De Villiers, married to Captain McCallum, having absented himself without my leave since the 15th March last, it is requested he may be lodged in Prison, if found in this Town or elsewhere, without a proper Pass under my Handwriting. He is frequently seen at the Rainbow balls on Saturday nights at Wynberg and Cape Town, where he acts as first Fiddler, and sometimes as Master of the Ceremonies. BJ van de Sandt. 6 July, 1835.

physical_description: figure moderate, complexion yellow, hair long and woolly
full_text: ABSCONDED, SINCE the month of May last, my app MARTHINUS, of this colony, aged 40 years, figure moderate, complexion yellow, hair long and woolly. He absented himself to the interior of this colony and was residing at the house of Mr Jan Overholster, of Candeboo, in the District of Graaff-Reinet, from whence he has proceeded towards the Kat River. Any person apprehending and returning him to the U, will receive a reward of 50 Rds; or any person lodging him in one of the prisons, 20 Rds. Whoever detains him after this notice, will be dealt with according to law. Gabriel H Le Roux. Stellenbosch, July 25 1835.

GALANT of this Colony, about 33 years old, color black, middlesized, black hair, is bandylegged, was dressed in a drab duffle jacket, leather trousers, handkerchief, and straw hat. Since last year: AFRICA, about 28 years old, colour brown, tall, black hair, has a scar under his left eye, and a defect on one of his little fingers. Hottentot cast of features. Has likewise been seen at Langehoogte. Whoever shall secure them...TWENTY five RDS for each of them, upon information and proof thereof to F Godf Watermeyer, Provisional Trustee.

full_text: 5 RD REWARD. WILL be given to any person who will lodge my Apprentice Servant HENRY YOUNG, alias BELMORE, in Prison, or deliver him safely to me. He absconded without cause on Tuesday, the 10th February, and has since been frequently seen in Cape Town, is 13 years of age, light brown hair, grey eyes, and freckled face; has on a straw hat with broad black band, coloured waistcoat, drab Moleskin Trowsers, with 3 red stripes on the braces. The U has but little hopes of recovering him through the medium of this Advertisement, and with many others who are similarly situated, some with two or three Servants away, have to deplore the want of proper Laws to check the rapidly increasing evils of vagrancy. The above is otherwise a very good Servant, but seeing daily instances of Boys running away without fear of detection, has for the sake of a holiday followed the example, and must, consequently, by this time, be in a rapid state of demoralization. Wynberg, 1st March 1836. HH Gird.

According to information received, he is supposed to reside at present near Piquetberg, or in the district of Tulbagh, where he passes himself for a Prize Negro. Whoever shall lodge...reward. Bergvliet, March 16 1836. Johannes Paulus Eksteen, JP's son.

name: Bastiaan

F Godf. Watermeyer, Sole Trustee. CT March 23 1836.
