name: Santon
physical_description: dark coloured, has short curled hair, and is of slender make
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 8th April last, the U's App, named SANTON, of the Cape, about 23 years old, dark coloured, much the appearance of a Hottentot, has short curled hair, and is of slender make. Honing Klip, Saldanha Bay, 20th June 1836. N Loubser.

name: Ali
physical_description: dark brown of colour, has a black mark on the bridge of his nose, curled hair, the upper lip elevated
intentions: hires himself as a free person, false name
full_text: 40 RDS REWARD. THE U having become entitled, by purchase, to the Services of the App ALI, formerly the property of the Insolvent Estate of SV van Reenen, Fs, will pay the above Reward to any person, who shall lodge him in one of the Prisons, or bring him to the U. He is dark brown of colour, has a black mark on the bridge of his nose, curled hair, the upper lip elevated, and has latterly let his services to Jan Buis, of Jourits River, as a free Person, under the name JAN BOVELAND. JG Stegmann. CT 14 July 1836.

name: Philis
physical_description: about 5 feet 5 inches high, dark eyes, long black hair, brown complexion, stout made, mark of an incised wound on the left side, a little behind the hip
clothing: handkerchief
intentions: Graham's Town/ Somerset; hires himself as a free person
full_text: ABSCONDED from my Service on the 23d Feb 1835, PHILIS, an App supposed to be either in Graham's Town or Somerset, where he is well known as a Mason, Carpenter, or Thatcher; he is about 5 feet 5 inches high, dark eyes, long black hair, brown complexion, stout made, 45 years old, and has a mark of an incised wound on the left side, a little behind the hip, wears a handkerchief round his head, and has the appearance of a Malay. Is in company with a Hottentot woman named Griet, his reputed wife, well-known in either of the above places as a notorious drunkard. I have no doubt he has hired himself out as a free person and owing to the want of a Vagrant Law, he and others in a similar situation, can do so, without fear of detection. Any person in whose service he might be, is requested to have him sent to the nearest Gaol, and those harbouring him shall be prosecuted. Kleine Gustrouw, Jonkers Hoek, 4th July 1836. MJ van Nuld Onkruidt.

name: Abraham
full_text: ABSCONDED, a considerable time ago, the Apps ABRAHAM and SARA, both of this colony, formerly the property of Mrs the widow J Pergo, now belonging to the U. Whoever…rewarded. Stellenbosch, 15th Aug 1836. BRH Daneel.

name: Lendor
physical_description: black, short and stout
full_text: 5 RD REW. ABSC. Since the month of December 1835 an App named LENDOR, belonging to Mr MJ van Der Spuy, S son, of Koeberg, Cape District; the said Lendor is black, short and stout, can make himself generally useful, and is quiet. It is supposed he has hired himself out in the neighbourhod of Ct as a Prize Negro. Any person lodging him in Gaol will receive the above reward,...prosecuted. NJ Lotz, Agent. CT 18 Aug 1836.

name: Aberam
physical_description: brown, short, and aged in appearance
full_text: 5 RD REW. ABSC. Since July 1835, an App named ABERAM, belonging to Mt DJ Smuts, M son, of Zwartland, District of Stellenbosch; the said Aberam is brown, short, and aged in appearance, speaks softly, and is a mason by trade. It is supposed he has hired himself out in the neighbourhood of Cape Town as a free person. Any person lodging him... prosecuted. NJ Lotz, Agent. CT 18 Aug 1836.

name: Japie
full_text: 25 RD REW. ABSC, since December 1835, JAPIE, of this Colony, aged 38 years, an App of color, belonging to William Rossouw Osmond, whoever shall lodge him in Gaol, will receive the above reward, upon notice and proof thereof, to the undersigned Trustees. If Japie returns to his duty of his own accord before the 30th of Sept next, and make his appearance before any one of the U in CT, no notice shall be taken of his defection; if not, he will be punished to the utmost rigour which the Law allows, if caught subsequently to that date. F Godf Watermeyer, JM Maynard - Joint Trustees. Cape Town Aug 25 1836.

name: Lodewyk
physical_description: yellow complexion
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED, my Apprentice called LODEWYK, of this Colony, yellow complexion, and a tailor by trade. It is supposed he conceals himself at Wynberg, and follows the occupation of a Coolie. He has been seen at Wynberg, and mentioned to diverse individuals there that he absented himself since the 24th November 1835. Whoever lodges him in gaol will be rewarded. Zwartland, District of Stellenbosch. Jan Andries Truter, Fs.

name: John Cooper
full_text: DESERTED, MY Juvenile Apprentice JOHN COOPER - left home on the 27th August, and has not since been heard of. Any person bringing him home, or committing him to any of HM's Jails, will be Rewarded. HA Truter, 29 Plein Street. NB. Any person detaining him after this notice, will be prosecuted according to Law. 28th September 1836.

name: Jacob
full_text: JS NEEDHAM, Caledon, 1st Oct, 1836. NOTICE. JACOB, an App to the above signed, having absented himself for a considerable time, and is supposed to be in the neighbourhood of Paarl. It is requested that the person or persons harboring him, will forthwith order him to his duty, otherwise they will be prosecuted according to Law. NB The above Apprentice has much the appearance of a Hottentot, 37 years old, a good Coachman, and is well known in Cape Town, Paarl, and Hottentots' Holland.

name: Hector
physical_description: slender
intentions: presents as a Prize Negro, Worcester
full_text: 50 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, since the 6th March 1835, the U's App HECTOR, of Mozambique, about 40 years of age, slender, and speaks loud; he is harbouring in the District of Worcester, where he states himself to be a Prize Negro - Also absconded, since the month of July of the present year, the App MAART, of Mozambique, about 50 years of age, small and limps with the left leg. Whoever will lodge them, or either of them with the U, or in one of the public Gaols, will receive a Reward of 50 Rds. PE Hamman. Stellenbosch, 15th Oct, 1836.

name: Maart
physical_description: small and limps with the left leg

name: Anthony
physical_description: left-handed
full_text: 20 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the U, on the 20th of September last, the following Apps, namely: ANTHONY, a native of Mozambique, PAMILA, female, native of this Colony, with her two children SALVEA, aged 11 years, and LEA, aged about 9 years, the three latter yellow complexioned, the first, second, and fourth, are left-handed. Any person lodging them in one of the Gaols, or bringing them to the U, shall receive the above reward. At the same time, Field-cornets are kindly requested to forward the Deserters to the U, in case they should be discovered within the limits of their Field-cornetcies. Jan-Paul Eksteen. Paardenberg, 15th of October 1836.

name: Pamila
physical_description: yellow complexion, left-handed

name: Salvea
physical_description: yellow complexion

name: Lea
physical_description: yellow complexion, left-handed

name: Solomon
physical_description: about 5 ft 4 inches high, stout, dark complexion, wears small mustachios
clothing: new blue Duffle Jacket and Trowsers
full_text: FIVE POUNDS REWARD. ABSCONDED from the Service of the U, his apprenticed laborer Solomon, by trade a Mason. The Indentures of this Apprentice were purchased in Cape Town about six weeks ago, from Mr Jacob van Reenen, J. Fs, He arrived in Algoa Bay in the St Helena, on the 9th of last month, and has since absconded from Port Elizabeth. He is 27 years of age, about 5 ft 4 inches high, stout, dark complexion, wears small mustachios; was dressed in a new blue Duffle Jacket and Trowsers. Any person employing or harbouring him after this Notice, will be prosecuted. And whoever shall give such information as may lead to his apprehension, shall receive the above Reward, on application to LH Meurant, Graham's Town; or The Publishing Clerk, at the Government Gazette Office, Cape Town.

name: Daniel
physical_description: 5 ft 7 in high, defect in one of his eyes, copper coloured
clothing: red cap and duffle jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED from Wynberg, on the 28th November last, DANIEL, an apprentice of the U, lately working as a mason. He is about 5 ft 7 in high, 35 years old, has a defect in one of his eyes, is a Malay copper coloured, was dressed in a red cap and duffle jacket. He was formerly a Slave of Mr Maynier, Capt Hare, and Benj. Stone. He is supposed to have hired himself as a free boy. Any person apprehending him, or giving information where he is to be found, will be rewarded for their trouble; and persons employing him after this Notice, will be prosecuted. Wynberg, 29th Dec, 1836.

name: Jason
physical_description: short and stout made, yellow complexion
full_text: DESERTED, JASON and JAPIE, formerly apps of Mr WM Rossouw Osmond. Jason is about 30 years old, short and stout made and yellow complexion, is in company with a small Hottentot Female named Lys, and they generally carry with them a Hottentot's Rankeen or Violin. Japie is tall and slender made, 35 years old, yellow complexion, and has lost a part of the first finger of his right hand, and part of his front teeth. Jason was last seen near Groene Kloof, whoever will deliver the said apps to the U, will be handsomely rewarded. CT Jan 1837. Edward Moore.

name: Japie
physical_description: tall and slender, yellow complexion, and has lost a part of the first finger of his right hand, and part of his front teeth

name: Jephta
physical_description: small sized
full_text: Cape Town, 26th January 1837. DESERTED since the 13th inst, my App named JEPHTA. The said app is a Mazambique African, small sized, about 16 or 17 years old, and stammers very much. Whoever shall lodge…prosecuted. Widow JH Bam, no 20 Grave-street.

name: Africa
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 26th December, the U's app AFRICA, with Merchandize, not having any leave to sell them. Whoever shall lodge…a Reward of 10 Rds. And whoever…prosecuted. Also, the App ADAM, formerly a slave of Mr David Piton; whoever lodges…Reward of Rds 5, and whoever harbours him is warned of the consequences. The Wid. H GNADE.

name: Jonas
physical_description: short body, long face and crooked nose, long legs, has a long step, and dark complexion
clothing: red handkerchief, drab duffle jacket and white trowser
full_text: ABSCONDED, upwards of two months the App of the U, called JONAS, short body, long face and crooked nose, long legs, has a long step, and dark complexion; wears a red handkerchief, drab duffle jacket and white trowsers; a saddler by trade. It is supposed, that he conceals himself in CT or Cape Flats. Any person...Gaols. WN Vos. Tulbagh Feb 1 1837.

name: Jonathan
physical_description: yellow complexion, slender made, rather a long head and curled hair
clothing: duffle jacket and leather trowsers
full_text: 25 RDS REWARD. ABSCONDED, on the 7th October last, my App JONATHAN, aged 17 years, he was dressed in a duffle jacket and leather trowsers; is of a yellow complexion, slender made, rather a long head and curled hair. Whoever shall lodge him in any of the Prisons, or bring him,,,consequences. the Field-cornets...in their respective Field-cornetcies. Klein Bottelary, 11 Feb, 1837. JG Fischer.

name: Plato/Pluto
physical_description: short and stout made, flat nose, wants the first joint of his left thumb
full_text: 25 RD REW. ABSCO since the 8th Feb, my App named PLATO, about 40 years of age, short sized, the thumb of his left hand mutilated. Whoever shall lodge…consequences. Verlooren Valley, 20th Feb 1837. HN Kotze, D son. {{Extra 0811: PLUTO, of Mozambique, short and stout made, flat nose, wants the first joint of his left thumb.}}

name: Sara
physical_description: short and slender make
full_text: RAN AWAY, SINCE the month of January last, my App SARA, short and slender make, with her child LOUIS, about 8 years old {under 6 in 1834}. Whoever…prosecuted. Widow W Dams. 23d March 1837.

name: November
physical_description: lame of one foot, about 5 feet and 9 inches high
clothing: white duffle jacket, and leather pair of trowsers
full_text: ABSCONDED. THE U's App NOVEMBER, of Mozambique, was dressed in a white duffle jacket, and leather pair of trowsers; he is lame of one foot, and about 5 feet and 9 inches high; aged about 45 years. He hires himself out as a Prize Negro, and was lately seen at Breede River, Worcester. Whoever...prosecuted. Honing Fontyn, Lower Ferry, at Berg River, April 24, 1837. GP Kellerman.

name: Maart
physical_description: middle sized, brown complexion, eyes deep sunk in his head, a dark sulky look, and curls generally hanging down from under his handkerchief
clothing: new blue duffle jacket and trowsers, and old drab hat
items_taken: a sail-cloth covering of his mattress
full_text: ABSC, on the 1st inst, my App MAART, native of this Colony, 44 years of age, middle sized, brown complexion, eyes deep sunk in his head, a dark sulky look, and curls generally hanging down from under his handkerchief. He took all his things with him, amongst which were a new blue duffle jacket and trowsers, a sail-cloth covering of his mattress, and old drab hat. Is supposed to be accompanied by his reputed Wife, a Hottentot woman called Truy. A Reward...prosecuted. Constantia, 12th May 1837. CG Blanckenberg.

name: Telemachus
full_text: ABSC from the Service of the U, since the 5th inst, my App Boy, by name TELEMACHUS. Whoever will lodge him in Prison, shall be rewarded. Widow DK Pallas. Cape Town, 19th May 1837. {{Extra: 0804: since 8th May? Supposed to be in the direction Groene Kloof, TELEMACHUS (Wagon Driver), address: Strand-street, CT}}

name: Jan
physical_description: dark brown complexion, middling size and of slender make; has a bald spot on his head
clothing: old brown jacket, with a patch of leather (voeringvel) on the elbow, and in new leather trowsers
full_text: ABSC on the 27th of Feb last, from the Service of Petrus Arnoldus van Zyl, Goern, before Kogmans Kloof, District of Swellendam, a Bastard Hott named JAN, dark brown complexion, middling size and of slender make; has a bald spot on his head, was dressed in an old brown jacket, with a patch of leather (voeringvel) on the elbow, and in new leather trowsers. He took with him a Gun belonging to his Master, mounted in black Stinkwood, and inlaid with Ivory. The Gun has a "Bier" or flat stroke on the barrel, and a "Sneller" at the lock; immediately behind the back screw of the barrel, a copper nail is driven in. The said Jan has last been seen on the Fransche Hoek's Mountain, pretending to be on his way to Wynberg or Constantia. Whoever lodges the said Jan with the Gun, in one of the Public Prisons, shall receive a reward of Ten Rixdollars.

name: Charlotte Morris
physical_description: fair complexion, blue eyes, short hair
full_text: NOTICE. CHARLOTTE MORRIS, Juvenile Apprentice, a stout full grown Girl, of fair complexion, blue eyes, and short hair, having left the house of the U on the 2d June last; Notice is hereby given…rewarded. C Blanckenberg. New Constantia, 3 July 1837.

name: Louis
physical_description: brown complexion, and has a waddling gait
clothing: duffle jacket, leather trowsers, and red handkerchief
intentions: Country Districts; former desertion at Visschers Hok
full_text: ABSC, since the 11th April last, the U's App LOUIS, aged about 20 years, of brown complexion, and has a waddling gait. When he absconded he wore a duffle jacket, leather trowsers, and red handkerchief. During his former desertion he lived at Visschers Hok, pretending to be a free person. Whoever lodges him in jail will be liberally rewarded. Wid PC Hammes. CT 21 May 1837. NB He is supposed to be in some of the Country Districts.

name: William Mc Maness
physical_description: round face, and red hair
clothing: new suit of Drab Duffle Clothes
full_text: ABSC, FROM the U, the Juvenile Emigrant, WM MC. MANESS - Had on a new suit of Drab Duffle Clothes. He has a round face, and red hair, and is about 14 years old. Whoever will…rewarded. W Hunt.

name: Jek
physical_description: thin stature, and has below his navel the mark of a sore
sightings: detained at place of Roelof vd Merwe
full_text: £1 REWARD. ABSC, since the 22d January last, my App JEK. He has been detained at the place of Mr Roelof van der Merwe, and has again absconded. He is a native of Mosambique, of thin stature, and has below his navel the mark of a sore. Whoever lodges him in prison will receive the above reward, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted in law. Gerrit Visser, Gs. Roggeveld, 25th Aug. 1837.

name: William Mims
physical_description: 4 feet 5 inches in height, marked from ear to ear from Scrofula, the right eye also diseased, a mark like a cut on the right side of his chin, two inches long, light brown hair
clothing: new suit of dark drab color Fustians, Seal-skin cap, and a black silk Handkerchief on his neck
full_text: APPRENTICE ABSCONDED. ABSC, my Juvenile Apprentice WILLIAM MIMS, aged 14 years old; 4 feet 5 inches in height, marked from ear to ear from Scrofula, the right eye also diseased, a mark like a cut on the right side of his chin, two inches long, light brown hair, was dressed in a new suit of dark drab color Fustians, Seal-skin cap, and a black silk Handkerchief on his neck - Any one harbouring the said app after ths notice, will be prosecuted...rewarded. Geo. Twycross. {Goes to Groenekloof, Zwartland but only established by later desertion, see GG _ 252 }

name: Jonge
clothing: white Duck trowsers, and a Blue Linen jacket
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 9th of October, the U's App, named JONGE, calling himself AFRICA, a Blacksmith by trade, is 20 years old, a Mozambique Afrikaner. He wore white Duck trowsers, and a Blue Linen jacket, and is supposed to have gone to the country with a trader's wagon - whoever lodges him in prison will be well rewarded. JH Vuurman.

name: Slinger
physical_description: has lost his lower teeth, and has a bald head
clothing: leathern trowsers, blue duffle jacket, and red handkerchief
full_text: ABSCONDED from the Service of the U, since the 6th inst, the Hottentot SLINGER, a Coachman, he was dressed in leathern trowsers, blue duffle jacket, and red handkerchief. He has lost his lower teeth, and has a bald head. He is in company with his wife ROSALYN, who states she is free, but much resembles an Apprentice, and committed a theft before her desertion; whoever lodges them in Prison will be rewarded, and whoever harbours them will be prosecuted in Law. M Jurgens. Garden Vredehoek, 17th Oct, 1837.

name: John Young
clothing: Straw hat, blue gambroon jacket, and light coloured Merino Trowsers
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED, on the 29th October last, JOHN YOUNG, an Indentured App of the U, was dressed in a Straw hat, blue gambroon jacket, and light coloured Merino Trowsers, he is supposed to be in the neighbourhood of Simon's Town. Any person apprehending him or giving information where he is to be found, will be Rewarded for their trouble, and Persons employing him after this notice, will be prosecuted. Cape Town, 2d November 1837. FR Brett, 34 Waterkant.

name: Manus
physical_description: small and spare
clothing: Moleskin Trowsers, striped Jacket, and Straw Hat, with Crape Hatband
full_text: ABSCONDED from the U, an App named MANUS, much resembling a Hottentot, and sometimes passing by the name of Landsman. He hires himself out at Koeberg to reap Corn; he is small and spare, and was dressed in Moleskin Trowsers, striped Jacket, and Straw Hat, with Crape Hatband. Whoever lodges him in Prison, will receive a reward of Ten Rixdollars. J. van Reenen. Round House, 22d Nov. 1837.

name: Jonas
physical_description: middle stature, black eyes, black curled hair, and has on the left side of the head immediately above the temple a conspicuous mark, caused by his falling in the fire while a child
full_text: ABSCONDED about the middle of November last, the U's app JONAS, about 30 years old, of middle stature, black eyes, black curled hair, and has on the left side of the head immediately above the temple a conspicuous mark, caused by his falling in the fire while a child. He is supposed to pass himself as a Bastard which he much resembles, and to be near Groeneberg, in Stellenbosch District. Whoever apprehends him and lodges him in the Jail, will be well rewarded. Bergvallei, Clanwilliam, 17th December 1837. GE Smit, Sr.

name: Joseph Garland
physical_description: light hair, about 5 feet in height
clothing: moleskin jacket and trowsers, black hat and shoes
full_text: ABSCONDED SINCE the 24th ultimo, my Juvenile Emigrant Apprentice, named JOSEPH GARLAND - He has light hair, is about 18 years of age, and about 5 feet in height. Had on when he went away a moleskin jacket and trowsers, black hat and shoes - Any person lodging him in Prison, and notifying it to the U, will be rewarded. Clasenbosch, Wynberg, 3d Jan 1838. JWJ Versfeld. {{Extra - 18380119 - NB The above App has been staying some days with Mr PJ Wahl, Field Cornet, Oliphants Kop, near Blueberg, which place he left on Sunday, the 14th Jan 1838, he there called himself James.}}

name: Daantje
full_text: ABSCONDED, my App DAANTJE - Whoever lodges him in prison will be rewarded. PJ Redelinghuis. {{Extra 18380413 - Absc since 2 months… He has often been seen at Wynberg and in that Vicinity… PJ Redelinghuys, Jr. Zonnebloem}}

name: Cornelis
physical_description: rather cross-eyed and near sighted, yellow complexion, and about 5 feet 5 inches high
full_text: NOTICE. ABSC on Saturday Night last, my App CORNELIS. He is rather cross-eyed and near sighted, yellow complexion, and about 5 feet 5 inches high; formerly Coachman to Mr Hunt, and lately to Mr Muter. Whoever will lodge him in Gaol, will be rewarded and those harbouring him will be prosecuted according to Law. Thomas Morris, Wynberg. {A cross-eyed Coachman :P}

name: David Leckey
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM my Place, Green-Point, on the 24th March last, DAVID LECKEY, an Irishman, about 50 years of age, who is already under a charge of theft and desertion. He was seen on the road to the Paarl; whosoever shall cause the delinquent to be apprehended, will do a good to the public. R Thomson.

name: Essageg Cosford
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 20th April, ESSAGEG COSFORD, a Juvenile Emigrant, apprenticed to the U; on the 1st may, he was seen on the Simon's Town Road, with a Handkerchief of Coals. Whoever lodges him in Prison will receive 10 Rds reward. CT 3d May 1838. AJ REIS.

name: Lowie
physical_description: black complexion, and thin posture; the sinews of his feet are drawn together by means of which he may be known
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 23d of April, my App LOWIE, about 20 years old, black complexion, and thin posture; the sinews of his feet are drawn together by means of which he may be known. He is in the habit of hiring himself as a Mason's labourer. Whoever lodges him in prison will be rewarded. 3d May 1838. Andries Brink, C.s.

name: Africa
full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 10th December 1837, the U's App AFRICA, of Mozambique. Whoever lodges him in Prison will receive 10 Rds reward…prosecuted. Cape Town. Widow JH Gnade.

name: Aron
physical_description: middle stature, and rather thin, with a thin face and crooked nose
full_text: ABSCONDED. SINCE September 1837, the U's app ARON, formerly belonging to the late Isaak van Hurden, Sr. He is of middle stature, and rather thin, with a thin face and crooked nose. Whoever lodges him…prosecuted. P Meiring. Hex River, 1st May 1838.

name: Willem
physical_description: middling stature
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the U, on the 6th March last, his App WILLEM, of Mozambique descent, middling stature, about 30 years old, and in company with a Hottentot Woman of the name Vytje, of stout stature, whoever lodges said Willem in Gaol, will be well rewarded. Hex River, 1st May 1838.

name: Abel
physical_description: short of stature and very stout
full_text: ABSC in the Night of the 15th inst, the U's App ABEL - He is short of stature and very stout, much resembles a Bastard, and limps. He is about 19 years of age. Persons harbouring him will be prosecuted, and those meeting with him are requested to send him to Gaol. Paul Johs. Toux, Ps. 4 Wale Street.

name: Frederick Lloyd
physical_description: broad face, strongly marked with small pox, small eyes, broad shoulders and hips, is short, stout, and plump
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED, since the 25th May last, from the Place Zoetendal's Valley, District Swellendam, the Juvenile Apprentice FREDERICK LLOYD, 19 years of age; has a broad face, strongly marked with small pox, small eyes, broad shoulders and hips, is short, stout, and plump. Any Person meeting the said App, is desired to give him in custody of a Field-cornet, as a Deserter. Any Person detaining him will be prosecuted. Reitz, Breda, Joubert & Co.

name: Mattheus
physical_description: black complexion
clothing: new kersey jacket and new leather trowsers
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED from the U's farm Oliphants Fontein, Zwartland, since the 2d of April last, two Apps named MATTHEUS and DOLLIE, both have been lately seen on the road to Saldanha Bay. Mattheus of black complexion, about 20 years old; Dollie of yellow complexion, about 20 years old; they were dressed in new kersey jackets and new leather trowsers. Also, a Hottentot named Hans Nieuwveld, absconded since 11th June last, taking with him two black cows and a black and white calf, which he was charged to bring to Zwartland. Any person bringing them to the U or to Mr PG Van Breda, Zwartland, or giving information concerning them, will be liberally rewarded. JA van Breda.

name: Dollie
physical_description: yellow complexion
clothing: new kersey jacket and new leather trowsers

name: Hans Nieuwveld
items_taken: two black cows and a black and white calf

name: August
full_text: RDS 20 REWARD. ABSCONDED, two apps named AUGUST and WILLEM, both of the Cape, the one much resembling a Hottentot, and the other a Mozambique; the latter wanting one of his lower teeth. Kersenbosch, Zwartland. W Basson, Js.

name: Willem
physical_description: wanting one of his lower teeth

name: Abraham
clothing: duffle jacket, white trowsers, and a malay handkerchief
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 28th Dec last, my contracted Apprentice [verbonden apprentice} named ABRAHAM; had on when he left, a duffle jacket, white trowsers, and a malay handkerchief on his head. Whoever lodges him in Prison will be rewarded, and those harbouring him prosecuted. He is supposed to be in the District of Koeberg. Willem Samodien, 27 Keerom-street.

name: Henry Vine
clothing: white duck trousers, moleskin jacket, brown cloth waistcoat, and black silk handkerchief and straw hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, on the 4th March, my Juvenile Emigrant Apprentice, HENRY VINE, about 14 years old, dressed in a pair of white duck trousers, moleskin jacket, brown cloth waistcoat, and black silk handkerchief and straw hat - taking with him a Pointer Dog, answering to the name of "Fear not," and wearing a tin collar. Whoever lodges said app in gaol, or brings him to me, will be rewarded; and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Paarl, 16th March 1839. PFR De Villiers.

name: Friederich 1
physical_description: short stature, pale face, red eyelids, as if suffering weak eyes
clothing: wears odd boots
full_text: To Field-Cornets. ABSCONDED from Mr P de Wet, of Platte Klipmill, and from Mr H Cloete, Hs, of Rondebosch, Two contracted German Servants, named FRIEDERICH, alias Fritz Kars, short stature, pale face, red eyelids, as if suffering weak eyes, and wears odd boots. Both are armed with Guns or Rifles. They are supposed to have gone in the direction of Hottentots Holland or Swellendam. All inhabitants or Field-cornets who may have an opportunity to arrest them, are requested to hand them over to the nearest authority, to be sent to their Masters.

name: William Mimms
physical_description: about 4ft 7in in height, a mark from ear to ear, from scrofula and an accident, a mark of a cut on the right side of his chin, 2 inches long, right eye rather sore, light brown hair
clothing: blue jacket, light twilled trowsers, new shoes, brown cloth cap, and took with him a small sack with old clothes

The U warns all persons not to harbour him or to take him in their service, as those doing so will be prosecuted in Law; and she offers a liberal reward to any person who shall apprehend him and lodge him in prison. Widow JH Bam. CT 21 Aug 1839.

W Turner. 32, Plein-street, Cape Town, Oct 3, 1839.

full_text: GOVERNMENT ADVERTISEMENT. THE attention of all Civil Commisioners, Magistrates and Fieldcornets is specially directed to the following notice from the Collector of Her Majesty's Customs, respecting certain Negroes who have deserted from the Negro Station at Papendorp. Colonial Office, Cape of Good Hope, 18th June 1840. By Command of His Excellency the Governor, (Signed) John Bell, Secretary to Government. CAPTURED NEGROES. Custom House, CT, 18 June 1840. WHEREAS about one o'clock on the Morning of Monday last, the 15th instant, Sixteen Men, of the non-distributed Captured Negroes, broke out, and effected their escape from the Negro Station at Papendorp, accompanied by a Negro Apprentice Man of Mr William H Theunissen, of Roseboom, Tygerberg, and there is reason to believe, they have gone in parties in the direction of Tygerberg, Blueberg, and Zwartland. Now I do hereby offer a Reward of Five Rixdollars for the apprehension of each Negro, exclusive of the expense necessarily, and actually incurred on the occasion. And further, I hereby caution any Person or Persons from harbouring, retaining in their service, or concealing these Deserters, or any other of the Captured Negroes who may desert; but all Persons at whose places such deserteres may arrive, are required to deliver them up, without delay, to the nearest Magistrate, Justice of the Peace, or Fieldcornet. A description Return of the Deserters is annexed. W. Field, Collector of H.M. Customs. 1. LEVELLEVY, 24 years of age, 5ft8in high, A on right breast, Tattooed all over the stomach. 2 TARVALAR, 26 years of age, 5 ft 9 in, A faintly on right breast. Pitted with Small Pox on the nose. 3. BOOSARO, 26 years, 5ft 3.5in, F on right shoulder blade. Tattoed all over the stomach. 4. MANUEL, 26 years, 5 ft 3.75 in, BG on right breast. 5. BROONDA, 24 years, 5 ft 6.25in, G on right breast. 6. PATROKA, 17 years, 5 ft 1.75 in, G on right breast. 7. SHUAAO, 24 years, 5 ft 2.5in, A on right breast. Slightly pitted with Small Pox. 8. SHUAAO, 26 years, 5 ft 3.5 in, M very faintly on left breast. 9. MARTINU, 17 years, 5 ft 2 in, Tattoed on right breast. 10. KOMPOANDE, 25 years, 5 ft 3.5in, Tattooed on forehead and both cheeks. 11. NAMATAMBO, 30 years, 5 ft 5.25 in, Tattoed on stomach and breast. 12. ROBERT, 24 years, 5 ft 7 in, Z on the breast. 13. ASSAYER, 25 years, 5 ft 1 in, (upside down B) on the breat and tattooed on forehead. 14. KOOKANNI, 34 years, 5 ft 7 in, M on right breast, tattooed on the forehead and cheeks. And Two men from the Hospital [No description]. Also, CHUCHANDUO, 28 years of age, 5 ft 4 in high - IGH on the right breast, and tattooed on the forehead. Deserted from Mr Theunissen. They were clothed in Blue Cloth Jackets and Trowsers, Red Shirts, and Scotch Caps, except two who had on White Duck Trowsers instead of Blue Cloth {maybe the hospital 2?}

full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED on the 10th inst, in company with an American, who calls himself William Barslet, my female Apprentice MARY MAHARY, about 18 years old, short figure, light brown hair, a cast in her eyes, very near sighted; - also my Juvenile Apprentice ROBERT LOGAN, about 18 years old, stout figure, red hair, full, freckled faced, marked with Small Pox, right leg much swollen, an ulcer on it. Whoever will lodge either of the two last-mentioned in Prison, or give information as will lead to their detention, shall be Rewarded. New Constantia, 23d June, 1840.

full_text: ABSCONDED. THE Juvenile Apprentice THOMAS FLYNN, about 13 years old, short and stout made, with sandy hair, fair complexion, and left eye considerably inflamed. At the time of his desertion, he was dressed in an old pair of blue linen trowsers, striped shirt and neckcloth; whoever returns him to me or lodges him in prison will be rewarded, and those harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted. P Harmsen.

ABSCONDED from the Residence of the U, on the Wynberg Road, on Monday morning last: KAMMANY, with mark GB on the right breast, 19 years of age, 5 ft 5.5 in high, black jacket, blue kersey trowsers, striped shirt, and brown fur cap. full_text: ABSCONDED, THE two Juvenile Apps of the Rev. GW Stegmann, WILLIAM PARKER, a tall good-looking youth, with dark hair, and EDWARD JONES, of slender make, with small sharp features - Any person harbouring these youths are hereby requested to hand them over to the proper Authorities. Captains of Ships are specially requested to take notice of this Advertisement, as it is suspected that these boys have absconded only from a desire to go to sea. Cape Town, 18th Nove 1840.

PV van der Byl. Eerste River, 21st Dec 1840.

ABSCONDED from the Undersigned, on Monday morning, the 11th instant, NIMPIPI, with mark Z on the right breast, about 7 years of age, 4 feet 1.5 inch in height, was dressed in a white shirt, trowsers, and a striped Apron - Any person meeting with the said Apprenticeis requested to lodge him in the Prison and give notice therof to the Undersigned; and any Person found harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted as the law directs. Cape Town, 14th Jan, 1841. JRG Klerck, No 7 Boom-street.

full_text: ABSCONDED, ON MONDAY EVENING, at 9 o'clock, my Juvenile Emigrant, THOMAS FLYNN, aged about 13 years; fair complexion, slightly pock-marked, with light hair and strong made. He took with him all his clothing, consisting of two suits of dark woolen cloth, and two suits of light stuff, a blanket and pillow, and wore an old brown cap, and shoes nearly new. Whoever lodges him in Prison, will be Rewarded, and those harbouring him, be prosecuted in Law. He has expressed a desire to go to sea. P. Harmsen. 34 Boom street, 24th Jan 1841.

full_text: ABSCONDED on Saturday 23d inst, EDWARD HARRISON, Juvenile Emigrant, 14 years old, fair complexion, had on a straw hat, white jacket, yellow waistcoat, light trowsers and a pair of shoes. Any person harboring him after ths notice will be prosecuted. CT, 27 Jan 1841. HA Sandenbergh.

name: George Plunkett
physical_description: marked with small-pox
full_text: NOTICE. ABSCONDED from CT on the 8th inst, three Lads, answering to the following descriptions: GEORGE PLUNKETT, an apprentice to Mr J Hickey, shoemaker, aged 16 years, marked with small-pox; JOHN HOLLAND, aged 15 years, son of Mr Holland, stable keeper; CHARLES POLLER, aged 12 years, stepson of Charles Langeveld. Any person harbouring or employing them will be prosecuted according to law, and any person giving such information to Mr Holland respecting the two last named as might lead to their return will be rewarded.

clothing: moleskin jacket, white duck trowsers, and red cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the service of the Undersigned, a Juvenile Apprentice named THOMAS HARDING, (of the age of seventeen); was dressed in moleskin jacket, white duck trowsers, and red cap. Any person lodging said T Harding in one of the prisons, or delivering him to the Undersigned, will receive a reward. Clasenbosch, 11th Feb, 1841. JWJ Versfeld

full_text: ABSCONDED from Hottentots Holland, on the 21st Jan last, two persons answering the following descriptions: ELIZA FOULGER, Juvenile Emigrant, 17 years old, a tall strong girl, of fair complexion, short brown hair, blue eyes, wore an open straw bonnet and a light printed dress. JAMES SMITH, fisherman, a Native of Germany, speaks English; his real name said to be JOACHIM CAREL THEODORE REICH, about 27 years of age, fair complexion, middle size with short neck. They were accompanied by a pack-ox, carrying luggage. The former is an Apprentice and has deserted, and the latter has connived at the desertion, and has harboured the said apprentice - Any information...received by Rev J EDGAR, Hottentots Holland, or Mr J BRESLER, 96 Long Street, Cape Town.

full_text: ABSCONDED PRIZE NEGRO. ABSCONDED on the 15th Feb, a prize negro, named NAMATAMBO, about 30 years of age, 5 feet 5 inches in height, marked Z with a star on the breast, being dressed in a duffle jacket, with green lining, and a pair of duck trowsers, and carrying with him when he deserted a pair of Assagaais and a sword. Whoever will give any information regarding him or lodge him in prison, will greatly oblige the undersigned. JP Cloete. Great Constantia, February 17 1841.

clothing: black gambroon jacket, brown silk waistcoat, black moleskin trousers, and blue cloth cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 11th inst, ROBERT HARE, App of the U. The said Robert Hare is fifteen years and six months of age, about four feet nine inches in height, fair complexion; he had on, when he absconded, a black gambroon jacket, brown silk waistcoat, black moleskin trousers, and blue cloth cap. He is supposed to be harbored in the vicinity of Rondebosch. Any person detaining said app will be prosecuted, and any person giving such information as may lead to his apprehension, will be rewarded. R Yates, Cabinet Maker, 25th Feb 1842.

full_text: ABSCONDED. THE Undersigned's Prize Negro, CONCHABA, calling himself ANTHONY, is about 20 years old, 5 feet half inch high, marked Z on his right breast. He is very much pock-marked, and has large holes in his ears, has been seen last near Berg Rivier. Whoever returns him to me or lodges him in prison will be well rewarded, and those harbouring hi, be prosecuted. BH Eyberg. Groene River, District Malmesbury.

full_text: {repeat offence 18401030} TO FIELD CORNETS AND OTHERS. ABSCONDED early this morning, from the Residence of the U, near Wynberg, the Prize App "MANUARE" (known also by the name of "LENZO") 23 years of age, about 5ft 2in; marked QG on the right breast. Took with him a new regatta shirt, and several other items of wearing apparel. Field-Cornets and others are requested to apprehend the said Apprentice and cause him to be lodged in any of HM Prisons. H. Watson. NB - The above app having absconded about four months, and was harboured for a considerable time by some person at or near Stellenbosch: Notice is hereby given that any one practising similar conduct will be prosecuted. CT 30th March 1841.

name: Johannes Egbertus Ehrenberg

full_text: ABSCONDED, since the 3d inst, my app named JOHANNES EGBERTUS EHRENBERG, aged 17 years, of a slender make, rather dark complexion, native of this colony. Any person harbouring the above apprentice after this notice will be prosecuted to the utmost rigour of the Law. J Bartie, Blacksmith. No 3 Mostert Street, CT, 13th May 1841.

The person on whose place he may be, is requested to forward him to CT prison, those harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted. JS Krige.

full_text: ABSCONDED from the parsonage house at Wynberg, my 2d app named MACOMO, about 29 years old, marked M on the right breast, wore a duffle jacket, leathern trowsers, and straw hat. He is of middle size and good figure. Any person meeting the above app is requested to forward him to CT prison, as those harbouring him will be prosecuted. JS Krige.

full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the U, on the 16th inst, his Juvenile App Joseph Logan, 19 years of age, chubby faced, slightly speckled, dark eyes and hair, had a dark green petersham jacket and some other clothes with him; he is supposed to have gone with a lad of colour called Michiel alias Jochem, and to have a dog with a fan tail with them. Any expense attending the apprehension of the siad Joseph Logan will be paid, whilst anyone harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted. New Constantia, 23d June 1841. CG Blanckenberg.

Whoever shall be found harbouring the said app will be prosecuted according to Law. Information to be lodged with the undersigned. Alex. Hutchinson, 28 Heerengracht. {{Attorney, in next paper}}

R Crozier. Boom-street, CT.

He is supposed to be somewhere about Blueberg. Whoever brings him to the U shall be rewarded; and any person harbouring him after this notice shall be prosecuted. 55 Keerom-street. Willem Samodien.

Trowsers and blue cloth cap; whoever apprehends the said App will be handsomely rewarded and any person harbouring him after this notice will be prosecuted according to law. Garden Maisonnette, 19th October 1841. D Kuys.

Garden Uitkyk, 7th Dec 1841. RH Loedolff.

THOMAS CHESTERS, App to the U, deserted on the 20th November ultimo, was dressed in a blue Camlet Jacket, brown Trowsers, an oilskin hat or Cap; his age 17 years, very short; has dark brown hair, and remarkable bald place on the fore part of his head - Any person harbouring the said Chesters will be prosecuted and those giving such information as will cause his apprehension will be rewarded on application at the Gazette Office, or at the Undersigned. Dorp Street, Stellenbosch, 30th November 1841. HPH De Wit.

Whoever lodges him in prison at Stellenbosch or CT will be liberally rewarded, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. JA Groenewald. Driesprong, Klapmuts, 27th December 1841.

name: Dennis Tidence
physical_description: short and stout make, face broad and pockmarked
clothing: Moleskin Jacket and Trowsers, blue Shirt, and a Farmer's Straw Hat
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON TUESDAY last, my two Juvenile Emigrants, DENNIS TIDENCE, 15 years old, short and stout make, face broad and pockmarked, has a defect in his speech - He wore a Moleskin Jacket and Trowsers, blue Shirt, and a Farmer's Straw Hat. He has been absent during the last 3 months in the District of Caledon, and has been lodged in prison here in the last week, and deserted on the day of his discharge. THOMAS SERJENT, 15 years old, slight make, pale complexion, whitish hair; was dressed in a Moleskin Jacket and Trowsers, white shirt, and a drab woollen hat with low crown. Whoever lodges them in prison will be rewarded. CT Garden "Uitkyk" 24th Feb 1842. RJ Loedolff.

name: Thomas Serjent
physical_description: slight make, pale complexion, whitish hair

name: John Brown
physical_description: 5 feet 5 inches in height, fair complexion, blue eyes, and good looking
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Place "Hamans [Herman's] Daal," District of Caledon, two Juvenile apps of the undersigned, viz: JOHN BROWN, about 18 years of age, 5 feet 5 inches in height, fair complexion, blue eyes, and good looking; and WILLIAM STEWARD, aged 17, height 5 feet 5 inches, dark complexion, good looking. If apprehended, to be lodged in the nearest prison and those harbouring them after this notice will be prosecuted. John Bourhill.

name: William Steward
physical_description: height 5 feet 5 inches, dark complexion, good looking

name: Beemley
physical_description: "N" marked on his right arm
full_text: NOTICE TO FIELD CORNETS & OTHERS. ABSCONDED, on the 23d January, my two Negroes, one named BEEMLEY, the other named SOUZA, supposed to be in company with two belonging to Mrs Morkel. Beemley has "N" marked on his right arm; Souza has "A" marked on the right breast, All persons detaining these Negroes after this notice, will be prosecuted. Any person discovering them is requested to lodge them in prison. Romeo, Hottentot's Holland. Peter Gerhard Wium.

name: Souza
physical_description: A marked on the right breast

name: Japa
physical_description: four feet and a few inches high, marked Z on the right breast, short, stout, and fat of figure, with a flat nose
clothing: 3 new pair of trowsers (grey), 2 jackets (moleskin and summer cloth), 3 waistcoats, and a new cloth cap
full_text: ABSCONDED, JAPA, a Prize Negro, in the service of the U he absented himself on the 16th inst, he is about 12 years old, four feet and a few inches high, marked Z on the right breast, short, stout, and fat of figure, with a flat nose, took with him 3 new pair of trowsers (grey), 2 jackets (moleskin and summer cloth), 3 waistcoats, and a new cloth cap. He has lately been for three weeks in Zwartland, under the name of Witgat, where he worked on the threshing floor of some farmer. Whoever finds him is requested to send him to the Undersigned, as those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Cape Town, 4 Wale street. PJ ROUX.

name: Godsena
physical_description: well made, about 4 feet high, marked with a raised brand on his breast
full_text: ABSCONDED [of verdwaald] since the 2d inst, the U's Prize Negro GODSENA; he is well made, about 4 feet high, marked with a raised brand on his breast. Whoever returns him to Mr PJ Truter, at the office of the Clerk of the Peace, CT, or to the U will be well REWARDED. JD Freislich. Malmesbury 11th April 1842.

name: Zoozy (Dick Turpin)
physical_description: 5 feet high, rather slim figure
clothing: grey cloth jacket, and trowsers nearly the same colour, and a white Beaver hat
full_text: NOTICE TO FIELD CORNETS AND OTHERS. ABSCONDED, on Monday Morning, 25th inst, (before daylight) my apprentice Prize Negro Boy named ZOOZY, or DICK TURPIN, about 5 feet high, rather slim figure and nearly 16 years of age, had on a grey cloth jacket, and trowsers nearly the same colour, and a white Beaver hat - Any person finding the said App is requested to send him to the nearest Gaol, and whoever harbors him after this notice will be prosecuted according to law. T Adney, Market Square.

name: Daala
physical_description: marked S, on each shoulder
clothing: duffel jacket, duck trowsers, and blue striped shirt, and a cap on his head, red on one side and blue on the other
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the Undersigned's Farm, at Salt River, the Liberated African named DAALA, marked S, on each shoulder; he was dressed in a duffel jacket, duck trowsers, and blue striped shirt, and a cap on his head, red on one side and blue on the other. Any person meeting him is requested to send him to prison, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. CT, 11th May 1842. FH Truter.

name: William Samuels
physical_description: slender figure, has dark eyes and dark hair, and has lost all his lower teeth
full_text: ABSCONDED, ON the 24th March last, from the House of the U, WILLIAM SAMUELS, about 14 years of age; is of slender figure, has dark eyes and dark hair, and has lost all his lower teeth. Whoever may discover the said boy is requested to lodge him in the nearest gaol, or to send him to Cape Town; and whoever harbours him after this notice, shall be prosecuted to the utmost rigour of the Law.

name: Fomaambe
physical_description: five feet one and 3/4 inches in height, marked S on his right Shoulder blade
clothing: pair of linen trowsers, gray Cloth Jacket and a Manilla Straw Hat
full_text: NOTICE TO FIELD CORNETS AND OTHERS. ABSCONDED during the night of the 26th and 27th of May my Negro Apprentice FOMAAMBE. He made his escape through my store. Is about the age of sixteen years, five feet one and 3/4 inches in height, marked S on his right Shoulder blade, and was dressed in a pair of linen trowsers, gray Cloth Jacket and a Manilla Straw Hat. Any person finding the said apprentice is requested to send him to the nearest Gaol, and whoever harbours him after this notice, will be prosecuted according to law. CF Barth, Apothecary. CT, 27th May 1842.

name: Maluel
physical_description: height 5 10 3/4 inches, S faintly marked on the right shoulder blade
full_text: ABSCONDED, FROM the place of the U, situated in Paardenberg, two liberated Africans, one named Maluel, aged 22 years, height 5 10 3/4 inches, S faintly marked on the right shoulder blade; and the other named GOOMA, aged 17 years, height 5 feet 4 1/4 inches, no mark. Any person meeting them is requested to forward them to the U or to Prison; and any person harbouring them will be prosecuted according to law. EL Heyn. Paardenberg, 24th May 1842.

name: Gooma
physical_description: height 5 feet 4 1/4 inches, no mark

name: Manual
physical_description: 4 1/2 feet high, very black complexion
clothing: duck trowsers, duffel jacket, and red cape
full_text: ABSCONDED FROM the U's farm "Melkboom" in the Division of George, the two undermentioned Negro Apprentices: 1. MANUAL, 23 years old, 4 1/2 feet high, dressed in duck trowsers, duffel jacket, and red cape, is of very black complexion. 2. LEVEENBOYDA, 18 years old, 5 feet high, dressed in duck trowsers, blue kersey jacket, and red cap. He is of brown complexion, and has white spots round his mouth, occasioned by a rash. Both have colored woollen blankets with them. A Reward will be given to those that bring them back to the u, or lodge them in Prison, and those harbouring them shall be prosecuted. Melkboom, 20th May 1842. JA Meyer, N son.

name: Leveenboyda
physical_description: 5 feet high, brown complexion, and has white spots round his mouth, occasioned by a rash

name: Partroka
physical_description: five feet two inches high, the letter G branded on his left breast
clothing: brown duffle jacket, striped shirt, canvas trowsers, and black hat
full_text: NOTICE. A NEGRO APPRENTICE, answering to the name of PARTROKA, 19 years of age, and five feet two inches high, has disappeared from the subscriber's place since 19th instant, having on a brown duffle jacket, striped shirt, canvas trowsers, and black hat, and having the letter G branded on his left breast. Field Cornets and others are requested, should they find him, to secure him and give intimation to James Martin. Croedenie, near Swellendam, 23d July 1842.

name: Macomo
physical_description: middle stature, and marked PM on his right breast
clothing: Moleskin Jacket, Leather Trowsers, and wore a glazed Hat
full_text: RAN away from my place on the 2nd August last, my Prize Negro MACOMO. He was dressed in a Moleskin Jacket, Leather Trowsers, and wore a glazed Hat. He is of middle stature, and marked PM on his right breast. Any person meeting him is requested to lodge him in prison, and those harbouring him will be prosecuted. Stellenbosch Kloof, 6th Sept 1842. JS Krige.

name: William aka John Hendriks
physical_description: middle age and stature, but stout and active withal, has a scar over the right eye, is very dark, and has thick wooly hair
clothing: felt hat with a feather in the tie, a white cotton shirt, a coarse blue cloth jacket, drill trousers, and half boots or high shoes
items_taken: a deal box or case, containing various
full_text: 100 RDS REWARD. WHEREAS my Servant WILLIAM alias JOHN HENDRIKS, did on the Morning of THURSDAY, the 20th inst or FRIDAY the 21st inst, receive into his charge a deal box or case, containing various Utensils, Apparel, Books, Stationery etc from the stores of Messrs Borridailes, Thompson & Pillans - I hereby offer the above reward to any person that may procure, or give such information as may lead to the apprehension of the said servant (vide his description at foot,) and the recovery of the above case with its contents. Henry F Drinkwater. Simon's Town, October 28, 1842. DESCRIPTION OF THE ABSENTEE: A man of middle age and stature, but stout and active withal, of Mozambique extraction, has a scar over the right eye, is very dark, and has thick wooly hair. Wore on leaving his service a felt hat with a feather in the tie, a white cotton shirt, a coarse blue cloth jacket, drill trousers, and half boots or high shoes. Speaks English fluently.

name: James Ferrol
physical_description: spare figure, brown hair, and one of his eyes smaller than the other
clothing: Leathern Trowsers and a pair of blue ditto, a blue frock, and a straw hat, a pair of field shoes
full_text: ABSCONDED since the 3rd inst, my Juvenile app JAMES FERROL, aged 16 years, spare figure, brown hair, and one of his eyes smaller than the other. He took with him a new pair of Leathern Trowsers and a pair of blue ditto, a blue frock, and a straw hat, a pair of field shoes and a tin bowl. Whoever lodges him in prison will be rewarded and those harbouring him be prosecuted. Wagenmakers Vallei, 9th November 1842. DJ Van der Merwe.

name: Manuel
physical_description: 5 feet high, marked0^ on the left breast
full_text: ABSCONDED a month ago, from my place Speelman's River, my male African MANUEL, aged 18 years, 5 feet high, marked0^ on the left breast, and has been seen about Cape Town; any person apprehending said Manuel will be rewarded by the U. Caledon, 9th November 1842. DW Hoffman.

name: Nitchintod
physical_description: marked Z ICM on the right breast; is about 5 feet 3 inch high

full_text: 10 RIXDOLLARS REWARD. MY NEGRO Apprentice NITCHINTOD, absconded on the 6th of November; whoever apprehends him shall receive the above reward, and those harbouring him shall be prosecuted. He took with him a dark blue cloak, lined with crimson, and is marked Z ICM on the right breast; is about 5 feet 3 inch high, and of broad Mozambique countenance. 23 Grave Street, CT. J Robertson.
